articleTitle: Parametric synthesis of enterprise infocommunication systems using a multi-layer graph model
abstract: This report calls attention to the need for multilayer graph model usage for solving the problems of synthesis of telecommunication systems including company communication systems. With the application of the model in the form of a multilayer graph the link capacity choice problem for self-similar traffic is solved. Comparative analysis of the proposed method with previously known ones shows that the infocommunication system synthesized by the proposed method provides a lesser network delay.

articleTitle: The flow-based model of multicast routing
abstract: The flow-based model of multicast routing in the telecommunications network is developed. The model is represented by a system of linear algebraic inequalities and equations of the network state. Model calculates a set of paths for multicast routing with a maximum bandwidth or a minimum number of hops. The model includes conditions to prevent a possible overload of network links.

articleTitle: Structural and functional optimization of transport telecommunication network
abstract: A dynamic model of the structural and functional optimization telecommunications transport network at the state space is proposed. The model describes the process of coordinated tasks by the choice of topology (CT) and channel bandwidth (CCB), flow distribution (FD) and limit traffic (LT) entering the transport network. The model features the capability of solving the problem of distribution of investment between the stages of optimization in concert with the objectives of CT, CCB, FD and LT, which is an advantage of the proposed solution. The use of the criterion of optimal solution considering the total cost of the structural and functional optimization of transport telecommunication network is justified.

articleTitle: Adaptive modulation and coding in broadband wireless access systems
abstract: This article presents study results of linear Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC) methods usage, based on channel quality measurements in Broadband Wireless Access Systems. Article shows that linear methods effectively compensate fading in AWGN channels and channels with Rayleigh flat-fading. In case of multipath channels with Rayleigh and Rician fading, the effectiveness of linear AMC methods is lower, because of significant difference in noise immunity characteristics for separate transmission profiles from their analog for AWGN channels.

articleTitle: Dual-frequency temperature-compensated Quartz Crystal Oscillator
abstract: The paper deals with the construction of a high-stability crystal oscillator with digital temperature compensation of frequency instability. Improving the stability of oscillation frequency of the crystal oscillator is achieved by more accurate temperature compensation of destabilizing effects on the basis of identification of the thermal mode of the quartz resonator in two-mode excitation.

articleTitle: Autodyne 8-mm wave length range radioblock system for ballistic tests
abstract: The description of an autodyne radioblock system based on the 8-mm wavelength range Gunn diode oscillator is given. The device is designed to detect the products in a defined area of space during their ballistic tests with flat trajectory with the aim of launching devices recording fast processes. Functional chart description, an appearance photograph and output signal records of radioblock system are presented.

articleTitle: Quality improvement of manual soldering of microwave devices
abstract: Reliability of electronic devices is determined, first of all, by reliability of solder joints, which depends on the temperature- controlled soldering and other factors. As a result of the complex theoretical and experimental studies of the factors that influence the temperature of the soldering station when soldering, and, consequently, the soldering temperature.

articleTitle: Relaxation instability in Quantum Wire
abstract: It is shown that the nonequilibrium quantum effects caused by charge transport through boundaries of contact areas and the conductive channel of Quantum Wire can lead to instability and to negative differential resistance of the device. These phenomena open prospect of application of Quantum Wire for generation of terahertz range electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: Ways to improve reliability of microwave devices
abstract: Currently, application conditions of the instruments (vibration, shock, high temperature and so on) become more and more complicated. At the same time, even more often, for example, devices in optical band of wavelengths are interconnected with devices in the radiation range of wavelengths, microwave range of wavelengths and so on. Under these conditions the frequency of failures of devices increases. It is shown that the most difficultly revealed defects of interconnected devices are defects of solder connections of microwave devices. The approach allowing considerably increasing the reliability of solder connections is offered.

articleTitle: Specific dynamic features of flow of electrons in crossed fields
abstract: The formation of isolated clots of electrons, which determine both the behavior of the flow and its noise properties has been found by means of high-precision system of numerical simulation in the investigation of the dynamics of extended flows of electrons in crossed fields. The received results testify that the very main frequencies of clots passing through the corresponding crosssection are matched by the maxima of current amplitudes.

articleTitle: Analysis results for distribution methods of time-frequency downlink resource of LTE technology
abstract: The comparative analysis of the proposed model of distribution for time-frequency resource of LTE technology with the existing methods in terms of the overall performance of the downlink, the degree of balancing capacity, as well as the probability of the desired transfer rate allocation to the user equipment (UE). It is shown that the proposed model under high requirements to transfer rate of UE as compared to known methods, allows 5–20% increasing the downlink capacity balance ratio and 40–100% increasing the probability of allocation of required transfer rate to UE.

articleTitle: A measuring device of the complex reflection coefficient
abstract: The paper shows a theoretical possibilily to increase the measurement accuracy of the complex reflection coefficient of a double-pole circuit by forming amplitude-modulated signals in the reference and measuring channels, discriminating from the spectrum the detected components' signal with information about the module and phase of the reflection coefficient of the double-pole circuit being investigated, with further processing of those by the developed algorithm.

articleTitle: The theoretical description of the hierarchical condensation near the phase equilibrium
abstract: The mechanism for the phase formation on the example of quasi-equilibrium steady-state condensation in the ion-plasma sprayer was proposed. It is shown that the condensation nuclei form a statistical ensemble of hierarchically subordinate objects distributed in the ultrametric space. To describe this ensemble the Langevin and the Fokker-Planck equations were deduced.

articleTitle: Speaker identification by characteristics of linear prediction residual
abstract: Synthesis and research of text-independent adaptive algorithms to identify speakers by characteristics of linear prediction residual are described. As the informative features we use coefficients of Fourier transform of an autocorrelation function of a linear prediction residual signal processed with different time window functions. Experimental tests on the proposed identification algorithms are carried out.

articleTitle: Efficiency estimation of using MIMO technology in ad-hoc networks
abstract: Based on the built model of ad-hoc network with MIMO technology, the variation of total energy consumption for feeding transmitting antennas and processing the received signal is shown to provide the same level of data transmission rate in the network. Curves of such variations are shown for an example of the system with nodes having equal quantity of receiving and transmitting antennas.

articleTitle: Autodyne microwave sensor for contactless monitoring of internal dimensions of the product
abstract: Description of the autodyne sensor prototype model designed for contactless monitoring of internal dimensions of products at their mass production is given. Autodyne sensor operating principle based on comparing the monitored and the model product dimensions is presented.

articleTitle: Calculation methodology for devices of Klystron type in self-consistent mode
abstract: In one-dimensional approximation on basis of a numerical model of an electron current the recurrences presenting a selfconsistent mode of klystron-type devices are obtained. The equations are assumed as a basis of the program for calculation of output characteristics of the indicated devices. Results of calculation of a double-cavity double-gap generator-gain klystron are shown.

articleTitle: The spectral analysis of a cylindrical-radial waveguide junction with laminated dielectric filling
abstract: The present paper concerns the problem of the natural electromagnetic modes, regions of their existence and interaction with all possible types of resonances in the junction of cylindrical-radial waveguide with laminated dielectric filling. The electrodynamic model has been created and the numerical analysis of the spectral characteristics has been carried out. The problem of the boundary effects in samples of finite size is studied.

articleTitle: Intelligent support for target marketing of telecommunication companies
abstract: The web-based application to determine the preferences of telecommunication company target audiences was developed. Information obtained as a result of on-line survey is processed using data mining techniques. As a result of analysis the groups are formed on the target preferences and specify the methods of formation of tariffs.

articleTitle: X-band MMIC limiter with amplitude modulator function
abstract: The present paper concerns development results of x-band MMIC high speed limiter with amplitude modulator function are presented. This limiter is characterized with small size and fast response. The experimental characteristics are provided.

articleTitle: Two-level hierarchically coordinational model of users traffic distribution over telecommunication network nodes
abstract: The paper presents investigation of the hierarchical queuing concept to improve quality of service for users. Proposed for use is the hierarchically coordinating principle of solving the task of managing a multi-level system. The proposed hierarchical queuing model is presented in decomposing form by differential equations.

articleTitle: Use of modern wireless technologies in combined LTE/DVB-NGH systems
abstract: Some methods of increasing mobile systems' capacity intended for transmission of large multimedia traffic flows are reviewed. In addition to the general traffic partitioning scheme, the way of using combination of LTE and DVB-NGH technologies is described. The high since-driven potential of using MIMO, UWB and OFDM technologies within integrated LTE/DVB-NGH system has been determined.

articleTitle: Method of localisation of wireless sensor network nodes at the initialization phase
abstract: The method of positioning WSN nodes with a combined experimental and analytical cycle during initialization allows obtaining the relative and global coordinates of the network elements. This improves the quality of service and provides data compression, efficient routing, visualization on the remote control, etc.

articleTitle: Development of L-band amplitron
abstract: Different design versions were studied and simulated, the fabrication technology was developed and experimental models were fabricated for compact M-type L-band amplifier (amplitron) with output power exceeding 6 kW. Measurements of the electrical parameters of models were performed.

articleTitle: Successive Interference Cancellation methods in tree algorithms of Random Multiple Access
abstract: Nowadays Wireless Broadband Networks (WBN) are dynamically developed sphere of science and technology. The given work concerns the analysis of Random Multiple Access method called Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC), which is widely used in IEEE 802.16 standard. The direction of research is rather up-to-date and its importance is very high.

articleTitle: Simulation and efficiency evaluation of router queuing management algorithms
abstract: Several queue management algorithms are evaluated in terms of their capabilities of maintaining high resource utilization, identifying and restricting disproportionate bandwidth usage, and their deployment complexity. The performance of Drop Tail, RED, ARED is compared based on simulation results and with respect to parameters such as throughput, packet end to end delay, and average queue size.

articleTitle: Correlation direction finder with two OMNI-directional antennas
abstract: J-correlation method of direction finding is considered. The structural diagram of the direction finder coincides with the scheme of the optimum receiver. DF characteristic is obtained, its form is determined by the parameters of the signal. The method provides an unambiguous measurement. Decrease of the base distance allows improving the accuracy of measurements.

articleTitle: The multi-band antenna with a modified screen
abstract: In this paper we consider multi-band antenna based on fractal Sierpinski napkin located at an angle relative to the plane of the screen. The modified versions of the screens are proposed. A computer experiment in FEKO software is considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of probability characteristics of the combined multiple access
abstract: We consider the probabilistic model of a channel utility factor in a case of combined multiple access, which allows assessing and analyzing the effectiveness of the access method with increasing user traffic.

articleTitle: Development facilities for database application on Java
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of data of the most widely used integrated environments of application development on Java. A set of different criteria is proposed to allow estimating with high credibility the properties of the compared products, their strong and weak points. The estimation of functionality of development environments has revealed the leadership of NetBeans IDE as a basic tool for database application development.

articleTitle: Information and communication technologies - Challenges and problems of implementation
abstract: The present paper concerns the main tasks of development and implementation of information and communication technologies and approaches to their implementation.

articleTitle: A 2–8 GHz ultrawideband 14 W power amplifier
abstract: The results of the development and experimental investigation of 2–8 GHz range broadband GaN transistor amplifier with CW output power of 14–21 Watt and PAE 25–30% (to be used as a transmitting module of broad-band multibeam arrays) are presented. The experimental characteristics, design features and assembly technology of the amplifier are discussed.

articleTitle: Waves and dispersion in 2-D periodic metal rod structures
abstract: 2-D periodic wire metamaterials have been investigated by the volume integral equation with Green's function of periodically located sources (periodic FG). It is shown that such structures are highly suitable for the transmission of terahertz and infrared radiation. The wires are taken into account as complex permittivity of metal for terahertz and infrared frequencies. The homogenization of ideal and nonideal metallic wire media are performed.

articleTitle: Test and measurement instruments and systems of Rohde & Schwarz (Germany)
abstract: Rohde & Schwarz is one of the world's largest manufacturers of electronic test and measurement equipment. Our products set standards in research, development, production and service. As a key partner of industry, network operators and public institutions, we offer a broad spectrum of market-leading solutions for state-of-the-art technologies, including hyper frequency applications up to 500 GHz. The purpose of this work is the short review of the main achievements of the company in the field of radio measuring equipment of the general application.

articleTitle: Recursive error-corrected coding of number-impulse data sources in telecommunication systems
abstract: Methods of the error-correction information exchange in telecommunication systems are analysed. Properties, advantages and disadvantages of recursive coding methods of number - impulse data sources are defined. The offered method of the inverted forming of recursive code sequences allows carrying out autorun of devices of data digital manipulation.

articleTitle: Scientist and teacher of brain-power (to the 90th anniversary of professor Igor Vsevolodovich Lebedev)
abstract: I. V. Lebedev — Doctor of Engineering, Honored professor of National Technical University «Moscow Power Engineering Institute» (MPEI), Honored master of Science and Engineering of the microwave, Laureate of state prize of the USSR. I. V. Lebedev was born on the 13th of September 1922 in Moscow. He graduated Moscow Power Engineering Institute in 1946. I. V. Lebedev — a creator of the powerful gas discharge devices for anti-missile systems, solid-state switches and protective devices of the microwave. Professor I. V. Lebedev — founder of the scientific school of the microwave engineering. His two-volume text book «Microwave engineering » and «Microwave electronics» was published twice and translated into English and Chinese languages. Professor I. V. Lebedev made 57 graduations of specialists of the microwave on the «Electronic devices» chair, MPEI, participated in the establishment of the University of electronic science in China. He is a research supervisor for more than 40 Ph.D.'s of science and 5 Doctors of Engineering. Professor I. V. Lebedev was awarded with government awards of USSR and China.

articleTitle: Investigations of mode splitting below FMR in magnetized resonator made of barium ferrite
abstract: Mode splitting has been investigated experimentally in frequency range below 47 GHz for the main resonant mode HE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11δ</inf> of magnetized cylindrical resonator made of barium ferrite. Influence of a dielectric layer between a resonator and a metal shield has been examined for the resonance frequency splitting.

articleTitle: Cross-shaped combiner of five-port analyzer of the complex reflection coefficient
abstract: The five-port automatic network analyzer based upon a new concept has been tested in the 26–37.5 GHz range. Analyzer consists of a symmetrical cross-shaped junction and three directional detectors from the scalar reflectometer. An experimental waveguide cross-shaped junction has been designed and used in a five-port measurement system. Validation of moving loads with |Г|<0.7 resulted in errors |Г|≤10%,Δθ ≤ ±10°.

articleTitle: Technological methods for fabrication of Al2O3-plates as bases for microwave structures
abstract: Technological methods for the formation of 100–400 µm thick free Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-plates by a two-sided through anodization and subsequent bipolar anodization for the application as bases for microwave strip structures were designed. High shape stability and crack resistance after high-temperature (> 500 °C) treatments, ∼20–23 W/m·K thermal conductivity, ∼7.2–7.4 relative dielectric constant were obtained.

articleTitle: The academician A.P. Alexandrov and his activity in the Crimea (to his 110th anniversary)
abstract: The present paper concerns some little-known facts of participation of the academician A. P. Aleksandrov (1903 – 1994) in operations in Vrangel's army, his capture and a sentence to shooting down after the capture of the Crimea by the Red Army in 1919 – 1920, as well as some technical details of his activity concerning the naval protection against magnetic mines in Sevastopol in 1941. The scheme of a test bench and a photo of a memorable sign dedicated to the events of 1941 is provided.

articleTitle: The method of horn antennas absolute cross-section estimation
abstract: The improved experimental method of horn antennas scattering signature estimation based on substitution methods is proposed. The method includes an enhanced measurement structure chart and an enhanced experimentation algorithm.

articleTitle: The research of the distributed objects' radar image recognition algorithms
abstract: The formulas of the sufficient statistics for the grading the radar images received in RSA are obtained. The comparative analysis of the efficiency of the grading the named images as the feature of the sufficient vector, the moments' vector with the parametric and non parametric solution rules is carried out.

articleTitle: Analytical solutions of Maxwell's equations with tensors of dielectric permittivity and magnetic permeability
abstract: The present paper concerns the analytical solutions of Maxwell's equations in one-axis anisotropic medium, where tensors of dielectric permittivity and magnetic permeability have diagonal type.

articleTitle: Harmonic spectrum analysis of a plate metal-dielectric waveguide
abstract: The results of the study of wave types' range in a plate of metal-dielectric waveguide, which is a promising line for transmission of radio-electronic systems (RES), are presented. It is shown that the influence of higher spectral harmonics on the parameters of RES antenna waveguide channel is reduced.

articleTitle: Microwave diagnostics of structure and charge state changes nature of manganese impurity in ZnSe crystals
abstract: Results of ESR-investigations of ZnS and ZnSe crystals activated by manganese ions are presented in this report. It Is shown, that at plastic deformation of ZnSe crystals partial, and complete dislocations both take part. It is discovered, that after deformation the quantity of Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> ions are decreasing.

articleTitle: The technology of bibliographic descriptions conversion
abstract: This article describes how to create the conversion technology of bibliographic descriptions from the previous formats to the current DSTU GOST 7.1:2006 on the territory of Ukraine, as such possibility is absent in existing control systems of bibliographic information. The structures of bibliographic descriptions of different standards are explored, compared and the difference between GOST 7.1-84 and DSTU GOST 7.1:2006 is analyzed. The obtained information is used to form the principles of the conversion of bibliographic descriptions to the current format on the example of the abstract of dissertation. It is also proposed to apply the markup language XML in the bibliographic description based on a defined set of rules.

articleTitle: The effects of resonant scattering of waves provided by the metamaterial layer
abstract: The results of the study of the resonance properties of the metamaterial layer composed of wire helices wound in different directions and spatial orientation are presented. Numerical simulations revealed that at the frequency f = 2 GHz such a structure fully reflects the incident wave, and at the frequency f = 2.8 GHz the wave passes through the layer without reflection. At the frequency f = 2.39 GHz incident wave propagation direction changes by 90°.

articleTitle: International Crimean conference “microwave and telecommunication technology” (CriMiCo): 1991–2010. Bibliographic index of the conference proceedings
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of creation of the bibliographic index of proceedings of the International Conference CriMiCo for 20 years. The structure of the index and the auxiliary reference tool for the index is considered. Problems which originators faced at working on the index are noted.

articleTitle: The synthesis of a linear antenna array with cosecant directional pattern
abstract: This article presents the results of theoretical calculation and experimental testing of a linear antenna array (AA), designed for the formation of directional characteristics of cosecant type with a broad operating sector in the elevation plane. Identified factors, due to which there is a deviation of the measurement results of an experimental specimen of AA from the results of theoretical calculation.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic simulation of the exciter for the multibeam APAA optical type distribution system
abstract: The study of the exciter for the optical type distribution system is carried out. The results of electrodynamic simulation of VSWR, losses between wave ports, radiation patterns and H-Fields distribution, are presented.

articleTitle: Thermally stimulated change of optical properties of cuinsete nanocrystals in silicate glass
abstract: Concentration dependence of optical properties of the glasses containing a solid solution CuInSeTe is studied, and influence of additional heat treatment on spectral properties is established. The difference in the spectra is explained by the transformation of the lattice.

articleTitle: Technique and algorithm for design of microstrip directional filters
abstract: The method for calculation of both separate elements and the whole device was offered on the basis of the known block diagram of a microstrip directional filter of traveling-wave (MDFTW). The algorithm for topological design of such devices was validated and developed, and the examples of its practical realization were given.

articleTitle: Spatial signal processing with QAM-M modulation efficiency research for microwave link
abstract: The analysis of experimental investigation of spatial signal processing of a microwave band for a signal-of-interest with modulation QAM-M extraction (M=64, 128, 256) from a wanted signal radiation source against interference from another radiation source for the case when bands and polarization type are the same, but the radiation source angular position is different, are presented. These results can be helpful for designers of microwave devices and microwave systems, such as radio relay systems.

articleTitle: Moisture sensor based on coaxial resonator with below-cutoff part
abstract: Theoretically studied electromagnetic features of the resonator measurement converter with below-cutoff part that used for measuring the moisture content of bulk materials. Complex numerical studies of characteristics were conducted. The design of the moisture sensor based on a resonator with a below-cutoff part was developed.

articleTitle: Increasing performance of differential noise-shift keying communication system
abstract: It is shown that one of the underlying causes of the performance deterioration in communication system utilizing stochastic signals is bit energy fluctuations. Normalization of the signal provides a significant gain in performance of communication system using a stochastic carrier.

articleTitle: Dual-layer patch-antenna fed via plated holes
abstract: The topology, design, theoretical and experimental frequency response of the SWR, the measured radiation patterns obtained by near and far fields method of dual-layer patch antenna feeding through plated holes, are presented.

articleTitle: Interpretation of radioimpedance sounding data for different models of environment
abstract: The description of program software for solution of direct and inverse problems of radio impedance sounding is presented. Results of interpretation of radio impedance sounding for different models of Baikal region environment are given.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation of ε-negative metamaterial
abstract: This paper presents the numerical results for ε-negative medium, consisting of thin metal rods. Field localization in the structure defect area is demonstrated, losses in plate waveguide are studied. The structure geometry influence on the radiation and dissipative losses is investigated.

articleTitle: Influence of composite materials with foamed binder powdered filler dispersity on their electromagnetic shielding characteristics
abstract: The manufacture technology of composite materials based on foamed denatured collagen and powdered oxide containing iron waste -cupola gases sludge treatment (CGST) - characterized by different dispersity is described. It is shown that CGST dispersion decreasing leads to the reduction of the electromagnetic shielding effectiveness of the composite materials with foamed binder formed on the basis of CGST.

articleTitle: Increase of UWB signals information capacity in radio networks
abstract: Each impulse of UWB signal carries just one bit of information. In radio networks it is necessary to mark signals destination. The easiest way to do this is to send mutually orthogonal series of impulses (addresses) for each subscriber. But such series still represents one data bit and decreases the overall data transfer rates. The amplitude, duration and polarity modulations of each impulse allow significantly increasing data traffic of each impulse and the all series.

articleTitle: Results of software complex «Digital Television System» development
abstract: The results of development of software complex «Digital Television System» unit that provides laboratory study of principles of digital television signal formation are reported. Methods of study of image discretization and quantization using linear and nonlinear scales are described.

articleTitle: The method for forecasting date, time and duration of terrestrial stations blinding by the sun
abstract: This paper concerns the method for forecasting a date, time and duration of terrestrial stations blinding by the Sun that leads to a communication gap.

articleTitle: Academician A. I. Berg and the black sea fleet (to Berg's 120th anniversary)
abstract: The present paper concerns a short biography of academician Axel Ivanovich Berg (1893 – 1979), the Soviet scientific radio technician, the admiral, the deputy minister of defense of the USSR, the academician of Academy of Sciences of the USSR, the Hero of Socialist Work. The paper presents information concerning A.I. Berg's participation in short wave communication tests carried out on the Black Sea Fleet in 1928, as well as a version about his participation in communication tests between the ships on the Black Sea in 1940.

articleTitle: Synthesis of neuro-fuzzy systems of data flows intensity control in mobile ad-hoc network
abstract: The functions of neuro-fuzzy systems of data flows intensity control in a military mobile ad-hoc network are formulated. Procedures of output sizes value receipt of the neuro-fuzzy systems, are presented. The basic stages of synthesis of the neuro-fuzzy systems which can be utilized for data flows intensity control in the examined network are offered.

articleTitle: Polyfunctional foamglass using radioabsorption material
abstract: Electromagnetic properties of foamglass used as radioabsorption material are considered.

articleTitle: Methods of random signals recognition in infocommunication
abstract: Some practical peculiarities of methods to recognize random signals are considered when there are both signals with unknown probabilistic characteristics and statistically defined signals are given for recognition. The novelty of the present work is that it considers the signal recognition problem solving with employing methods based on different probabilistic models like auto regression processes, mixtures of standard distributions and expansions of random signals with respect to orthogonal functions.

articleTitle: Radiation degradation of light-emitting diodes
abstract: The present paper concerns the comparative complex study of degradation kinetics of light-emitting diodes in the course of the long neutron and gamma irradiation and tests for non-failure operation at thermocurrent loadings without irradiation. Serially released devices on the basis of A3B5 connections (arsenide and gallium phosphide) and GaAlAs solid solutions were exposed to research.

articleTitle: Multiband irradiator of spiral coils with outputs for each frequency band
abstract: This paper describes a way of designing a circularly polarized antenna consisting of regular spiral coil irradiators tuned to different frequency bands and aligned one inside another. In so doing, the required directionality characteristics are provided for each frequency band. The analytical relationship between currents in coils of aligned spirals is presented. Practical implementation and a comparison between analytical and experimental results are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improvement of the calculation theory of electrodynamic characteristics of metal-dielectric planar periodic structures
abstract: The system of linear equations in the approximation of a given current for a rigorous mathematical formulation was obtained. It allows conducting a comparative analysis of the characteristics of the excited diffraction radiation harmonics for arbitrary parameters of a planar periodic metal-dielectric structure.

articleTitle: Angular characteristics of radiowave scattering on finite cylinder objects
abstract: The calculation of the angular scattering characteristics of millimeter waves incident at different angles to the cylinders of finite length with various ratios of length and radius was carried out. As a method of calculation the method of discrete sources was used.

articleTitle: Technological and design features of contact-connection elements of microwave devices
abstract: The peculiarities of structure and technology of manufacture of contact-connection passive elements for modern microwave microelectronic device are considered. Their operating parameters are given.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic lattice “invisibility” of the resonance crystal made of magnetodielectric spheres
abstract: Solution and analysis of a problem on electromagnetic lattice “invisibility” of the resonance crystal made of magnetodielectric spheres in the form of octahedron with a cubic crystal lattice are presented.

articleTitle: n-TiO2/p-Si anisotype semiconductor heterojunction structure
abstract: The dominating current-transport mechanisms were established: multistep tunnel-recombination via surface states at the metallurgical interface TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si under low forward bias; the dominating mechanism of charge carriers' transport is tunneling at forward bias V > 0.6 V. The reverse current through the heterojunctions under investigation was analyzed in the scope of the tunnel mechanism.

articleTitle: LNFS-RC low noise synthesizer with fixed output frequency
abstract: The fixed-frequency synthesizer that allows generating sine wave output signals synchronized with an internal or external reference in the microwave range with low phase noise. This synthesizer can be used as a source of reference signals for different radio systems, in particular for the direct digital frequency synthesizer (DDS).

articleTitle: Condition and directions of development of service handover procedures in mobile communication cellular systems
abstract: The analysis of modern condition of procedures and realization of service handover outlines is presented, their classification is given, on the basis of features of development of modern mobile communication cellular systems the conceptual directions of development of procedures of horizontal and vertical service are planned.

articleTitle: Modeling of antennas of radio frequency identification tags
abstract: Combined volume-surface integral equations for simulation of radio frequency identifying tags (RFIT) is proposed to build an approximate model for calculating the input impedance and radiation pattern of its antennas. We discussed the different planar and nonplanar configuration in terms of their obtained characteristics.

articleTitle: Algorithm of digital watermarks forming for audiosignals
abstract: The novel algorithm of DWM forming is designed on the base of scalar product quantization for vectors of audio signal frequency coefficients and pseudorandom sequence. Adaptation of step quantization and multichannel processing using OFDM technology provide DWM robustness against amplitude distortions, filtering and digit-analog-digit transformation. Possibility of flexible choosing of algorithm parameters allows realizing DWM robustness-imperceptibility trade-off for construction of practical schemes of information security.

articleTitle: Instability in the day to day variability of ionospheric F2 region electron density
abstract: The critical frequencies of the ionospheric F2 region are used to find the possible causes of the high day-to-day variability in the ionosphere under the influence of space and atmospheric factors. The ionosphere is shown to be influenced by processes that are operating in neighboring regions above and below even in the absence of powerful events, and to respond to forcing as an open system that dissipates the energy.

articleTitle: X-ray nonprojective tomographic microscope
abstract: This paper describes the operation principle and the characteristics of the new device for nanoscale objects visualization (biological tissue sections and slices, cell structures, nanostructured powders etc.) in the range of X-ray and EUV radiation. The device allows obtaining the two-dimensional image using tomographic reconstruction techniques on a set of one-dimensional sample projections.

articleTitle: Millimeter radiowave amplitude fluctuations in absorption lines of near-earth atmosphere
abstract: The theoretical analysis of millimeter wave beam fluctuations in the near-earth turbulent absorptive atmosphere was carried out by the first approximation of the smooth perturbation method (Rytov method). The influences of outer scale size of the turbulence and wave beam parameter on level variations were investigated. It has revealed that under certain conditions the amplitude scintillations in absorption lines of atmospheric gases can exceed similar fluctuations in window regions.

articleTitle: Modern models and standarts of software quality
abstract: Considered the features of models: Capability Maturity Model and Software Quality Requirements and Evaluation, which representing the quality of the software. Presented the comparative analysis of these models with standards series ISO 9000 and defined the problems and challenges of their practical application.

articleTitle: Experimental determination of power handling level in continuous and pulsed modes for mmic limiter
abstract: The present paper concerns experimental determination of a power handling level in continuous and pulsed modes for MMIC limiter. This limiter is based on a Schottky diode. Influence of a method of installation and radio impulse parameters on power handling level are considered. The experimental values are showed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the metric's characteristics for packet queuing control system
abstract: A method for evaluating the performance of packet queuing management in TCP / IP routers is proposed. The method allows comparing efficiency in a broad range of input load router. This takes into account the possibility of adaptive management.

articleTitle: Characteristics of routing protocols in telecommunication networks
abstract: Routing protocols — these are the rules of interaction of routing equipment telecommunication networks, such as messages of routing table updates, IP addressing, interaction algorithms, algorithms for processing messages. The article deals with the requirements that apply to messages update routing tables in the dynamic routing protocols.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the potential accuracy of the comparisons of the timeline using SBAS system signals
abstract: The current state for comparisons of standards of time and frequency of the passive method using the total coverage algorithm is considered. Relations are given for estimating the shift scales and standards errors. The classification and proposed methods for estimating uncertainty of measurement and research are presented. Experimental evaluation of potential accuracy of the comparison of time scales using SBAS signals system is carried out.

articleTitle: Surveillance radar application for cab location at the hump yard
abstract: Test results of 3-cm and 8-mm wavelength ranges surveillance radar samples for the hump yards are presented. The prospects of improving surveillance radars for automated location of the cabs both on the hills and in the station sorting yard are outlined.

articleTitle: The combined waveguide directional coupler
abstract: The results of the study of the combined directional coupler, the channels of which are made of different types of waveguides (hollow metal and flat metal-dielectric) are presented.

articleTitle: Organization of scheduling processes in linux operating system
abstract: Understanding of resource allocation processes in operating system is complicated by the different implementations of the scheduler, the inaccuracy of the models and intricacy of approaches being used in the development of resource schedulers. This paper considers the process of resource scheduling in the operating system and its analytical model.

articleTitle: GaN HEMT with 0.5-µm gate length and gate width of 500 µm and 1500 µm
abstract: Design and fabrication process of 0.5-µm GaN HEMT with 500-µm and 1500-µm gate width are described. Results of the S-parameter measurements are presented and compared with the data of TGF2023-01 transistors fabricated by TriQuint Semiconductor.

articleTitle: The pyroelectric sensor of heat flow using a peltier element based on single-electron transistor
abstract: It is possible to obtain a cyclic structure which will generate pulses with generation frequency depending on the value of heat flux, if we connect a pyroelement in a daisy-chain to a one-electron transistor's lock, and connect a Peltier cooling element to the pyroelement.

articleTitle: Graphene: Unique material or vain expectations?
abstract: In the present report the author intends to show that the question presented in the title is not just futile one. The great number of empirical evidences of exclusive lability and/or even instability of graphene's properties is rather convincing ground for its statement.

articleTitle: Semiparametric methods of hypothesis testing about average value on basis of decomposition in space of Kunchenko
abstract: The new method of statistical hypothesis test about the mean value of random values, being based on the decomposition in space with a generative element (Kunchenko's space) and use the property of the minimization of the variance of stochastic polynomials is offered. Gained analytical expressions allow optimizing deciding rules on a certain high-quality criterion and expecting the probabilities of errors during solution of problem. The comparing of the polynomial of deciding rules during to linear rule is conducted by a statistical design.

articleTitle: On the support of quasi-homogeneous field distribution near aperture antennas
abstract: Amplitudes of electromagnetic fields in the near zone of aperture antennas are investigated theoretically. Amplitude distributions of the field on the aperture are homogeneous and cosine ones. The influence of quadratic phase distributions of the field on the aperture is investigated. It is shown that they allow supporting near to uniform distribution of the electromagnetic field power on some limited planes parallel to the aperture or inside of some volume in the near zone of the antenna.

articleTitle: Calculation of near field microwave microscope based on the system «pin with a gap — short with hollow»
abstract: The article shows that the relation (1) allows drawing a calibration plot as a curve of reflection factor versus frequency in resonance vicinity for the near field microwave microscope based on the system «the pin with a gap - short with hollow». In order to perform calculations using this relation, three parameters of experimental curve such as curvature of the frequency characteristics, resonance frequency and reflection factor shall be kept at resonant frequency.

articleTitle: High efficiency L-, S-, C- band GaN power pulse amplifiers
abstract: The results of the development and experimental investigation of a L-, S- and C-band GaN transistor amplifiers with output pulse power from 68 to 200 Watt and minimum PAE 40–55% for AESA radar systems are presented. The experimental characteristics, design features and assembly technology of the amplifier are discussed.

articleTitle: Method of increase of efficiency of assistance to the victims according to the integrated number 112
abstract: The present paper concerns the problems of call service in the system 112. The method of organization of queues on territorial criterion and allocation to each queue of an assignable number of operators is offered. It is also offered to create the software which will allow mobile teams of the emergency aid to have access to a database of calls in order to make more correct decisions on-site.

articleTitle: High-speed digital frequency synthesizers based on Galois basis
abstract: The construction principles of the phase accumulator in direct digital frequency synthesizers are considered. The mathematical analysis of propagation delays in the transfer phase drives is carried out. The basis for the construction of high-speed Galois phase accumulators of computing frequency synthesizers is considered. Application of the proposed structures of phase accumulators allows reducing energy consumption of the synthesizers and improving their performance characteristics.

articleTitle: Direct digital method of the spectral correlation-interferometric radio direction-finding with double correlation processing
abstract: The present paper concerns the analysis of precision characteristics of proposed direct digital method of the spectral correlation-interferometric radio direction-finding with double correlation processing. The results of analytical analysis and software simulation are presented. As a result of the use of this method the increase of performance of correlation direction-finders is provided with maintenance of high exactness.

articleTitle: Waveguide transmission lines: Some issues of automated designing
abstract: The waveguide layout automation problem concerning large-sized phased antenna arrays is stated. The methodology of the waveguide transmission line designing automation using topological methods is presented.

articleTitle: Quality evaluation of video data using subjective integral function
abstract: The analysis of existing approaches to assessing the quality of video data and a mathematical model to determine the quality of the video data by calculating the integral function that takes into account the combined indicators of the quality of video and voice parameters, and the correction factors obtained experimentally by expert groups.

articleTitle: One spark — Compose your own project management app
abstract: In recent years many useful web-based services were introduced, which simplify the work on projects. The idea of One Spark is to include these tools, having no direct project relation, in the scope of project management software (PMS). One Spark is an easy to use PMS, which allows single users and teams working efficiently on projects. Based on a new plugin concept it allows including these external services and managing them as tools within their own project environment.

articleTitle: High-power GaN/AlGaN Ka-band HEMT's on silicon carbide substrates
abstract: The development of the 100×4 micron transistor design, the nano-structured hetero-layered materials and the technology with 0.15 to 0.2 micron design rules has made possible the production of power GaN/AlGaN Ka-band HEMT's on silicon carbide substrates and measurements of their static and ultra-high-frequency characteristics (S-parameters). The HEMT parameters G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>=8.89 dB and P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>∼ 450 mW achieved at frequencies up to 40 GHz indicate the possibility of using them for creation of the SSI Ka-band power amplifiers.

articleTitle: X-band GaAs MMIC core chip
abstract: This report presents results of design and manufacturing of X-band GaAs MMIC core chip for T/R modules of modern telecommunication and radiolocation systems. The MMIC are realized in the 0.18um pHEMT (ED02AH) process of OMMIC foundry.

articleTitle: Determination of kinetic parameters of gaas by monte carlo simulation of semiconductor plasma
abstract: The paper presents the results of computational experiments to determine GaAs kinetic parameters. The calculated dependences of scattering rates on the energy of carriers in valleys of GaAs are presented. The optimal energy intervals are determined for implementation of ballistic transport. The time and field dependences of drift velocity of carriers are calculated.

articleTitle: Dynamic flow control method for coherent optical communications
abstract: The paper focuses researches on network transporting technologies. A comprehensive data-transfer approach proposed for dynamic flow control in connection oriented packet based transporting networks with coherent optical communications. A multipurpose network meta-protocol is introduced for dynamic flow control. The tenets of integrated telecommunication technology platform are developed to facilitate the network transportation function. The paper intends to contribute in future generation networks.

articleTitle: Determination of level of steadiness against data encapsulation steganographic methods attacks
abstract: The influence of different types of attacks against the images embedded with DW (digital watermark) was considered. The comparative analysis of stability to distortion of the most popular methods of embedding DW in spatial and frequency domain images and using wavelet transform was carried out.

articleTitle: Experimental research of autodyne microwave vibration-sensor signals
abstract: Description of the test installation is presented. The stand is designed for research of autodyne oscillators and modernized for studying autodyne signals received from the vibrating reflecting object. The experimental research results of the spectral composition of signals obtained for the hybrid-integrated oscillator based on 8-mm wavelength range Gunn diode, are presented.

articleTitle: Multicriteria optimization of multiparameter adaptive information transfer system
abstract: The technique of finding the Pareto-optimal states of multivariate adaptive data transmission system as a combination of variable parameters of the transmitted signal is proposed. This allows excluding obviously inefficient state from among those in which the system transitions in the process of adaptation at the design stage.

articleTitle: The method of active magnetic introscopy in the Earth's crust investigations
abstract: The main content of the active magnetic intros?opy (AMI) method to analyze the structure and dynamics of the Earth's crust is considered. The possibility of using explosive magnetic generators (EMG) as active sources of external magnetic field is proved. The block diagram of the method and the evaluation of the magnetic field, which provides the magnetization of rocks, are presented.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of screened dielectric waveguides system with distributed coupling
abstract: The present paper concerns a possibility of implementation of the mechanical and electronic control methods for the electrodynamics characteristics of functional devices which based on coupled dielectric waveguides by means of changes in the parameters of conductive screens according to numerical and experimental simulation.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of HEMT current-voltage characteristic with thin InAs layer
abstract: The possibility of HEMT drain current enhancement is numerically investigated by means of implementation of a super thin film semiconductor layer with high mobility. The peculiarities of new and standard HEMT current-voltage characteristics were also investigated.

articleTitle: Terbium luminescence under X-rays from YAlO3 composite deposited on porous anodic alumina
abstract: Terbium-doped yttrium aluminum composite was synthesized by the co-precipitation method. The deposition was made by spinning of the aqueous-alcoholic solution of aluminum and yttrium salts on a porous anodic alumina formed on a monocrystalline silicon substrate. The YAlO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> phase was revealed after the heat treatment at 1000° C. The terbium luminescence excited by X-rays was observed along with the intense photoluminescence. The synthesis procedure is of interest for the development of radiation-resistant film luminescents.

articleTitle: Modeling of the mimicry cloak using coordinate transformation
abstract: The present paper concerns a possibility of creation of anisotropic dielectric cloaks, which provide to the body covered with them the mimicry to a body of other shape, so for an external observer perceives the body covered with such cloak as a body of other shape. The technique of designing mimicry cloaks with using coordinate transformation is presented. Numerical modeling of the mimicry cloak is held and the estimation of efficiency of their work is made and practical recommendations are given.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic fields excitation by multi-element vibrator-slot structure in rectangular waveguide
abstract: A problem of electromagnetic fields excitation by a structure, consisting of a narrow transverse slot in a broad wall of a rectangular waveguide and two asymmetrical vibrators with variable surface impedance, located inside the waveguide, is solved by the generalized method of induced electro-magneto-motive forces (EMMF). Calculated and experimental dependencies of energy characteristics of the vibrator-slot structure for different vibrators placement relative to the slot and for various dependencies of surface impedance upon the vibrators length are presented.

articleTitle: Method of separating metagraph representing fuzzy knowlede base into layers
abstract: This paper presents a method of a separating metagraph which represents the fuzzy knowledge base into layers. This method is based on the method of separating into layers for a directional graph considering the structural features of a metagraph. This separation allows one to structure the fuzzy knowledge base better and improve the efficiency of fuzzy inference.

articleTitle: Temporal variations of electric fields density in the middle atmosphere
abstract: The analysis of the diurnal variations in the large mesospheric electric fields obtained over different world regions with a new technique for remotely sensing the parameters of the electrically active mesosphere is presented. These variations are shown to have two maxima. A comparison of the results obtained with the Carnegie curve shows common features in the temporal behavior of the mesospheric electric field and the fair weather electric field at ground level.

articleTitle: The microwave power limiter based on pin-diodes for the frequency range of 100–110 GHz in form of waveguide MIC
abstract: The waveguide insert MIC for the 3-mm wavelength range was developed and produced. The device has insertion loss as low as 1 dB in all operating frequency range. 3 dB compression point is obtained with 13 dBm input power.

articleTitle: Effects of interminiband tunnelling on current generation in the semiconductor superlattices
abstract: The effects of interminiband tunnelling of the electrons in semiconductor superlattice on the electric current through this device are studied. It is shown that the change in miniband gap significantly affects both the current-voltage characteristics and high-frequency current oscillations in semiconductor superlattice.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of request routing in content delivery networks with guaranteed quality of service
abstract: The request routing in content delivery networks (CDNs) is traditionally related to choosing the appropriate mirrored server only. At the same time, the need of providing guaranteed quality of service necessitates conversion to solving of request routing on CDN together integrated with traffic routing in transport telecommunication network. The mathematical model that allows obtaining integral optimal solution of both tasks has been offered.

articleTitle: The characteristics of the graded-gap AlGaAs-GaAs-InGaAs Gunn diodes
abstract: The usage of graded-gap semiconductors in the Gunn diodes results in increasing the output power and efficiency of the electromagnetic waves generation. However, the ternary compound InGaAs does not create the optimal distribution profile of binary semiconductor components. This disadvantage can be eliminated in AlGaInAs compound. The paper presents the following results: firstly, the numerical experiments on the generation of oscillations in wide frequency range by means of Gunn diodes based on graded-gap AlGaInAs has been carried out, secondly, the parameters has been optimized and, thirdly, diodes output characteristics has been obtained. The study showed that AlGaInAs graded-gap Gunn diodes outperform the InGaAs and AlGaAs diodes of same type on generation efficiency, output power and cutoff frequency. The results of the study extend the knowledge of the physical processes of carrier transport in complex semiconductor structures and can be useful for the development of new high-speed devices based on graded-gap semiconductor compounds.

articleTitle: Current transport mechanisms in n-CdO/p-InSe photosensitive heterojunctions
abstract: n-CdO/p-InSe photosensitive heterojunctions were fabricated by dc reactive magnetron sputtering of CdO thin film with n-type conductivity onto freshly cleaved p-InSe single-crystal substrates. Temperature dependences of the I-V characteristics of the heterojunctions are studied and current transport mechanisms through the potential barrier at forward and back biases are identified.

articleTitle: Method of increase of fault tolerance of mobile communication systems at the moments of peak load
abstract: The present paper concerns the new method for increase of fault tolerance of mobile communication systems at the moments of peak loads, which at the expense of use of servers of the company in different time zones, will allow increasing efficiency of service of subscribers, to decrease the main server load, and will exclude possibility of refusal in service in connection with a server overload.

articleTitle: Possibilities of increasing the efficiency of modern satellite communication systems
abstract: Development rate of physical layer techniques for satellite communications systems is slower, than for terrestrial wireless systems. This paper considers terrestrial wireless transmission techniques (such as UWB, OFDM, MIMO) as possible means to increase channel rates, system capacity and rational spectrum allocation in satellite communications systems. Various problems that appear during application of these techniques are discussed, and future research topics are proposed.

articleTitle: Experimental research of signal formation dynamics of radiopulse autodyne microwave oscillators
abstract: Description of the test installation for the research of transient phenomena in radiopulse autodyne microwave oscillators is given. The results of experimental research of the process of autodyne response formation are presented as a function of changing of the oscillation amplitude. Common and stabilized by external high-Q resonator 8-mm wavelength range hybrid-integrated autodyne modules “Tigel-08” were used as research objects; the modules are performed on planar two-meza Gunn diodes.

articleTitle: Inherent noise in ultra-wideband heterogeneous telecommunication channels
abstract: The value of the S/N in different parts of a heterogeneous network of fiber optic links with two laser beams, a photodetector, in the millimeter wavelength radio channel to a demodulator in a decoder-detector at the entrance of which S/N ratio of 16.8 dB can be provided, is analyzed. It provides high quality of reception of signals at the respective modulation.

articleTitle: The increase of output power of multebeam klystron of centimeter wavelength range
abstract: The paper presents results of numerical investigations of output double-gap cavity excitation of multibeam klystron of centimeter wavelength range formed by the penultimate and the final one-gap cavities. The possibility of significant increase of output power with rectangular coupling slot changed for П-shaped coupling slot is shown.

articleTitle: Radiation pattern null elimination of the radiosonde antenna
abstract: The design of meteorological radiosonde antenna with Earth-oriented minimum in radiation pattern reduced to −20 dB level is presented. By the development of the antenna in current design for 403 MHz band there was made minimal changes in form of bending one of the antenna arms. Influence of this bend on the characteristics of the antenna is considered.

articleTitle: Data fusion for multifrequency remote sensing systems
abstract: The method of data fusion for thematic radar's signals processing of multifrequency radar remote sensing systems is proposed. The method is based on the analysis of the Hough spectra which is invariant to inversion of radio brightness contrast. Based on the method the image analysis algorithm is developed. The algorithm includes calculation of the characteristic features of each image, the Hough spectrum transform, comparison of the spectral data with a threshold and detection of the same responses. The results of signals processing are presented.

articleTitle: Adaptive playout buffer based on robust Kalman filters
abstract: The algorithm for an adaptive playback buffer, which allows smoothing hops and emissions, is presented. The algorithm uses a robust Kalman filter. The robust filter ignores single delay bursts and rapidly switches to a new delay value when the trend is changed or the level of delays that occur due to a burst of batch activity, the filter allows switching quickly, owing to a certain window of observation allowing making a decision about a spike's type.

articleTitle: Longitudinal-transverse waveguide polarization selectors
abstract: Microwave polarization selectors based on the main square cross-section waveguide and two output channels of the standard cross-sections for orthogonally polarized waves were theoretically studied. One output channel is implemented as a smooth longitudinal junction of the square and rectangular waveguides and another one is formed by the rectangular waveguide connected with a sidewall square waveguide so that the rectangular waveguide broad wall is perpendicular or parallel to the main waveguide axis. It is shown that the optimum of the polarization selector parameters is achieved when the rectangular waveguide broad wall is parallel to the main waveguide axis.

articleTitle: Architecture of wideband variable attenuators
abstract: The features of circuit design method for bandwidth extension of resistive voltage divider of variable attenuators (AT) with parasitic capacitance in the load circuit, are considered. It is shown, that when changing the transmission coefficient of AT over a wide range the conditions of a significant increase of the proposed AT bandwidth are not changed. This feature of the considered circuit is its main advantage in comparison with traditional methods of designing this class of functional units of microwave communication, broadcasting and navigation systems.

articleTitle: Estimation of radial velocity of objects using fractional differentiation of doppler radar signal
abstract: The method for estimation of radial velocity of fast-moving near-Earth objects (asteroids, meteorites) from a Doppler signal, based on calculation of a fractional derivative of order 1/2. Theoretical basis for using fractional differentiation for fast estimation of mean Doppler spectrum frequency in the temporal area without spectral analysis is given. We describe the algorithm structure for real-time estimation; estimation of velocity resolution are performed using the proposed method in X-band. It is shown that the number of operations can be significantly reduced in comparison with similar value under spectral processing.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of mapreduce technology
abstract: Modern technologies which solve the problems of processing of structured and unstructured data of significant scopes (so-called “Big Data”) were comparatively analyzed. This paper presents the conclusions how to choose a specific technology depending on the types of data analysis problems and their characteristics.

articleTitle: The nanobiosensor on the basis of glucose oxydase enzyme
abstract: The present paper concerns a planar topology for a nanoelectronic transducer based on the glucose oxydase enzyme. The technique of implementation of planar nanostructures for a nanoelectronic biosensor based on the methods of electron-beam lithography is developed. The method of the chemical modification of silicon dioxide surface by epoxysilane was developed and the immobilization of the glucose oxydase enzyme on the surface of planar nanostructure for the nanoelectronic transducer through the linker molecules was realized. The registration procedure of the biochemical signals was developed. A change in the functional state of the immobilized ferment of the glucose oxidase enzyme with the presence of glucose in the test solution was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation efficiency of planar n+-n-n+ diode with tunnel boundaries
abstract: The planar n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> diode with tunnel lateral boundaries based on n-type epitaxial film which is grown on a semi-insulating GaAs substrate is considered. It is shown that having two sites with the tunneling characteristics on the lateral border of the planar diode leads to two areas of negative differential conductance on the current-voltage characteristic of the diode and leads to the generation of two zones of the voltage. The influence of the location and extent of the boundaries on the energy and frequency characteristics are shown. The experimental current-voltage curves of the structure are given.

articleTitle: Dependence of CVC of planar Schottky diode on thickness of active regions
abstract: The model of an active region of the Schottky diode on GaAs is presented. The dependences of a direct branch of CVC of a diode and field penetration into a semiconductor on thickness of the active region were studied. It was concluded that a decrease in the thickness shifts the CVC to lower currents due to the increase of resistance and penetration of the barrier field into the substrate.

articleTitle: Graphene, silicene, and forgotten lessons of the surface physics
abstract: Graphene material science only slightly depends on the uniqueness of a regular one-atom- thick planar sheet while is mainly governed by peculiarities of electronic structure of `sp<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-bonded carbon atoms that are densely packed in a honeycomb crystal'.

articleTitle: Threshold signal-to-noise ratio analysis in application for integral-phase difference estimation problem
abstract: Threshold signal-to-noise ratio determination procedure for Cramer-Rao bound is analyzed. The ability of Chapman-Robbins bound implementation for such a procedure is demonstrated. An approach for asymptotic region extension with the possible gain from its utilization is specified.

articleTitle: Coaxial gyroklinotrons on H04 and H08 modes of conical cavities
abstract: Results of optimization of coaxial gyroklinotrons are shown. Results of numerical simulation and optimization of the design of coaxial gyroklinotrons conical cavity testify that they are feasible and promising in terms of increase of power and efficiency of the short-wave gyrotrons.

articleTitle: Multiresonator microstrip antenna with radiators of complex shape
abstract: The multiresonator microstrip antenna with slot radiators of a complex shape was studied. With the help of a combined method of finite elements method the spectral characteristics and current distribution on disk and energy characteristic were investigated. The sizes of structure were optimized and the possibility of matching such radiator structure in frequency domains was shown.

articleTitle: Models and methods of resource management in the adaptive telecommunication networks
abstract: Basing on the analysis, the algorithm of self-organizing base stations network action was proposed and implemented in the simulation model. The simulation results provided the basis for constructing a hardware implementation of adaptive communicational control unit to control communication between the base stations. Results of the research of software and hardware developments have shown their reliable function together in conditions close to real. The installation of the designed adaptive control communication units into the BS is highly recommended, because it will significantly improve the network reliability, performance, and significantly reduce the time required to deploy it.

articleTitle: Application of analytical multifrequency phase method of range measurements for solving radiolocation problems
abstract: The present paper concerns the use of multi-frequency phase method to measure the range of radar. It is shown that the measuring information about the range of targets is retained and can be obtained by appropriate mathematical transformations using the conversion of low-frequency signal with a rectangular envelope of the spectrum to the radio frequency by amplitude modulation techniques, probing targets and then converted back.

articleTitle: Signal generation, contrast and resolution in near-field microwave microscopy
abstract: The analysis of scanning near-field microscope with a microwave resonator measuring probe and the recording system on the basis of the AFC system of a microwave generator with a measuring transmitter as a reference model, is carried out. It is shown that the process of signal generation and the possibility of increasing of sensitivity, contrast and resolution depend on factors that are specific to particular implementations of the microwave microscope.

articleTitle: Data storage based on distributed file systems with data replication
abstract: The present papers concerns the main features of data handling in file systems with data replication of two types: file systems with data handling on server side and file systems with data handling on client side. The advantages and disadvantages were determined, and the sphere of application of each file system was described.

articleTitle: 0–4 GHz GaAs MMIC SPST switch
abstract: In this paper, results of designing microwave monolithic integrated circuit of broadband SPST with chip dimensions of 1.35×0.75×0.1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and providing 1.0 dB conversion loss and 48 dB isolation in 0–4.0 GHz range are represented.

articleTitle: «Visual» design of 2–18 GHz MMIC low noise amplifier
abstract: The «visual» design of 2–18 GHz MMIC low noise amplifier (LNA) based on 0.15 µm GaAs pHEMT technology is presented. The use of software tools for the «visual» design of microwave amplifiers has allowed simplifying and accelerating the design procedure.

articleTitle: On cardinality of quasi-constant weight and constant weight codes
abstract: The cardinality of used quasi-constant weight codes in a system with error detection, in which the constant weight codes have been used for detecting all asymmetric errors, is analyzed in the paper. The analytical expression of the ratio of the cardinality of the set of quasi-constant combinations to the set of constant-weight combinations is obtained, that allows finding the optimal parameters of codewords for given cardinality of the code set and its error detection ability.

articleTitle: Organization of communication channel with nanoobjects
abstract: The analysis of the modern condition of nanonetworks' designs and creation strategy is presented. Two main alternatives of the nanocommunication organization are considered: electromagnetic one in terahertz band on the basis of principles of classical electromagnetic communication, and molecular one demanding involvement of biotechnologies for the realization.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the structure of langmuir-blodgett films of tetraphenylporphin derivatives and mixed-substituted phthalocyanines
abstract: The features of formation of floating layers and Langmuir-Blodgett films of fifteen novel porphin derivatives and six unsymmetrically substituted phthalocyanine derivatives with 3,6-dioctyloxyphthalonitrile and 3,4,5,6-tetrachlorphthalonitrile fragments were investigated. A comparative analysis of the structure of Langmuir-Blodgett films of these compounds was held and the features of influence of their molecular structure on the supramolecular organization were determined.

articleTitle: Theoretical studies of kinetics of photodynamic processes using semiconductor nanomaterials quantum dots as photosensitizers
abstract: The present paper concerns the investigations in photodynamic therapy area. Principal photodynamic processes in photodynamic therapy with use of semiconductors quantum dots were described. In this work the mathematic modeling of the kinetics processes of singlet oxygen generation and recording was carried out by means of the method of chemical traps. Graphs of the time dependence generation of singlet oxygen on the concentration of molecular oxygen were obtained.

articleTitle: A parallel processing system for measuring 3D surface profile using RF spectrogram
abstract: A scanning system was constructed for detecting 3D profile of a whole body using an RF antenna array and a parallel processing unit. The antenna array generated signals whose information indicated reflection from a target object. The signals in the array were produced during rotation and sampled with triggers by a high speed ADC. The sampled data was transferred to a parallel processing unit. Large number of the triggers and the amount of mathematical computation of frequency analysis forms gigabytes of data size. We showed that the parallel processing unit is useful and time-efficient to detect the 3D profile of whole body by millimeter wave imaging.

articleTitle: Combined method of spatial objects localization for use with RFID systems
abstract: The combined method of spatial objects localization for use in RFID systems which is able to estimate RFID tags positions by handling multiple types of measurement information is developed. It is experimentally found that this method excels the zonal method, the nearest neighbors method and the trilateration method by the expected value of the positioning error.

articleTitle: Elimination of abnormally high errors of determining the coordinates of global navigation satellite system receivers
abstract: The approaches that allow to eliminating abnormally high measurement errors in the coordinates of global navigation satellite system receivers by the use of the behavior of the signals for both individual satellites and data signals obtained in solving the navigation problem is discussed. The effectiveness of the proposed methods is evaluated using experimental data, the fluctuations in the coordinate measuring points Kharkov, Poltava, Sumy, and Smela.

articleTitle: Reduction of abnormal error when measuring the carrier phase incursion through digital processing
abstract: Developed and researched is a way to significantly reduce the abnormal error when the measuring the phase difference of the signal received by the mm-range radar sensor or retransmitting meter. The additional digital processing uses the previously not applied arguments such as the number of periods of oscillation in the measuring range and the number of changes in the order of the opening and closing phase intervals.

articleTitle: The two-band antenna
abstract: In this paper we propose a variant of the dual-band antenna based on the principles of fractal self-similarity for the 802.11n standard. The computer experiment with the investigated antenna in the software of FEKO electrodynamic analysis is considered. We propose a unique mathematical algorithm and a program for calculating the most important characteristics of the antenna.

articleTitle: Electron transport pecularities in GaN FET's
abstract: Comparison of electron transport peculiarities of GaN and GaAs transistors has been carried out. It is shown that because of a splash of drift speed its value under a device lock made of GaAs almost doubles the value of drift speed in the transistor on basis of GaN, even at the identical value of mobility of electrons and in spite of much higher values of static speed of electrons in GaN in the strong fields.

articleTitle: Analysis of non-linear distortion of angle-modulated radar signal
abstract: In this report the features of reception of the high information radar image (RI) are considered at use of LFM impulse signal as a sounding signal. At processing of such signals we have an inevitable problem connected with presence of the incompressible residual of the signal function. The level of these incompressible residuals depends not only on the compression algorithm, but in many respects on presence of the distortion and noise in radar system hardware as well. The conducted researches have allowed developing a simple method of estimation for the level of these distortions, and also establishing a connection of these distortions' level with the lowest possible level of side lobes signaling function of the sending signal.

articleTitle: Techniques to reduce energy consumption in sensor networks
abstract: The paper discusses possible ways to reduce energy consumption in wireless sensor networks. Limit power consumption connected with the fact that the sensors are fed by a power source with limited power limit (typically battery). The more unfrequently they will be replaced or recharged, the lower cost their service will have.
