Also, power consumption is an important limitation in the use of sensors with complicated access to them; therefore, the power supply unit can not be replaced or recharged. To solve this problem, we examined five possible options to reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: The processing features of measurement results of radio acoustic sounding systems using the kalman filter
abstract: The optimal linear filtering application in the atmospheric radio acoustic sounding (RAS) systems which are designed to taking the profiles of air temperature is discussed in the report. The optimal linear filter application in RAS systems will reduce a number of repeated soundings which are necessary to achieve the required estimate accuracy. The optimal linear filter application will improve the delivery of vertical profiles of required atmospheric parameters.

articleTitle: Selection of information transmission system architecture for Ukrainian Antarctic Data Center
abstract: Tasks of Ukrainian National Antarctic Data Center development and reasons of information transmission system development are discussed. Two main system architecture variants, their advantages and disadvantages, specifics of the existent project are defined. Basic operating principles for each of the variants, key architectural elements and their main functions are described. On basis of obtained comparison the choice on web-service based system was made.

articleTitle: Experimental study of relativistic millimeterwave magnetron
abstract: Tests of 48-cavity mm-waveband relativistic magnetron (RM) confirm the results of theoretic calculation and 3D simulation. Radiation appears in the frequency range of 36-39 GHz corresponding the induction of p-mode oscillations of the fundamental spatial harmonic. At the same time, there is evidence that in the modes of developed generation the electrons in the interaction area are affected by radio frequency. fields with the amplitude compared to static ones. They sufficiently vary the interaction condition between particles and resonators and shorten the radiation impulse.

articleTitle: Electron drift velocity modulation in mis transistor structure with one-dimensional electron gas
abstract: The effect of the gate voltage on the electron drift velocity in GaAs quantum nanowire transistor structure is studied. Electron transport is simulated by the Monte Carlo method in the electric quantum limit. The possibility of effective drift velocity modulation in the structure by the applied gate bias is shown.

articleTitle: Broadband quadrature couplers for microwave power amplifiers
abstract: The overview of existing constructions of broadband (>octave) quadrature 3-dB power divider\combiners (quadrature hybrids), widely used in the microwave power amplifiers, was presented. The results of experimental and theoretical investigations to improve the microstrip multi-coupled lines quadrature hybrids characteristics were presented. The quadrature hybrids applications in the broadband microwave power amplifiers were discussed.

articleTitle: Designing of 32–40 GHz two-stage MMIC low noise amplifier using automated synthesis software
abstract: The paper considers designing of 32–40 GHz 0.15 µm GaAs pHEMT two-stage MMIC low-noise amplifier (LNA). The software tool Geneamp for the automated synthesis of linear microwave amplifiers is used for the designing. The full development cycle is described from the selection of LNA structure to the creation of MMIC layout. The use of the Geneamp tool has resulted in simpler and faster development of the MMIC LNA.

articleTitle: Space pilot of the nuclear-powered vessels (on the 30th anniversary of the «Kosmos-1500» satellite launch)
abstract: History of the creation of the first national oceanographic radar satellite “Kosmos-1500” is considered.

articleTitle: Research of mechanisms of dispersion in heterostructures with plasma waves at low temperatures
abstract: On the basis of a method of statistical modelling the research of the basic mechanisms of dispersion in semi-conductor heterostructures at low temperatures, and the basic physical process characteristics of charge carriers carrying over in a mode with the plasma waves advent is carried out. Novelty consists in statistical modelling and the self-coordinated decision of Schrödinger equations that allow revealing the basic physical mechanisms defining increase of speed of plasma distribution waves and requirements to a choice of heterostructure electrophysical parameters to increase the sensitivity of semiconductor devices based on them in the terahertz at low temperatures.

articleTitle: Application of the FFT algorithm in the structure of the digital antenna array to improve the signal-noise ratio
abstract: This article discusses the possibility of time accumulation of a signal in the aperture of the digital antenna array using Fourier transform. This approach can increase the signal-to-noise ratio at the output of a digital beamforming.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of critically low supersaturation self-organization at carbon nanofibers formation
abstract: In this paper we present the idea that the basis of all the technologies required for the production of carbon nanofibers are constant over time small relative supersaturation of the deposited vapor. The proof is carried out by the example of arc discharge technology of the first CNT obtaining. The phase plane method shows yield of the system, determining a self consistent change in the growth surface temperature (T), the concentration of ions of the substance (n) and supersaturation (ξ), in a stationary mode at critical low supersaturation.

articleTitle: The transverse resonance technique for analysis of microstrip step discontinuity
abstract: The analysis technique of the classical step discontinuity in a microstrip line by transverse resonance method was proposed. The numerical algorithm is implemented using the approximation of the tangential components of the electromagnetic field at the interface in the form of a series in its eigen waves of complicated waveguide's cross-section. The algorithm was tested on the example of section of microstrip line step discontinuity. The data on the convergence of the algorithm and the comparison of the calculated characteristics with the experimentally measured are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Electrophysical properties of nanosyructured materials used in medicine as implants
abstract: The electrophysical properties of nanostructured materials based on hydroxylapatite and silver nanoparticles were investigated. The loading mass characteristic influence on electrophysical properties in microwave frequency band was shown. The band of efficient interaction is determined.

articleTitle: 5-mm wavelength applicatory aerial simulation
abstract: Properties of 5-mm wavelength applicatory aerial for the biomedical appliances are explored. By means of the program of electromagnetic simulating the aerial design is specified and its output matching with the surface of the explored object is executed. Distributing of the near electromagnetic field is shown and the level of the background formed by the distributed far field sources is estimated.

articleTitle: A doppler direction finder with one rotating antenna
abstract: The result of a Doppler single-channel direction finder's analysis is that the signal processing peculiarities are revealed, the basic equations are obtained. It is shown that finder's operating can be conducted both on the even and odd harmonics, and its amplitude is specified by the delay time line. It is proved that amplification factor and phase characteristic instability of a linear tract does not influence the measurement results.

articleTitle: Use of differential entropy for the analysis of repeated high-precision measurements
abstract: The problems of determination of a minimum necessary number of measurements to ensure the required accuracy on the basis of the analysis of differential entropy are considered. Necessary conditions of a maximum of entropy of the sum of two random variables concentrated on final intervals having identical borders are defined at the required dispersion of their sum.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy logic to improve security network based on Wi-Fi technologies
abstract: The algorithm of work is based on intrusion detection systems in the Wi-Fi network using fuzzy logic. This algorithm permits making a decision about potential security risk, taking into account the different and rapidly changing conditions that intrusion detection systems can not take into account. Such parameters can be analyzed, the amount of transmitted and received data transfer rate, the dynamics of the packet, MAC-addresses of the users and the level of the signal. The proposed algorithm in the analysis of the Wi-Fi network based on fuzzy logic allows making decisions about anomalous network more adequately The use of fuzzy logic makes possible adjusting the solutions depending on changes in network conditions.

articleTitle: Application prospects for aluminum bases in gigahertz devices
abstract: Based on analysis of the microstrip line parameters, arguments for aluminum bases with a dielectric layer of anodic aluminum oxide for gigahertz devices are adduced. Taking into consideration that aluminum is a good structural material, it is concluded that aluminum bases are very promising for microelectronic microwave devices operating at high frequencies and powers.

articleTitle: Investigation of amplitude-frequency characteristics of waveguide photonic crystal consisted of periodically alternating layers implemented as a matrix with a large number of air inclusions
abstract: Numerical simulation and experimental investigation of the amplitude-frequency characteristics of the electromagnetic radiation transmission coefficient in the microwave band, interacting with the photonic crystal consisting of periodically alternating ceramic (Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) layers with a large number of air inclusions, with the presence and absence of the photonic structure periodicity violations, are carried out.

articleTitle: Modeling of distributed workflow for National Antarctic Data Center processes automation
abstract: In this work the problem of the automation of business processes for the organization of collective work in a distributed environment of knowledge portals is under consideration. Primarily, it was done the analysis of work processes of the National Antarctic Data Center (NADC). For selecting of the methodology of its subsequent formal description the comparison of the most popular methodologies designed to describe and implement of workflows was carried out. Then the analysis of the resulting conceptual scheme of NADC data processing with subsequent improvement was held.

articleTitle: The mathematical model of the magnetron type amplifiers analysis taking into account reflected waves and side vibration modes
abstract: The multiwave numerical model of magnetron type amplifiers (amplitrons, stabilitrons, forward-wave and backward-wave amplifiers with drift space) is described. This model allows describing the process of “working” signal amplification and excitation of oscillations side types caused by multiple input and output reflections of high-frequency waves. It is shown that the registration of possible self-excitation of a device allows determining adequately the limits of a region of amplification according to anode current and voltage.

articleTitle: Application of wavelet transformation for accuracy improvement of microwave level measuring device
abstract: Continuous wavelet transformation (CWT) of a signal is an effective tool for analysis of signals containing frequency and temporal localization. Measurement accuracy of a distance, in particular, of a level of a substance in a tank via microwave sensors with frequency-modulated sounding waves depends on measurement accuracy of beat signal parameters and a band of frequency deviation. CWT-based method for processing of a beat signal is presented. Modeling results show that it is characterized by increased measurement accuracy of beat signal parameters and needs narrower band of frequency deviation as compared with spectral analysis-based method.

articleTitle: Negative conductance of diodes on gallium nitride microcathodes
abstract: Small-signal negative conductance of a diode on AlGaN micro-cathode, which results from delay of both processes — electron emission and its transit in a vacuum layer, has been studied theoretically. Its periodic dependence on both of delay angles leads to a multiband structure of diode negative conductance spectrum, when the upper angle of emission delay in the spectrum exceeds the same of a transit delay. Owing to sufficiently great electric field values and electron velocity in vacuum the negative conductance of the diode is in terahertz frequency range. The longer the emission delay time, the lesser its value and diode optimal frequency are.

articleTitle: Features of transitions to the wideband generation mode in laboratory model of low-voltage vircator
abstract: The present work concerns the continuation of experimental investigations of transition from narrowband (single frequency) generation mode to broadband noise generation in the layout of a low-voltage generator with a virtual cathode. An experimental setup and used test equipment are considered. Detailed experimental study of the dynamics of change of time realizations of the signals generated by the laboratory layout when changing selected control parameters is carried out. Carrying out the analysis of the power spectra, the time realizations of output signals, the phase portraits and bifurcation diagrams with changing the selected control parameters showed that the transition from the single-frequency mode to broadband generation occurs through a cascade of period doubling bifurcations and through intermittency.

articleTitle: Neural network with conservative blocks for device designing solutions
abstract: The use of the conservative blocks in the neural network ensembles to increase the stability of obtained models in their further training based on experimental data is proposed. The variants of the conservative block connection in terms of functions performance quality and complexity of creation programs are considered. The expediency of the neural network ensembles using and their further development to improve the quality of the design process are described.

articleTitle: Fast algorithm of iterative equalization for ISI channel
abstract: The fast and numerically stable algorithm for calculation of turbo-equalizer coefficients of successive modem, based on the Levinson-Durbin method and considering both standard specificity of inverted parameter matrix: band type, hermiticity, toeplitz and positive definiteness, and its special correlation with a vector of absolute terms, is proposed. Results of accuracy and numerical stability of algorithm were obtained by modeling.

articleTitle: The history of invention and development of autodyne proximity fuzes
abstract: Historical information regarding invention of the autodyne and further development of autodyne proximity fuzes for the artillery shells is presented. Objective circumstances of proximity fuze invention by the British scientist W.A.S. Butement are given. The role of a famous American physicist M.A. Tuve in the organization of the invention and production of proximity fuzes for artillery shells is shown. The aspects of acquisition and further development of this subject in the Soviet Union are considered.

articleTitle: Device modeling of electron beam bunching in a linear collider
abstract: The present paper concerns an alternative system of beam bunching in a linear collider, based on preliminary cross modulation. The modeling is carried out, and parameters of two alternative bunching systems are compared.

articleTitle: Electrodeposited SnS thin layers on template substrates for solar cells and secondary batteries
abstract: SnSx semiconductor electrodeposition onto nanoordered template substrates produced using electrochemical porous oxidizing of aluminum has been investigated. The two types of template substrates have been investigated: nanoporous alumina and nanoordered aluminum surface after the porous oxide removal. XRD results prove predominantly single-phase polycrystalline SnS formation in the both cases. The results could be used for thin-film solar cells and secondary batteries development.

articleTitle: Techniques of experimental determination spaceborne SAR's through characteristic at the step of ground tests
abstract: The possibility of experimental determination of spaceborne SAR's through characteristic at the stage of ground tests is shown, and the techniques are introduced. A hardware-in-the-loop workbench for reflected signal simulation is developed using which the carrier frequency signals from the radar simulating reflection from the ground surface have been supplied to SAR receiver input considering the transmitter motion law and the survey mode. Spatial and radiometric radar test patterns, as well as point objects have been simulated. The data obtained are used for estimations of SAR spatial resolution, radiometric resolution and dynamic range.

articleTitle: Interaction effects of microstrip resonators, which increases a bandstop of band-pass filters
abstract: The method for expanding the bandstop of band-pass filters containing microstrip stepped-impedance resonators and capacitors is presented. It is based on a zero value of the coefficient of electromagnetic coupling between the resonators in the first parasitic resonant frequency.

articleTitle: Tree dimensional spatial multiplexing methods for wireless communication
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of the multiplexing methods, allowing increasing the technical efficiency of radio resource usage based on the three-dimensional signals spatial separation in a spherical coordinate system. These methods allow creating spatial multichannel communications between certain points (areas) of the space through the radiators and signal processing system of a wireless base station. Three-dimensional spatial selectivity in spatial matched filtration is provided by the physical processes of the focusing and the differentiation signals by their front curvature, and in the spatial correlation signal processing - by orthogonality of spreading sequences, their reusing by a cyclic shift and synchronization, depending on the distance from the base to the mobile station.

articleTitle: On specificities of spherical near-field antenna measurements
abstract: Specificities of the method for determining antenna radiation pattern in spherical near-field measurements are presented for cases when in antenna-object system there is a significant distance between an assumed antenna phase center and a measurement sphere center. The required number of spherical harmonics is justified theoretically and experimentally. Specificities of antenna diagnostic for flat aperture antennas and planar phased arrays are considered in terms of narrow-band and ultra broadband spherical near-field measurements.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection method according to the characteristics of refreshing process
abstract: The method of intrusions detecting in telecommunication systems by analyzing the characteristics of a number of values of innovation process is proposed. The hypothesis notifies that in the absence of anomalous effects of the discrepancy corresponds to the parameters of the Gaussian white noise is considered. As a criterion to determine the correlation residuals and the Gaussian white noise we propose to use the Wilcoxon signed rank test. The reason of a choice of this criterion is also considered.

articleTitle: Use of dipole scattering method for calculation of electromagnetic scattering from non-spherical particles of rain
abstract: The peculiarities of using dipole scattering method for calculation of radar reflectivity from non-spherical rain particles are discussed. As well the choice of raindrop shape model is considered and comparison of different approaches to calculation of electromagnetic scattering is performed. It is shown that use of dipole scattering method is validated when particles diameter does not exceed 3 mm for an ellipsoidal model of particles shape and for model of Pruppacher-Pitter when particle dimension is less than 2.5 mm. Also it was shown that the difference between rigorous and dipole scattering calculations is provided by large drops. From the other hand the probability of large drops in polydisperse medium is quite small, that is why the error between rigorous and dipole scattering calculations is not too much for polydisperse medium and for rain intensity up to 20 mm per hour. Finally, the conclusion about applicability of approximate method of dipole scattering is made for rain of large intensity.

articleTitle: Al-Al2O3-Ni-Cu structures for microwave microstrip lines
abstract: Based on Ni chemical deposition and Cu electrochemical deposition up to 30 µm thick onto large-size Al bases with Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> one-sided dielectric coating obtained by electrochemical anodic process, technological modes for Al-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-Ni-Cu structures formation were developed. Electrophysical parameters for Al-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-Ni-Cu structures were studied and their promising application for microstrip lines of microwave systems passive part was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Russian technological equipment set for high power microwave fet's and circuits based on GaAs and GaN
abstract: Using of SemiTEq equipment for high power microwave FET's and circuits based on GaAs and GaN is shown. Main technological operations are demonstrated: heterostructures growth by MBE, ohmic contacts and gate metallization by electron-beam deposition, annealing of ohmic contacts in RTA system, etching mesa isolation and passivation layers deposition by plasma chemical methods. The basic problems and their solutions are discussed.

articleTitle: Using of linearized approach for crossed-field devices' modeling
abstract: Using of linearized systems describing the crossed-fields devices' operation, taking into account space charge fields, is studied. It allowed simplifying significantly the processes study in crossed-fields devices. It was shown that one of spectrum components coincides with the fundamental mode of magnetron oscillations.

articleTitle: Model example of suboptimal filtration
abstract: The paper considers optimization and research of suboptimal filtering methods of signal processing in the communication channels with complex types of interference in real time. The aim is to obtain mathematical expression that describes the impact of such transformation input influence in order to select authentically useful information from a set of signal and noise. Depending on what data is useful, the following problems should be solved: signal detection, evaluation of parameters for determination of the value of one or more parameters of the useful signal (amplitude, frequency, etc.) as precisely as possible; distinguishing of signals when several input signals can occur and indication of which signals actually present is required; reproduction of waveform, distorted by the influence of noise, into its original form.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon waves on the nanoscale films
abstract: The present paper concerns the analysis of methods for forming waveguides on the surface plasmon (SP) for implementation of the devices controlled by optical signals. The most effective method, a method of two-photon polymerization, is proposed and investigated.

articleTitle: Selective mode excitation at power pulse millimeter waves gyroklystron with the external delayed feedback
abstract: The idea of delayed feedback application was experimentally realized at the gyroklystron. The use of selective delayed feedback for one mode allowed increasing this mode selectivity. The studied scheme could be considered as a perspective source with fast frequency switching.

articleTitle: The first four-electrode designs of radio tubes
abstract: The detailed history of the invention of the first designs of four-electrode radio tubes is presented. It is noted that the first design of such tube was created by a Russian radio technician V.I. Kovalenkov. After it a tube with two control grids was designed by an Italian physicist Quirino Majorana. It is shown that this type of tubes includes a triode designed by an employee of RCA Norman E. Wunderlich, which was produced by Arcturus company.

articleTitle: Phase composition and structure of nanoscaled thermoelectric films on base of CoSb3 skutterudite
abstract: The processes of skutterudite CoSb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> formation in nanoscaled CoSb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>(30 nm) (1.8<x<4.2) films deposited on SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(100 nm)/Si(001) substrate were investigated by methods of physical materials science. After deposition the films are in x-ray amorphous state. Amorphous films crystallization occurs during annealing in temperature range of 140°C–200°C. Phase composition of nanoscaled films corresponds to Co-Sb phase diagram. At annealing higher 400°C Sb sublimation occurs and amount of CoSb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> phase increases. More intensive process of Sb sublimation is observed at annealing of x-ray amorphous films.

articleTitle: Investigation of characteristics and modeling of Ka-band 0.15 µm GaN HEMT on SiC substrate
abstract: A brief description of the design and manufacturing technology of 0.15 um GaN HEMT on SiC with T-shaped gate for the Ka-band is presented. The probe measurements of GaN HEMT with W<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> = 4×100 µm are presented. Based on these measurements the nonlinear model EEHEMT was constructed.

articleTitle: Analysis of load balancing methods for improving of utilization efficiency of hardware resources of distributed systems
abstract: The present paper concerns scalability and elasticity characteristics of distributed systems. To achieve high efficiency of the system the use of dynamic load balancing methods is proposed. The analysis of efficiency of proposed methods and their impact on quality of service of distributed systems is performed.

articleTitle: Electrical properties of photosensitive heterojunctions n-TiN/p-CdTe
abstract: Photosensitive heterojunctions n-TiN/p-CdTe were obtained for the first time. The dominating mechanism of current transport through the heterojunctions was determined under forward biases. The heterojunctions produce open circuit voltage V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">oc</inf> = 0,35 V, short circuit current I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf> = 1,88 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and fill factor FF = 0,51 at illumination 80 mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: The analysis of existing signal preconditioning algorithms for speech recognition
abstract: In this work are described main algorithms steps of signal preconditioning for speech recognition systems. Existing methods are discussed in the paper such as: statistical data collection of speech signals for system learning; input data filtering; frontiers detection of a message information part; and spectral transformation of a speech signal with normalization of frequency specter.

articleTitle: Autodyne characteristics calculation considering internal and external time lags
abstract: The solution of differential equations system of the autodyne is found using the quasi-static higher approximation method for the general case of an arbitrary value of reflected radiation time delay and for the case of the rapid motion of a reflecting point object and inertial characteristics of the oscillator. Formation features of autodyne response were considered taking into account oscillator time lag and its internal parameters. The waveform, DC component and nonlinear harmonic distortion coefficient functions of the distance and the direction of the location object movement are found.

articleTitle: Increasing of energy efficiency of a cognitive radio network
abstract: The technique of cognitive radio network deployment for joint spectrum allocation between GSM and LTE was presented. A new approach to cognitive radio spectrum sensing is designed. We suggest using well localized window functions in order to achieve better energy and spectral efficiency of the network. Simulation results show the advantage of localized signals in terms of signal noise ratio in 8% and 15% for AWGN and Rayleigh channels respectively.

articleTitle: Radiation effects in elements of submicron CMOS integrated circuits with various kinds of isolation
abstract: The results of experimental researches of radiation resistance of element base of 0.35 µm CMOS integrated circuits under influence of Co<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup> gamma-irradiation are submitted. The comparative analysis of influence of various kinds of isolation of CMOS IC' elements (LOCOS and Shallow Trench Isolation — STI) on radiation variation of MOS transistors' parameters is carried out.

articleTitle: Special purpose CMOS VLSI SRAM with capacity of 256K, 1M, and 4M
abstract: The issues of development and production of SOI CMOS VLS SRAM with information capacity of 256K, 1M and 4M, resistant to influence of external factors are considered.

articleTitle: Enhancement of the interaction efficiency in O-type electronical devices with photonic crystal slow-wave systems
abstract: Theoretical investigations of the photonic crystal fiber electrodynamic characteristics for cases of circular and rectangular hollow cores have been carried out. Localized modes with the longitudinal electric field intensity maximum in the center of the waveguides cross-section are found. The possibility of the efficiency enhancement of the sheet electron beams interaction with photonic crystal structures fields due to coupling resistance increase and electron current settling decrease is shown.

articleTitle: Microstrip microwave antenna based on magnetoelectric composite
abstract: The miniature microwave microstrip antenna based on magnetoelectric composite was developed and studied at frequency of 1.3 GHz. The composite based on the nickel-zinc ferrite/barium strontium titanate was used. Theoretical modeling of the antenna is carried out.

articleTitle: Conversion features of the surface waves of distributed radiation sources into the spatial waves in the periodical metal-dielectric structures
abstract: The results of experimental modeling of the open electrodynamic system based on periodical metal-dielectric structures are presented. It allows determining basic physical properties of the radiation energy characteristics of the periodical metal-dielectric structures with the agreed-upon ends and semi-infinite dielectric medium. The quantitative analysis of the influence of the higher harmonics on the main harmonics was carried out. It allows giving practical recommendations concerning use of the systems based on periodical metal-dielectric structures in EHF electronics.

articleTitle: Frequency alteration of microstrip antenna parameters by microelectromechanical method
abstract: The structure of a microstrip antenna with microelectromechanical tuning in a frequency domain is discussed. It is shown that change of physical and geometrical parameters of such structure effects on the field distribution. Frequency dependence of antenna parameters for different dimensions of an air gap between a metal patch and a dielectric substrate is analyzed.

articleTitle: Microwave invisibility by means of circular cloaks
abstract: Microwave invisibility effect, obtained by means of the homogeneous but electrically and magnetically anisotropic multilayered cloak, is demonstrated. Dependence of masking effect versus frequency and viewing angle is analyzed.

articleTitle: Dual-band two-branch-line directional coupler with two reactive elements
abstract: The variant of modification of a two-branch-line directional coupler for operation in two aliquant frequency bands is offered. Unlike the known constructions only two additional reactive elements are used at that. The possibility of two-band operation of branch-line coupler without reactances utilization is investigated. The analytical correlations for the calculation of electrical parameters of such couplers equivalent circuit elements are obtained.

articleTitle: Miniaturized coupled-line directional coupler designed with the use of photoimageable Thick-Film technology
abstract: A quarterwave-long coupled-line single-section directional coupler has been developed using the combination of Phtoimageable Thick-Film technology and Laminate technology in an asymmetric dielectric structure. In order to obtain a significant miniaturization of the directional coupler, a high permittivity thin dielectric film between coupled lines has been used. Such an approach allows achieving compact size of the designed circuit, especially at the lower frequency ranges. The presented approach has been verified by the electromagnetic simulations and measurements of a 3-dB single-section coupled-line directional coupler operating at the center frequency f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> = 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Correction of the observed dynamic spectrums of solar radio emission
abstract: The World network of stations of radio service of the Sun is equipped with the one-type spectrographs CALLISTO for providing of continuous observations of the Sun during 24 hours. However the dynamic spectrums of the same radio burst are different at the stations of the World network. Apparently, spectrums are distorted by the uneven gain of receiving aerials which were not supplied together with a receiver and turned out to be different. The parameters of antenna, made in Laboratory of radio-astronomy of SRI CrAO are described in the article. For correct astrophysical interpretation of the registered information the method of exception of distortions of spectrum, brought by aerial, is developed and used at the station KRIM.

articleTitle: Self-learning grid-diagnostic center of telecommunication systems
abstract: The paper considers the problem of processing and recognition of images of oncological pathology based on the grid system. Some ideas and methods of information-extreme intellectual technology based on maximizing the amount of information are used as algorithms of image processing and recognition. Optimizations of the system of acceptance tolerances with respect to the signs of recognition, the level of selection of standard binary vectors-implementations of images were performed to construct the optimal decision rules of the learning algorithm. The influence of optimizing the brightness characteristics of the images on the accuracy of the recognition has been investigated.

articleTitle: A technique for optimizing construction of Ka-band power GaN/AlGaN HEMTs
abstract: A new technique for optimizing the construction of power HEMTs (selection of unit channel width d and the number of sections N, etc.) is proposed and experimentally investigated. It consists in measuring (or simulating) microwave characteristics of the set of passive transistor structures with different values of d and N. Passive structures include all the metal elements of the HEMT, but does not contain the active layer. The approach facilitates the optimization of the HEMT construction due to a simpler and faster fabrication of the test transistor structures. Good RF properties of Ka-band power 0.25 µm GaN / AlGaN HEMTs on SiC substrate are shown to have been achieved with d = 80−100 µm and N = 2−4.

articleTitle: Multifunction monolithic GaAs pin-diode core chip for x-band aesa T/R modules
abstract: The creating possibility of monolithic GaAs pin-diode core chip is shown. The results of development of X-band monolithic GaAs pin-diode core chip including 5 bit attenuator, 6 bit true time delay and SPDT switch are presented.

articleTitle: The influence of the coefficient of nonparabolicity on the distribution of the scattering angles in GaAs
abstract: The paper states that when determining the scattering angle for interaction of electrons with acoustic phonons by deformation potential the coefficient of nonparabolicity shall be taken into account only for charge carriers in г valley. Also the analysis of distribution of scattering angles of polar scattering on LO-phonons and scattering on ionized impurities has been conducted.

articleTitle: Monte-Carlo simulation of diodes with a cathode static domain
abstract: Diodes, where the static domain is formed under certain conditions in a cathode, are considered. Impact ionization can occur in cathode static domain at high voltages. The occurrence of impact ionization leads to the avalanche-transit effects and creates noise generation. The analysis was performed using Monte Carlo simulation. The advantages of a metal cathode over n <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> cathode to achieve breakdown voltages at which the noise generation takes place, are shown. The calculations are compared with experiment for the GaAs diodes.

articleTitle: The epitaxial heterostructure GaN/AlGaN design effect on the device characteristics of power Ka-band HEMT
abstract: Research of a Ka-band HEMT was conducted. HEMT's were manufactured with GaN/AlGaN heterostructures grown by MOCVD on sapphire substrates. A field-plate gate length and width was 0.15 µm and 400 µm correspondingly. A gate was placed between a drain and a source. Source contacts are connected to each other with double airbridges. It was shown that using of capsule layers i-GaN leads to ohmic contact resistivity reduction. It is shown that using of superlattice in a buffer layer leads to heteroepitaxial layers quality rise as well as leakage current reduction. This effect is achieved by buffer layer electron repulsion with negative charge localized at superlattice. Observed difference static IV caused by a capsule layer and superlattice presence leads to increasing f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf> from 25 till 35 GHz and f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> from 68 till 80 GHz.

articleTitle: The analys of cyberattacks against the information and telecommunication systems
abstract: At the present stage of our society development many of the traditional resources of the human progress gradually lose their original meaning. To replace them a new resource comes, the only product not diminishing, but growing with time, is information. Nowadays information becomes the main resource of scientific-technical and socio-economic development of the world community. The more and faster the quality information is implemented into the national economics and special applications, the higher the standard of life, as well as economic, defence and political potential of the country is.

articleTitle: Methods of signal formation and conversion in a hybrid radio over fiber network
abstract: Calculation methods of the signal formation parameters at the central station and of selective conversion in a mobile terminal receiver of the vehicle moving at speed of 200-300 km per hour are described. This solution provides high-rate services (up to 12 Mbit per second) for subscribers moving on the highway or high-speed railway using a hybrid radio over fiber network. Objective of research: calculation methods development of the signal formation and conversion parameters. A signal is a set of services in the form of OFDM-symbols, the total bandwidth of which is much higher than 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Natural acoustic-electromagnetic radiation of the seismoactive area
abstract: The paper considers prerequisites of the study of the acoustic-electromagnetic radiation of the lithosphere caused by elastic stresses of the lithosphere and resulting practical considerations regarding the use of this phenomenon in diagnostics of the lithosphere. That briefly discusses the results of a field experiment to investigate the correlation between acoustic and electromagnetic radiation of the lithosphere. It has been found that the most powerful manifestation of acoustic emission is observed in the results of registration of electromagnetic radiation with the use of the quadrupole antenna.

articleTitle: Measurements of parameters of multi-parameter generalized immitance convertors
abstract: The main operating parameters of the multi-parameter GIC were justified, the method for measuring their radio parameters were developed. Those methods provide stability of measuring device. The experimental device was developed. It provides the measurement of the parameters with relative error less than 5%.

articleTitle: Improving performance of detection and resolution of incoherent pulse radar systems
abstract: The method to ensure the coherence of radar signal processing in the application of incoherent sources of probing signals, is proposed. It is shown that with increasing instability of a microwave oscillator the gain in resolution of the system is increased by the use of additional matching of a receiver with probe complex of envelope signals. It is shown that the use of additional adaptive signal processing algorithms between periods sensing allows preparing radar portraits regardless of the system coherence.

articleTitle: Spectral characteristics and surface morphology of thin films of the isoquinoline-1-carboxylate europium with sodium and tris-(8-oxyquinoline) aluminum with inclusions of gold nanoparticles
abstract: The influence of gold nanoparticles featuring plasmon resonance on formation of thin films and luminescence spectrum of a highly effective organic phosphor isoquinoline-1-carboxylate europium with sodium and tris-(8-oxyquinoline) aluminum has been investigated.

articleTitle: PRediction of self-similar time series containing polynomial trends
abstract: The analysis of prediction methods for time series that contain deterministic and stochastic trends is done. The method to extract a deterministic trend at presence of correlated noise is considered. Estimations for prediction accuracy depending on a prediction step for different algorithms are obtained by modeling.

articleTitle: The source of radiometric noise illumination
abstract: The source of radiometric illumination is shown. It is a noise source which provides the level of noise power at the measure of 70 dB/kT<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub> in operation frequency range 90 - 98 GHz. The increase of the functional possibilities of the noise generator is obtained by the amplitude modulation while formation of the noise oscillation spectrum output. The pulse ratio is determined within the range of 100Hz - 1kHz and the pulse duration can be determined within the range of 100 ns - 1 ms.

articleTitle: Method for improving performance of charging and accounting system in telecommunication networks
abstract: The method of increasing performance of billing systems at a critical state due to the introduction of subscriber's risk threshold L, which allows making decision dynamically to charge users in the on-line or off-line mode. This reduces the billing system load to the required level.

articleTitle: Active-passive sensing of clouds for reconstruction of water content profile
abstract: The paper considers signal processing algorithm for reconstruction of integral water content and water content profile in a cloud. Based on numerical simulation it was shown that curve of brightness temperature of clouds versus its integral water content does not depend on the type of water content profile or cloud thickness. Results of integral water content and water content profile experimental measurements obtained by weather radar MRL-1 and 3-cm radiometer are also presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of multilayer nanostructured TiN/MoN coatings with different thicknesses of monolayers and their formation using C-PVD
abstract: Multilayer coatings based on TiN/MoN with different monolayers thickness have been obtained by using C-PVD method. XRD, SEM, EDX, HRTEM and AFM analyzes of coatings have been carried out. Specific relationship between the layers thicknesses, substrate potential, the annealing process, physical and mechanical properties of samples have been revealed.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of steady state in strongly coupled semiconductor superlattice
abstract: We analytically study stability of a steady state mode of charge transport in a model of strongly coupled semiconductor superlattice (SL), described in the framework of semiclassical approximation. Using a set of small perturbations of the steady state we found the value of the voltage applied to the SL, for which one of the perturbations starts to demonstrate a positive increment of growth, thus manifesting the loss of the steady state stability. We expand our analysis for the case when the steady state is already unstable and the current oscillations take place. It is shown, that despite the appearance of new unstable perturbations, the frequency of current oscillations remained close to the first perturbation frequency.

articleTitle: Graded-gap Gunn diodes on the base of InBn and GaBn
abstract: Physical phenomena of the transfer electron effect in Gunn diodes based on the InBN and GaBN graded gap semiconductors. InBN and GaBN diodes output power at the different maintenance of BN was determined. Optimum distribution of the BN binary components is found in the diode. It is shown that graded gap Gunn diodes InBN and GaBN excels InN and GaN in efficiency of generation and output power and graded gap AlInN and AlGaN diodes.

articleTitle: Resource allocation and load management considering the assessed quality of the provided service and the use of agent technologies
abstract: An approach to the resources allocation considering the assessed quality of the provided telecommunication services is proposed. The advantages of using the agent approach in the IT infrastructure management systems of the telecommunications services providers are described. The possibility of the usage of agents not only for monitoring and management, but also for simulating the variants of resource allocation, their evaluation and selection of the optimal variant is shown.

articleTitle: Plastic landmine detection by the slow wave structure-based sensor
abstract: A sensor for detecting plastic explosives placed in the ground is presented in this paper. The detection effect is based on the intensive radiation from the section of a slow-wave structure at slowing down less than slowing of the light in the medium, i.e. in the soil at the place of possible laying of the mines. High effectiveness and small dimensions in comparison to the wavelength in free space and possibility of monitoring at a wide frequency band define its significant advantages in comparison to another devices for detecting explosives.

articleTitle: Acousto-optical analyzers of microwave broadband spectrum
abstract: This paper presents an acousto-optical analog microwave spectrometer (AOS) with a serial-type acousto-optical unevenness (AO) interaction of less than 3 dB in the frequency range 500 MHz to 1750 MHz central frequency. As an acousto-optic modulator AO processor is used with the effective generation of bulk acoustic modes with the surface of the lithium niobate crystal YZ- cut by an optimally apodized interdigital transducer (IDT), calculated with the diffraction divergence.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic properties of different modifications of flat spiral antennas
abstract: On the basis of the method of integral equations for current distribution in thin conductors, a comparative estimation of radiation characteristics of spiral antennas (such as a symmetric two-arm spiral antenna, a spiral antenna with a single passive arm, a single-arm spiral antenna) is carried out. It was shown, that for considered antennas the difference in directivity, axial ratio, radiation pattern is insignificant for a wide frequency range.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence of noise on the quality of shadow tomogram reconstruction via preliminary projection filtering
abstract: The problem of image reconstruction in the shadow tomography is discussed, the process of shadow tomogram obtaining is described, the main sources of noise are considered, evaluating characteristics of the noise signals are presented, the scanning process with taking into account of the noise is simulated, the comparison of the image reconstructed without noise, and the image reconstructed with the presence of noise are presented, it is established that the preliminary projection filtering method is effective for projections with noise.

articleTitle: Adaptive correction algorithm for radar-tracking images
abstract: The high-speed adaptive algorithm of the correction of radar-tracking images of the Earth surface is submitted. The algorithm based on the principle of extraction of the information on phase mistakes directly from a signal is fixed. The algorithm is designed for the correction of errors on travelling speed, acceleration and acceleration change speed. The estimation of support function is under construction proceeding from statistically authentic estimations of distribution of amplitudes of a Doppler signal spectrum. The choice of two-step-by-step recurrent procedure is caused by the necessity of the compromise between speed of convergence and volume of the calculations, falling one iteration. As practice has shown, application of such algorithm allows to raise amplitude of the response from reflectors on a surface up to 3 dB and to increase SAR resolution.

articleTitle: Passive acoustoelectronic components and converters of physical values based on them
abstract: An overview of the current state of acousto-electronic components is presented. Acoustoelectronic components and transducers of physical quantities on their basis developed and produced by JSC “Avangard” are considered, and their prospects are estimated. Sensors and monitoring systems based on acoustoelectronic sensors, and radio frequency identification tags on the passive surface acoustic waves are considered.

articleTitle: Transient processes in the switching-modulation converter designed on the p-i-n diodes that work in the dynamic switch mode
abstract: Studies have been conducted of the transition processes within dynamic switching of the p-i-n diodes. In this mode the transient processes originate that leads to amplitude modulation of the carrier wave of the microwave signal. There was derived an equation that describes output signals of the switching-modulation converter. These processes should be under consideration when systems that based on switching-modulation converter are designed.

articleTitle: Investigations of the response of the midlatitude lower ionosphere to meteor showers
abstract: Experimental data show quasi-periodic changes in the relative amplitudes A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</inf> and A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> of the ordinary and extraordinary components respectively of the partially reflected wave, apparently due to the passage of infrasonic waves during the periods of maximum inflow of meteoric dust particles into the lower ionospheric plasma. An occasional increase in the electron density by more than (50…100)% compared with a quiet-time reference values over an interval of minutes to tens of minutes is also established to occur in the nighttime midlatitude ionospheric D-region above 80-km altitudes. This might be due to charging and dynamics of the dust particles.

articleTitle: Organization of heterogeneous weakly-coupled information of knowledge portals
abstract: The report presents the approach to the organization of heterogeneous weakly-coupled information by the means of specialized Internet-portal development. The portal conceptual model is proposed and its components such as: a knowledge representation model, a business processes model, a method of dynamic knowledge generation and a metamodel of calculation tasks are described.

articleTitle: Application of BPMN and EPC graphical notations for multi agent simulation of business processes
abstract: The task of the BPMN and EPC graphical notations application for business processes description is presented in the paper. The problem of elements conformity of simulation multi agent model of resources conversion process and graphical notations was solved. Selected graphical notations are supposed to be realized in the simulation system. Improvement directions of a visual model designer of simulation systems for mixed processes modeling (that consist of technological, logistic and business process elements) were determined.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband GaAs SPST MMIC
abstract: MMIC SPST on GaAs diodes for the bandwidth of 0.4–40 GHz with losses less than 1.5 dB and more than 50dB isolation is described.

articleTitle: 300 GHz gyrotron at the second harmonic of cyclotron frequency
abstract: The article describes the design of a millimeter wave gyrotron at the second harmonic gyrofrequency. The gyrotron operates in the mode TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">06</inf>, with efficiency of 27%, the pinch factor q = 1.3, accelerating voltage is 20 kV, current is 5.2 A and output power is 28 kW at operating frequency 300 GHz.

articleTitle: Influence of deposition and annealing parameters on phase-elemental composition of high entropy alloys nitrides (Ti-Zr-Hf-V-Nb)N
abstract: Using SEM (with EDS), RBS, XRD and μ-PIXE, the influence of deposition parameters changes of high entropy alloys nitrides, and following thermal annealing of them, on phase and elemental composition of (Ti-Zr-Hf-V-Nb)N coatings was investigated. Stability of atoms crystalline lattice of the coating, redistribution of elements after annealing, and changes (relaxation) of the internal microstrain was discovered.

articleTitle: Electrically controllable microwave phase shifters based on capacitive effect of the transistor structure with negative resistance
abstract: New schematic decisions of analog electrically controllable microwave transmission phase shifters have been proposed. The possibility to extend the range of the microwave signal phase change due to the use of the capacitive effect of the transistor structure with negative resistance has been shown experimentally. The developed microwave phase shifters are characterized by a small error of a phase shift and a low insertion loss level.

articleTitle: “Pressing effect” in near-field microwave diagnostics of biological tissues
abstract: The negative influences of “pressing effect” of a test probe pressed to the surface of an object under study on results of the near-field microwave diagnostics of biological tissues are researched and an effective method allowing reducing them through the appropriate choice of all probing capacities properties is proposed.

articleTitle: Method of extraction for parameters of electronic calibrators for microwave vector network analyzers based on a combination of ultra wideband reflectometry and simulation
abstract: The results of developing the method of extraction parameters of electronic calibrators for microwave vector networks analyzers are given. The method is based on obtaining experimental reflectograms by using a super-wideband reflectometer and comparing these reflectograms with results of modeling impulse characteristics of an electronic calibrator (ECal). Before carrying out extraction of elements parameters the divergence of experimental and calculated frequency dependences of the transfer coefficient module of ECal was 3 dB. Realization of the method of extraction parameters allowed reducing the divergence of frequency response from experimental up to 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Features of chaotic condition degree measurement of response signals
abstract: The method of reliable estimation of randomness degree of “similar” stochastic signals, the essence of which is to register during the measurements of the effect of correlation dependence of a response signal (RS) randomness degree of a nonlinear scatterer (NS) from the power level of a sounding signal (SS), is proposed. It is shown that with the change of time sampling of sensed RS the spread of experimentally obtained values of appropriate randomness index is occurred, the change of dynamic features of semiconductor NS with the variation of SS power level indicates it.

articleTitle: Two-mode millimeter wave gyrotron
abstract: The possibilities of improving the efficiency of a millimeter-wave gyrotron with multimode interaction fields of whispering gallery waves in a relativistic helical electron beam are discussed. It is shown that a two-mode gyrotron compared with single-mode allows increasing the efficiency from 40 to 45%.

articleTitle: Tunable cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna: Designs and parameters
abstract: This work presents a method of tuning a cylindrical dielectric resonant antenna, which has a wide range of adjustment of the resonance frequency and low loss. The basis of the proposed method is electro-mechanical alteration of the composite cylindrical dielectric resonator with piezoelectric actuators or micro-electromechanical (MEMS) systems. Two types of antenna's structure were investigated: excited by coaxial feed and waveguide. The basic antenna parameters, and also analysis of dependencies of the normalized wave number versus the relative position of components of DR, influence of the dielectric permittivity of the resonator on the adjustment of the resonance frequency, antenna's gain and radiation pattern are presented.

articleTitle: Reflections detection with an unknown initial phase when using the random sounding signals
abstract: The detector structure of radar reflections at distribution of radio waves, both in ordinary linear and in dispersion mediums when using the stochastic sounding radio-frequency signals is obtained. The analysis is carried out both for mono-, and multi-position radar systems, when reflected and reference signals are coherent, as well as with partial or complete violation of this coherence.

articleTitle: Creation of the most feasible estimation of the integral difference of phases in the reference phase method
abstract: The present paper concerns the creation of the most feasible estimation of the integral difference of phases in the reference (minimum-)phase method. The integral phase maximum likelihood estimation procedure is analyzed for the minimum-phase method. The behavior of estimation bias and its deviation for a case of various true values of an integrated difference of phases, the relations signal/noise, and the volume of statistical sampling, are analyzed.

articleTitle: Use of organic moisture-holding components as the basis of microwave-range shielding structures
abstract: Frequency dependences of shielding characteristic of samples of designs on the basis of composites with organic hydrophilic components in the range (8…12) GHz are presented. It is shown that composites on the basis of moisture containing wood shaving lead to electromagnetic wave weakening of about 20 dB with possibility of going up to higher than 40 dB, the reflection coefficient being no greater than −6 dB with possibility to going down to −14 dB.

articleTitle: High local scanning modification of semiconductors and dielectrics
abstract: The present paper concerns the implementation principles for high local scanning UHF heating of semiconductors and dielectrics with the purpose of their modification in various microtechnologies, including microelectronic technologies. Numerical investigations of spatiotemporal temperature distribution in the object under near-field UHF high local probe with coaxial aperture have been carried out. Basic quantitative dependencies of the above distribution upon electrophysical parameters of semiconductor object and UHF probe structural element have been determined.

articleTitle: X-band image-rejection mixer based on GaAs quasi-vertical schottky diodes
abstract: Results of development the MMIC mixer have been presented. The mixer chip with dimensions 1.8×1.2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> has been made. The IC provides conversion loss less than 8.0 dB and image-reject more than 20 dB within 8–12 GHz frequency range.

IEEE Keywords: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

articleTitle: Broadband GaAs monolithic switch SP4T in a surface mount package
abstract: The development of SP4T switch on GaAs pin-diodes for the bandwidth of 0.4–8 GHz with losses less than 2 dB and more than 35 dB isolation in 6×6×1.3 mm sintered package for surface mount package has been presented.

articleTitle: Optimization of low-voltage gyrotrons parameters
abstract: Some issues important for operation of gyrotrons driven by low-voltage electron beams are analyzed. An emphasis is made on the efficiency of low-voltage gyrotron operation at the fundamental and higher cyclotron harmonics. These efficiencies calculated with the account for ohmic losses were, first, determined in the framework of the generalized gyrotron theory based on the coldcavity approximation. Then, more accurate, self-consistent calculations for the fundamental and second harmonic low-voltage sub-THz gyrotron designs were carried out. Results of these calculations are presented and discussed. It is shown that operation of the fundamental and second harmonic gyrotrons with noticeable efficiencies is possible even at voltages as low as 5–10 kV.

articleTitle: Influence of electron energy uncertainty on electron drift velocity in GaAs quantum nanowire
abstract: The dependencies of electron drift velocity in GaAs quantum nanowire on various physical and topological parameters characterizing the nanowire are calculated by means of a direct numerical solution of the Boltzmann transport equation both taking into account the electron energy uncertainty and not. The degree of influence of the parameters values on the electron drift velocity is ascertained.

articleTitle: Development of the microwave nanoelectronics: From the solution of design, technology and training problems to development of the first professional standards
abstract: The main results of development of nanoelectronics microwave in Tomsk are presented. Development of the private and state partnership, role of university researches, the scientific and educational center “Nanotechnologies” in industry development is considered. The brief overview of development of the industrial enterprises and their interaction with universities is given. It is reported about the first results of creation of professional standards in the field of design and production of microwave nanoheterostructural monolithic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: “Visual” design technique for networks matching of two complex impedances
abstract: The new “visual” technique is presented for designing networks matching two complex impedances in a wide frequency band. The technique allows providing control over matching network (MN) structure and elements. As an example, the “visual” design of the band-pass MN is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Development of interactive voice response models based on IP-PBX Asterisk
abstract: The present paper concerns a model of interactive voice response (IVR) developed for the Institute of Telecommunication Systems NTUU “KPI” for the purpose of providing information about the Institute for university entrants. The created model is based on IP-PBX Asterisk, which is a new generation technology of telecommunications. This model demonstrates all abilities of the flexibility of IP-telephony based on Asterisk, its rationality in comparison with other hardware PBX.

articleTitle: Architecture construction of frequency synthesizer and features modeling VCO
abstract: This paper presents the basic techniques in the construction of microwave synthesizers of the frequencies used in communication systems. The paper discusses the details of modeling of the VCO in NI Multisim software. Simulation was carried out to display visually VCO output characteristics.

articleTitle: Cu2ZnSnSe4 films for solar cells absorbing layers
abstract: CZTSe films obtained by co-evaporating of compounds components (Cu, Zn, Sn, и Se) with using Knudsen cell were investigated by electron microscopy and X-ray diffractometry methods in order to optimize the structural parameters. The analysis of X-ray diffraction showed that CZTSe films have practically monophase tetragonal crystal structure and growth texture of [211]. The lattice period of the material varies in the range of a = (0.56640−0.56867) nm, c = (1.13466−1.13776) nm. Obtained films can be used as highly absorbent layers of thin film solar cells.

articleTitle: Polarization resonator structures of frequency selection of mm and submm waves
abstract: Polarization resonator structures of the band-elimination filtering and of the bandpass filtering and also of diplexing are presented. Advantages of the polarization resonator structures of frequency selection are shown. Ways of realization of structures in MM and sub-MM wavelength ranges are proposed.

articleTitle: Electrodeless lamps based on the resonant irregular microwave structures
abstract: Investigations of irregular resonant structures at the highest of high-Q oscillation modes are conducted. The possibility of achieving the electric fields is sufficient for the formation of sulfur-containing light-emitting plasma in the environment with power microwave pumping not exceeding 10 watts is shown. The feature of these structures is the ability to adapt their configuration simultaneously by providing directional light emission.

articleTitle: Interpolation method of introducing differential corrections into measurements of coordinate and pseudoranges in global navigation systems
abstract: The interpolation method of introducing differential correction into coordinate and pseudo-range measurements is proposed. The advantage of the interpolation method in comparison with the standard method of differential correction is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Factor analysis of image features used for automatic analysis of echocardiography results
abstract: The possibility of reduction of 43-dimensional feature space to three-dimensional factor space is shown on the basis of factor analysis of information features calculated from the frames of ultrasound images of the heart. The obtained result indicates the possibility of classifying of image pixels based on three information features included in one of the selected factors.

articleTitle: Growth in performance and reliability of ahead automatic activation of the beacon for the purpose of aircraft position coordinates transmission
abstract: Within the framework of carrying out the instructions of the President of Russian Federation and developing the 2nd generation Cospas-Sarsat System, it is necessary to increase the reliability of the automatic activation during the aviation accidents and to decrease the time before the first burst which should contain the aircraft position coordinates. Under the auspices of leading experimental- design departments specializing in distress radio beacons and leading experimental-design departments of aircraft industry, some researches which make it possible to develop the experimental software-hardware complex based on the serially produced articles for the performance of a number of bench tests have been carried out.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillator's spectral observation with a radio astronomy receiver
abstract: The technique of microwave oscillator's spectral observation in frequency band from 3 to 120 GHz is described. The main instrument is 3mm receiver for radio astronomy observation. Some spectra of PLL oscillators for 5GHz and 38 GHz are presented.

articleTitle: The compensation method of the bandwidth enhancement of the parallel ADC with the differential input
abstract: This paper presents the methods of the response speed increase of the parallel ADC's with the differential input that allow reducing of the parasitic capacitances effect of the active and passive components in the analog sections, and also optimizing the amplitude frequency response irregularity.

articleTitle: Method of calculation rectangular shielded waveguides with arbitrary anisotropic filling
abstract: Proposed is a method of calculating the exact electrodynamics waveguides with arbitrary anisotropic filling, in which the tensor quantity can be both dielectric and magnetic permeability. The peculiarity of the method is that the very set of Maxwell equations is taken as a zero element of the functional space.

articleTitle: The approach for selection of a routing metric in special-purpose wireless networks under the influence of radio-electronic investigation
abstract: The present paper concerns the approach for selection of a routing metric in special-purpose wireless networks under the influence of radio-electronic investigation (REI). In this approach the routing metric considers both the quality of service (QoS) requirements and security requirements from REI. The index of information security risk of the route is added in the metric calculation function. This index depends on the information security risk of the network routing elements. The ways of index calculation are proposed.

articleTitle: The 3-mm wave mobile spectroradiometer for the remote viewing of mesospheric ozone and carbon monoxide
abstract: A high-sensitivity mobile spectroradiometer for observations of mesospheric ozone O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and carbon monoxide CO is developed. The performance of the spectroradiometer and results of observations of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and CO emission lines at frequencies 110.836 and 115.271 GHz, respectively, are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis and use of antarctic data for developing of the National Antarctic scientific center portal
abstract: The present paper concerns the reasons and precondition of the National Antarctic scientific portal creation. It describes the steps of the portal development and reports of Antarctic researches. Descriptions of the structure and the architecture of web service, that sends data from the portal to other resources, are given. The given architectures are compared and the optimum one is selected.

articleTitle: Method of the transformed images compression on basis of transformant bit planes coding
abstract: The present paper concerns the grounds of binary description of transformant compression technology within the framework of the non-weight position coding of unidimensional lengths sequences of binary areas series. Possibilities are shown in relation to reduction of volume of transformant presentation as a result of exposure of spatial limitations on the sequences of series lengths of binary elements. Forming of terms of the effective use of the non-weight position coding is expounded for processing of arrays of series lengths of binary elements of transformant binary description.

articleTitle: Radiation frequency control method for technological gyrotron
abstract: A novel method of gyrotron frequency stabilization is proposed. An external low-power high-stable oscillator and a phase lock system are used for stabilization. The control element is a low-inductance solenoid located in the resonator region of a gyrotron.

articleTitle: Diodes on gallium arsenide nanostructure
abstract: The dependence of impedance of a diode on AlGaAs/GaAs nanostructure with tunnel injection of electrons through AlGaAs single potential barrier and their transit in GaAs drift layer vs. parameters of transit and barrier layers is investigated in a framework of small-signal theory. It has been shown that a negative conductance band of the diodes with injection delay time from three to nine tenth of a picosecond is in a submillimeter range. The dependence of a value and frequency of negative conductance maximum vs. diode parameters has been found.

articleTitle: The study of three assemblies of mixers with subharmonical pumping on coplanar transmission line
abstract: This article summarizes the different manufacturing technologies of integrated circuits, the possibilities of usage of two main types of transmission lines are considered, i.e. microstrip and coplanar, to perform the mixing in the range of 60 and 120 GHz. For the first time three assemblies of mixers: 30–60 GHz, 30–120 GHz, 60–120 GHz, have been offered within one version of the structure.

articleTitle: The constructive implementation of digitally controlled radar covers based on microstrip reflectarrays
abstract: The paper presents results of theoretical and experimental investigations of capabilities and peculiarities of the application of digital reflective antenna arrays as components (modules) for the creation of smart radioelectronic covers intended for operation in the microwave range.

articleTitle: Two-stage technology of ZnO nanosystems formation
abstract: The semiconductor ZnO is a highly promising material for use in various detectors, solar cells, piezoelectric transducers, light emitters, transparent electronics etc. It is known that physical properties and scope are determined by morphology and size of the structural elements of the material. Consequently, development of technology that allows creating nanoporous metal oxide structures with a highly-developed surface area is currently of great interest. Therefore, the aim was to develop a technology for production of porous nano-zinc oxide, and determining relationship between morphology of the layers and their optical, physical, electrical, and sensory properties for possible applications in optoelectronics and sensor electronics.

articleTitle: Beyond-the-horizon detection of the surface objects using the “Burevestnik ZG” radar
abstract: One of the problems in the area of radio wave propagation and radar design is creation of radar facilities for navigation in the regions of the World Ocean with intensive shipping. Ukrainian radio-electronic industry has a large experience in development of different purpose radar systems, one of that is the radar <;Burevestnik>. This radar is used to control and observe marine surface situation on the naval border check-points of Ukraine. In the paper it is suggested to modernize radar <;Burevestnik-1> for navigation and beyond-the-horizon detection of the surface objects. The possibilities of <;Burevestnik ZG> effective application for beyond-the-horizon detection of the surface objects in the districts of the World Ocean are estimated. To illustrate the latter the centimeter radio waves attenuation factor database, created in IRE NASU on the base of experimental results, is used. Statistical distribution functions of the <;Burevestnik ZG> radar coverage range in the districts of the World Ocean are determined. Comparison with experimental data for stationary navigation radars <;Don>, <;Nayada> and <;MRL-5> is conducted. Finally a conclusion, that radar <;Burevestnik ZG> can be used in the regions of the World Ocean for navigation and beyond-the-horizon detection of the surface objects, is made.

articleTitle: Analysis of positioning using UWB systems
abstract: This paper explores the possibility to implement the indoor positioning using the Ultra wide Band systems. The ultrawide band technique allow a high precision ranging due to its fine resolution in order to resolve multipath fading and presence of lower frequencies in the base band in order to penetrate walls.

articleTitle: Diagnostic capabilities of radiothermometry in urological diseases
abstract: Capabilities of applying microwave radiothermometry in medicine, in urology in particular, are shown. By means of RT-01 NATALKA radiothermometer more than a hundred patients were examined, master values of perineal region core temperature were determined, thermogram analysis of healthy people of different age groups as well as from patients with pathologies was carried out.

articleTitle: The phase radio system for coordinate determination of a radiation source with a phase manipulation signal located in the fresnel region
abstract: The unused possibilities for signal coordinate determination of a radiation source (RS) with phase m?nipulation (PM) in the existing mobile communication systems are shown. The usage of sparse antenna arrays and a radiation source location in the Fresnel region of the antenna array for this case are examined. The approaches and scheme realizations of phase radio systems for coordinate determination (PRCD) for estimating bearing angle, tilt angle for plane and spherical phase fronts and distance estimation to RS with PM when electromagnetic wave phase front curvature is present, are proposed.

articleTitle: Resonant phenomena in a periodic array of slits filled with a metamaterial
abstract: The TM-wave diffraction problem by a periodic perfectly conducting grating is solved for the single-mode approximation of the slit field. The physical reason of the observed effects is discussed for the case when slits are filled with a conventional positive index magnetodielectric. The obtained solution allows analyzing the periodic arrays of slits filled with an arbitrary metamaterial.

articleTitle: Calculation of the grooved waveguide
