abstract: An approximate method of calculating the characteristics of the grooved waveguide is offered, using analysis of coupled waveguides of different sections. The equation for determining the propagation constant of the grooved waveguide shows the wavelength of the cross-sectional geometry.

articleTitle: AODV and DSDV routing protocols energy efficiency comparison
abstract: The method of simulating modeling in a ns2 network simulator compares efficiency of two routing protocols (AODV and DSDV) in wireless mobile cellular networks by means of criterion of maximizing operating time at a limited resource of power supplies of knots of a network.

articleTitle: Band structure resonance characteristics of microwave photonic crystals with disturbed periodicity at a little number of included elements
abstract: The increase of bandgap's width and the decrease of passbands' size due to the decrease of a number of resonances forming the passband at the appearance of impurity mode resonance in the photonic crystal's bandgap depending on the number of its layers, has been theoretically shown and experimentally determined.

articleTitle: Environmentally safe multistatic marine radar system for sea border protection
abstract: A description is given of an environmentally safe multistatic X- and Ka-band marine radar system (RS) intended to guard the sea territorial waters of Ukraine. An alternative variant of using a multistatic radar built on basis of the floating active radio beacons (installed beyond the boundaries of radio horizon) and a single receiving station. The receiving station is located on a coastal line and its operational function is to pick up sequentially some information from each radio buoy, process received signals in a special-purpose computer and demonstrate the observation data on the state of the protected sea area from multiple positions.

articleTitle: The ontology model of Ukrainian national centre of Antarctic Data
abstract: Conceptual model for building a portal of the National Antarctic Data Centre is presented. Information base of the portal is presented like ontology, with the help of which the ordering and structuring of information is made, as well as an effective search and navigation of information space of Antarctic knowledge portal is organized.

articleTitle: Development of compression algorithm for video flow based on processing of predicted frames
abstract: The present paper concerns the basic algorithm for processing of video sequences by way of the example of P-type predicted frames. The article shows the major disadvantages of this method and proposes an alternative algorithm using polyadic encoding, which will increase the compression ratio, taking into account the requirements for it in time of processing, the bit rate and quality of video data recovery.

articleTitle: The high-speed amplitude modulator of mm-wave range with cascade included GaAs p-i-n-diodes in the transmission line
abstract: Results of development of broadband modulators for controlling amplitude of signals in a range of 26–70 GHz on GaAs diodes which are cascade included in an asymmetrical transmission stripline are presented. Direct losses are 1.2–1.5 dB. Switching time is no more than 10 nanoseconds. The important requirement for the development of amplitude modulators is a wide band of operating frequencies, small direct loss in an open state and high level of loss (±40 dB) in a closed one, and also providing short time of key element transition from high impedance state into low impedance one. Application of package diodes in mm-wave range provides operating band 10–15% [1]. In this work it is considered the possibility of realizing broadband modulators with operating band ∼40% using p-i-n-diodes cascade included in asymmetrical strip line, which are carried out on pieces of waveguides of regular cross section. The developed modulators on GaAs p-i-n-diodes could find application in instrumentation when creating panoramic measuring instruments of VSWR and attenuation, and also in microwave devices for protection of receiving channels against influence of nonsynchronous interference.

articleTitle: Theoretical evaluation of BER performance for noise communications
abstract: Theoretical investigation of UWB wireless noise communications with code spectral modulation of continuous noise carriers in the transmitter and double spectral processing in the receiver is accomplished. On the base of statistical signal processing it is produced the probability error estimation for wireless data transmission in a link with additive Gaussian white noise. BER performance of UWB noise communications are calculated depending on signal/noise ratio for various values of the signal gain.

articleTitle: The description of the active nanoparticles kinetics within the bounds of canonical representation
abstract: The behavior of active nanoparticles was investigated within the framework of the canonical Hamiltonian system. On the basis of the phase portraits for the case of the harmonic oscillator the kinetics of the system was studied under the transformation of the internal energy of the particle into the mechanical energy of motion.

articleTitle: Investigation of the spectral and energy characteristics of bunches of space charge in turbulent electron beams
abstract: The investigation of the spectral and energy characteristics of bunches of a space charge in the turbulent electron beams is presented. The results of numerical modeling and experimental studies carried out on laboratory layout generator are proposed. It is shown that for the formation of an electron beam with a multirate structure a pronounced fundamentally important aspect is the presence of the initial spread of electrons velocity in the electron gun, in particular with grid structures. There is an intensive form of dense bunches of space charges in electron beams with a strong multi-rate structure. Spatial and temporal oscillations of bunches of the space charge are a source of broadband noise fluctuations.

articleTitle: Study of nanoscale films TI-O-N BY nuclear-physical methods of analysis before and after thermal annealing
abstract: Using a variety of complementary methods of element structural analysis, such as a slow positron bunch (SPB), Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) and x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), ∼ 5-nm nanoscale Ti-O-N film), obtained by Cathodic-Arc-Vapor-Deposition method at the synthesis temperature (250…300) °C, were studied. This article concerns elemental composition profiles of the defect and the depth of the atoms on the surface of the coating in a 3D view and survey, obtained by comparing the X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).

articleTitle: Optimization of characteristics of gunn oscillator
abstract: The paper presents the results of experimental studies of the characteristics (such as power, frequency) of the Gunn oscillator depending on the position of the diode in the waveguide cavity. The comparison of dependences of the central frequency of the cavity vs. the diameter of the radiator obtained theoretically and experimentally is provided. Some recommendations for optimization of Gunn diode oscillators can be established based on the results of this work.

articleTitle: The system of micro-wave integrated TV/radio information of multiservice radio access “UMDS”
abstract: Presented the results of the studies of the problem of the provision of multi-service radio access to information resources on the territory of Ukraine, including the rural areas, mountain regions and regions with a low level of income. A description of the designed on the basis of radio technologies MITRIS microwave TV/radio information system of multiservice radio access UMDS with the use of the frequency bands of 11.7–12.5 per GHz and 12.75–13.25 GHz direct channels and with the use of reverse channel in ranges frequency 5.15–5.85 GHz; 12.75–13.25 GHz. Shown the possibility of the introduction of the developed system UMDS as one of the promising directions in the creation of technical bases for development of information society and sustainable development of sphere of telecommunications and Informatization in Ukraine.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable photodetector of erythemal and pigmentation radiation
abstract: Based on the ZnCdS/GaP heterosystem UV photodetector with electrically tunable spectral sensitivity has been developed. At low bias voltages (∼20 V) the spectral response is near to erythemal effect spectrum. When bias increases up to 60 V and above the photodetector is able to capture the greatest impact area of pigmentation radiation. The detector can be used to control irradiance level of the Sun and other sources of UV radiation in the wavelength range of 250–450 nm.

articleTitle: «Lybid« spacecraft technical capabilities analysis
abstract: The results of the “Lybid” spacecraft technical capabilities analysis are presented with indication of possible modulation- coding types. The services that can be provided by “Lybid” spacecraft are presented with the description of the main factors that influence the quality of service and the parameters that can be manipulated in order to optimize the system.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of MIMO system with nonlinear effects
abstract: An electromagnetic mathematical model for MIMO systems is developed, considering the whole MIMO system as an antenna with nonlinear elements. The model presented enables taking into account various nonlinear effects, including those induced by reconfigurable antennas in MIMO transceivers.

articleTitle: Sensor for two-resonator refractometer
abstract: The differential model of a refractometer based on two-resonators with “whispering gallery” modes (CDR) is designed and validated. It is shown that the accuracy of the measurement of frequency difference should be 10 Hz, thus determination accuracy of the refractivity of air is provided at the level of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> N -units.

articleTitle: Measurement of the shielded anechoic chamber characteristics
abstract: Precision of measurements carried out in the shielded anechoic chamber substantially depends on a shielding level and anechoic factor. Shielding measurement procedure in a frequency range for limited volume of chamber environments is proposed. The anechoic factor is determined according to the used radar absorbing coating characteristics.

articleTitle: Hierarchical algorithms of key point search on the object contours of images
abstract: Two ways of construction of hierarchical algorithms of key points search based on 2 operations on object set: operations of algorithm union and algorithm consensus (corresponds to operation of set intersection) has been given. It was showed that union of algorithms is generally more informative while consensus gives the possibility to build the most stable to different external factors key point sets.

articleTitle: MPLS network model
abstract: A service model of the voice traffic in multiprotocol label switching (MPLS) networks has been proposed and investigated. The study concerns the service model, MPLS networks, and a formal description of processes occurring in them, development of mathematical models, reflecting the main properties of the investigated object, it allows calculating the values in the required operating modes. The developed model of functioning MPLS network is provided as a multi-phase, multi-channel, open-loop system. Proposed analytical expressions describe the process of mutual influence when servicing requests various directions of communication, and may be used to determine parameters of quality of service and bandwidth channels of MPLS network, and compare them with normalized values and assess the compliance of the specified standards.

articleTitle: Heuristic method of adaptive routing for solving dynamic RWA
abstract: The problem of dynamic routing and wavelength assignment is relevant in the control of WDM network when servicing requests for the installation of short-term connections and transfer of excess traffic. The proposed solution method is heuristic and is an improvement over the previously known method by taking into account the influence of four-wave mixing and use of the new metric for finding the potential for the use of routes. This reduces the probability of blocking calls when the connections have an average of 13%.

articleTitle: Real-time optimization of GSM communication channel choosing on the basis of analytic hierarchy process
abstract: The approach of selecting a channel of GSM-communication for remote control and monitoring in real time mode on the basis of multi-criteria decision making method (the analytic hierarchy process) is presented. The criteria of link selection in industrial systems are considered. An example of real application of this approach is given. Convolution formula specified local priorities of the analytic hierarchy process to solve possible incorrectness of the classical method is obtained.

articleTitle: The phase synchronization device of mobile and immobile generators for the magnetoplan's navigation system
abstract: Availability of the phase-ranging method for precision positioning of ground high-speed transport is discussed. Directed communication and topologically related to route structure cables are used in the phase-timing system. The technique of determining the short-and long-term mutual synchronization of generators is presented.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of indoor propagation of ultra wideband chaotic signals
abstract: Experimental study of indoor propagation of ultra wideband (UWB) chaotic signals has revealed practically no interference in multipath environment. This phenomenon is shown to be due to rapidly decreasing autocorrelation function, which is typical for chaotic signals, which makes signals at the receiver input coming via different paths uncorrelated, and be summed up by their powers. Comparative analysis of UWB signals has been performed with a view of observing this phenomenon.

articleTitle: Experimental study of controlled gas discharge
abstract: Experimental facility for studying the characteristics of controlled gas discharge at the energy level of 10–100 mJ together with measurement and processing algorithm for determining the dynamics and amount of the net spark gap impedance are considered.

articleTitle: Methodological basis of science and technics historical investigations
abstract: Recently the special attention is paid to the systems approach. When carrying out historical-scientific and historicaltechnical study the problems of reconstruction of events, the facts, material carriers, etc, take place very often. The science and technics history as a reconstruction process of real development of scientific knowledge and technical creativity has to consider changes and transformations of existing theoretical generalizations.

articleTitle: Simulation of the ribbon-shaped electron beam of the diode electron-optical system of microwave devices
abstract: Complex numerical simulation of the ribbon-shaped electron beam, which is formed by the diode electron gun with magnetic field focusing was conducted. Analysis of the beam formation dynamics in longitudinal and cross-section as well as the results of calculation of the separate electron trajectories agree with experimental data, obtained previously by using of the method of electron beam diagnostics by means of transient radiation.

articleTitle: The attenuator with uniform frequency response on the basis of the strip diaphragm with a dielectric
abstract: We have revealed, that the strip diaphragm between two identical dielectric layers was capable to of being not only an efficient matched load of waveguide. If there are dielectric losses, then such a module can become a nonreflective radiowave absorber or an adjustable attenuator. We have carried out optimizations and constructive changes to improve the band properties of such devices.

articleTitle: The design of microwave phased array antenna elements with increased operating speed and decreased power consumption
abstract: The results of microwave reflection-type phased array antenna integrated elements design are shown. The problems of microwave reflection-type phased array antenna elements with intrawaveguide system realization are considered. The results of radiation elements investigation are presented. Summary of the electrical and constructive characteristics is given.

articleTitle: Mitigation of range ambiguity when using radar signals with high pulse-repetition frequency
abstract: Effectiveness analysis of range ambiguity mitigation methods with usage of multiple pulse-repetition intervals is performed. The method of range ambiguity mitigation, when using different pairs of pulse-repetition intervals on even and odd scans, is proposed. Theoretical basis of the method is presented. The procedure of hypotheses formation of unambiguous range values with subsequent choice of the most probable hypotheses is presented.

articleTitle: A miniature stripline filter with a wide stop band
abstract: The design of a miniature three-conductor stripline resonator on a double-layer dielectric substrate is suggested. Based on the proposed resonator diminutive bandpass filters with a wide stop band and high rejection is developed. To demonstrate characteristics of the proposed design the prototype of the fourth-order bandpass filter is fabricated. A stop band cutoff frequency of the filter at the level of −100 dB is more than 10 times higher than the central frequency of passband.

articleTitle: Band-pass ceramic microwave filters with broad stop bands
abstract: The results of the calculation of a small-sized ceramic microwave band-pass filter with a wide stop band are presented. It is shown that the expansion of stop band width (more than 4÷5f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>) of a filter based on the coupled coaxial resonators is possible by increasing the shortening capacitance, which leads to the filter type: a chain of quasi-stationary direct-coupled resonators.

articleTitle: The design of the modem of modern tropospheric radio relay stations
abstract: Requirements for the modem of modern tropospheric radio relay communication lines are formulated on the basis of the methodology of the energy calculation. The developed methodological approaches have allowed designing the modem making possible to ensure the effective compensation of losses due to multipath, significantly increase throughput of the system, provide control of the receiving-transmitting unit operation and remote full-featured testing of the status of all units and communication systems in general.

articleTitle: Antenna-feeder devices in the development of OJSC “NIIEM”, Istra (Moscow region)
abstract: In this paper an overview of the development of antenna-feeder devices laboratory antenna feeders of “NIIEM” is presented. A number of developed types of on-board antennas of spacecrafts and feeder path elements is presented.

articleTitle: Parametric spatial signal processing in uncertain conditions
abstract: In the paper a short overview of negative impacts which can give rise to huge reduction of signal-of-interest power to noise plus interference power ratio is provided. Those factors also can decrease accuracy of DOA-estimation. There are many parametric methods to tackle these problems. The authors developed a couple of algorithms which compensates ambiguities in analog receivers and make nulls of direction pattern of antenna array wider.

articleTitle: Planning and optimization of networks 4G
abstract: The basic tasks and methods of selection of optimal design options when planning for mobile networks based on LTE technology, are presented.

articleTitle: Measurement of p-n junction-to-case thermal resistance in impatt diodes
abstract: We present a method for measurement of p-n junction temperature as well as static and pulse thermal resistance in IMPATT diodes. The method is tested using 8 mm-wave IMPATT diodes with an integrated heat sink made at the State Enterprise Research Institute “Orion” (Kyiv).

articleTitle: Optimization of the parallel hybrid fluid model of high-speed data flows in the major Internet channels
abstract: The possibility of efficient using GPU computations for parallel hybrid fluid model to accelerate the simulation of Internet traffic is experimentally demonstrated. The main factors affecting the performance of parallel computing on graphics processors are identified.

articleTitle: Method of the analysis of power consumption dependence from service of a number of processes
abstract: The method of the analysis of power consumption depending on processes which are served in the portable device is offered. The method allows revealing the indicators removed from a system of monitoring on which energy consumption strongly depends. The method is designed to determine an extent of influence of each of measured parameters on the general power consumption.

articleTitle: Microwave meter of aqueous suspension concentration
abstract: One of the problems of using microwave techniques to measure the concentration of aqueous suspensions in the wood-pulp and paper industry is that results of concentration measurements depend on the temperature and conductivity of the suspension. The designed microwave concentration meter takes into account temperature changes of the suspension in the range of 5 to 70°C and conductivity values from 0 to 15 mS/cm, and provides a possibility to measure the concentration ranging from 1% to 5% with the accuracy of ± 0.04% (absolute).

articleTitle: Influence of an external magnetic field on microwave power of the ultrarelativistic vircator
abstract: The study of the output power of electromagnetic radiation of a relativistic electron beam (REB) with a virtual cathode in the presence of external magnetic field has been carried out. The typical dependencies of the output microwave power of the vircator versus external magnetic field have been analyzed by means of 3D electromagnetic simulation. It has been shown that power of the vircator demonstrates several maxima with external magnetic field growth. The characteristic features of the power behavior are determined by the conditions of the virtual cathode formation in the presence of the external transversal magnetic field and the REB self-magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Multifrequency measurements of the radiation patterns of antennas
abstract: The use of automated complex for multifrequency measuring of the radiation patterns of the small directed antennas, feeders and modules Active Phased Array built on the basis of the positioning system WiNRADiO WR-ARP-ELAZ-100 and programs “Tamic Obl” is shown. The measurement is carried out for the radiation pattern of a given set of frequencies in the selected frequency range. The automated system allows providing the required accuracy of antenna parameters at lower cost than existing on the market the complexes in 9 times.

articleTitle: Using green's function method for the leaky-wave antenna analysis based on a dielectric partially-filled rectangular waveguide with transverse slots
abstract: A leaky-wave antenna based on a rectangular waveguide with partially dielectric filling and transverse slots, is studied. The Green's function method for dispersion equations and antenna radiation analysis is suggested. A protective dielectric cover on the screen with slots is taken into account. The complex propagation constant is defined by matching of a magnetic field in slots. Two different waves' expansions for Green's functions with TE, TM and LE, LM are considered.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillation phase stabilization effect of nanosecond Gunn oscilators
abstract: The standard deviation σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> of a phase delay with respect to a fixed voltage level during the voltage pulse rise time in a nanosecond pulsed Gunn oscillator was measured. A method of measuring the pulse current of the Gunn diode inside the resonator chamber was proposed. The standard deviation σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">δt</inf> of a phase difference for two Gunn oscillators being electrodynamically decoupled and connected in parallel to a common power supply was measured.

articleTitle: Regularities of formation of silver/porous silicon nanostructures for Surface Enhanced Raman Scattering
abstract: This paper presents results of investigation of formation regularities of nanostructures produced at different modes of immersion deposition onto porous silicon for their use as active substrates in Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering (SERS). Porous silicon samples were formed by anodization of monocrystalline n+-Si in water-alcohol solution of fluorhydric acid HF. It has been found that the intensity of SERS signal depends significantly on the morphology of nanostructured silver films which in turn depends on the silver salt concentration in the solution for immersion deposition and by the immersion period. Optimal modes of silver depositing have been revealed which made it possible to produce SERS-active substrates allowing reaching the detection limit for copper porphyrin to be 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup> M of analyte.

articleTitle: Progress in development of waveguide high-pass filter (HPF). Broadening of HPF applications
abstract: We developed the design of the waveguide high-pass filter (HPF) [1] with a smaller length as compared with known designs of HPF [2] and with tuning cutoff frequency of the order of 50% of the operating band of the standard rectangular waveguide. Traditionally, HPF is used for rough frequency measurement of microwave pulses [3–5]. In the report we present iterative method that allows showing the possibility of measuring the detailed amplitude and phase spectra of microwave pulses by high-pass filter. The method is based on the iterative processing of the original signal envelope and the envelopes of signals passed through a high-pass filter with a set of different cutoff frequencies. The method has been tested by numerical simulation on test signals and showed good accuracy of reconstruction of the amplitude and phase spectra.

articleTitle: Development of microstrip bandpass filters with triangular patch resonators
abstract: Band-pass 5th order filters implemented as a triangular patch resonators series have been investigated. Optimization of the relative position of the resonators and the distance between them has been carried out to obtain the filter design with required frequency characteristics. The influence of the feed lines shape and coupled area length to the filter's frequency response has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Electrodiffusion of ions through the membrane with low intensity microwave influence
abstract: There are results of numerical modeling of binary electrolyte electrodiffusion through the ion-exchange membrane with self-consistent ion field calculation and external low energy influence. Physical laws and behaviour features of asymmetrical binary electrolyte at scleronomous conditions with a fixed value of a voltage drop in Nernst delta-layer are analyzed.

articleTitle: Development of the VHF digital radiostation with discrete frequency tuning
abstract: This paper describes a principle of creation of the VHF digital radio station on the basis of modern element base. The device is simple to produce and adjust and has low power consumption, small weight and sizes because of using integrated chips. Application of a TRC101 chip allows ensuring high noise immunity of a transmitted signal because of using frequency manipulation, noiseproof coding of transmitted signals and capability to operate in the mode with frequency hopping spread spectrum.

articleTitle: Disk resonators for investigation of low-loss media characteristics in the millimeter waveband
abstract: Results of experimental investigation of characteristics of the disk resonator formed by the thin-wall dielectric cuvette filled with liquid and amorphous materials with small losses of electromagnetic energy in the millimeter waveband are presented. Study of extra-high frequency properties of some liquids including pure and used technical oils by means of such resonator is carried out. For the first time by example of paraffin wax and stearin the possibility of application of the resonator for investigation of dielectric parameters of media at their transition from one state of matter in another at temperature change is shown.

articleTitle: Band acoustoelectronic microwave filters on the basis of SMR BAW resonators
abstract: The technology of formation of band microwave ladder-type filters on the basis of thin-film acoustoelectronic resonators with the Bragg reflector (SMR BAW) on nitride of aluminum, operating in (2–10) GHz frequency range is presented. The experimental sample of the three-tier filter on the central frequency of 5 GHz with a pass-band of (2–5)% is developed and results of measurements of its parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Multifrequency microwave monitoring of water diffusion in soil
abstract: Possibilities of the monitoring the water diffusion into soil by data of multifrequency microwave measurements of the dynamics of complex amplitudes of the signal scattered by such an inhomogeneous medium are considered. Measurements have been carried out at 801 frequencies in the range (1.7...7) GHz using the vector network analyzer Agilent E5071B. In the experiment, the initial homogeneous over transversal co-ordinates near-surface water content distribution was prepared by uniformly spilled water, so following diffusion was described by the dynamics of the depth profile of the volume water content in soil. Transformation of multifrequency data to the complex-valued pseudopulse makes it possible to obtain a quality visualization of diffusion. The inverse problem of the retrieval of the depth profile evolution of the water content in soil has been solved by these data using the reduction of the problem to a one-dimensional Fredholm integral equation of the 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> kind with the kernel function that has been obtained experimentally.

articleTitle: LSP bandwidth dynamic management algorithms
abstract: Modified algorithms for automatic capacity adjustment TE-LSP tunnel are proposed. These algorithms are based on existing Autobandwidth algorithm. The dependence of share traffic loss upon algorithm timing parameters is analyzed. Modeling is performed and recommendations as to algorithms usage are made on the basis of timing parameters for the different Hurst's coefficient traffics.

articleTitle: Ortho-unitary transformations for color image processing
abstract: A novel algebraic approach based on triplet 3D algebras for color image processing and recognition is under development. A family of discrete color-valued fast transformations has been presented to be used for color image processing.

articleTitle: Fem modeling of thin film resonator based on (0001) AlN
abstract: The paper describes a method of numerical modeling of thin-film single-frequency resonator on bulk acoustic waves (FBAR) using the finite element method (FEM), presents results and their comparison with the results obtained by using the Nowotny-Benes theory.

articleTitle: Effect of adaptation's taking into account for determination of color rendering index of white LED's
abstract: The results of calculations of color rendering index of light-emitting devices using white LED's with and without adaptive effect are analyzed. The comparison of the results of the calculation of some specific color LED options for the existing method is carried out. The rendering index values are highly of criticality on respect to a small change in the spectrum of the LED's.

articleTitle: Method of parallel processing of digital flow in the broadband access systems
abstract: The aim is to improve the quality of operation of telecommunications systems by reducing the time of forming the frame digital flow by the network management controller, through the development of tools for the design of telecommunication systems. This paper provides a method of scheduling the performance of atomic operations frame of the digital stream. The method uses a structure of the genotype with fewer parameters making possible to increase efficiency and enhance quality with respect to time criterion. Solved is the problem of scheduling operations in the digital flow frame formation unit of the software of radio network management controller considering the following conditions: the schedule to be built shall have a maximal efficient use of all available hardware resources; when the system is being used in real time, search time of the optimal schedule is limited.

articleTitle: Algorithms of data forecasting in industrial telecommunication system of environment control
abstract: The algorithms for processing and forecasting data on the levels of polluting emissions produced in the course of industrial environmental control are described. The different options for systems of neural network forecasting and recovery results of time series data preprocessing based on the wavelet transform are presented.

articleTitle: Promising solid state sources of ultra wideband microwave signals for new IEEE standards
abstract: Development of the effective sources of ultra wideband signals is stimulated by much interest to ultra wideband communication technologies. Chaotic oscillators can play the role of such sources. In the report, structure of the microwave solid state ring oscillator capable to generate ultra wideband microwave chaotic signal with uniform power spectral density, is proposed. Its evolution from distributed elements implementation to CMOS IC realization is demonstrated in simulation and experimentally. Dynamics of the basic oscillation modes are investigated, the fact of the chaotic generation is shown. It is demonstrated that such oscillators can be used in different wireless communication applications as a compact device for UWB microwave chaotic signal generation with uniform power spectral density in frequency bandwidth up to 5 GHz and integrated output power reaches about 20 mW.

articleTitle: Research of methods of combining reception and transmission frequencies in the transistor superregenerative transceivers of radiosondes
abstract: Methods of combining reception and transmission frequency in superregenerative transceivers (SRT) of aerological radiosondes of atmosphere radio sounding radar-tracking systems are considered.

articleTitle: Influence of parameters of emission modulation on the nonlinear dynamics of the virtual cathode oscillator
abstract: The numerical simulation of the low-voltage vircator with the controlled emission from the thermionic cathode has been carried out. The external signal effects on the beam in the formation region leading to the emission modulation are found. The strong influence of the modulation parameters on the oscillations characteristics of the beam with virtual cathode has been discovered. It has been shown that tuning of the modulation frequency to the harmonic of the virtual cathode free oscillations leads so the considerable power increase of the higher harmonics of the virtual cathode free oscillations frequency in the output spectrum.

articleTitle: Transport of intense charged-particle beams in a coaxial magnetic undulator
abstract: The system of dynamics equations describing the propagation of high-current charged-particle beam in a coaxial drift-tube in combined longitudinal homogeneous (guide) and periodic magnetostatic undulator fields is formulated. The self-electric field and both longitudinal and azimuthal components of self-magnetic field of charged-particle beam averaged over the undulator period are obtained.

articleTitle: Orotron with DRPS and DFSCM using two electron beams
abstract: The experimental study of output power increase in 2 mm orotron with double-row periodic structure and with focusing double-focus spherocylindrical mirror (DFSCM) of open resonator by means of introducing an additional electron beam was performed. This additional plane electron beam was situated over second row of periodic structure used in experiment. In experiment it was shown that increasing power is can only on unit frequency for r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>/λ ≤1.5.

articleTitle: Formation of low-temperature oxide inside of straight-through pores in silicon substrates for 3-D metal interconnections
abstract: Silicon substrates with ordered pores, which pass through the whole sample, have been fabricated for 3-D metal interconnections. The inter-pore distance can be ranged from 4 to 10 µm. The thickness of silicon substrate can reach up to 200–300 µm. The ordered porous structures are obtained by means of photolithographic process. Electrochemical anodization has been used for oxide formation inside of straight-through pores in silicon substrates. The oxide thickness can reach 120 nm.

articleTitle: Simulation of resonant-tunneling and single-electron devices with the use of modified models
abstract: The influence of potential barriers width deviation on IV-characteristics of RTD is investigated using the suggested modified two-band combined model. A multi-island structure was simulated using a modified model in case of account of spatial quantization on islands of single-electron devices. It enables one to achieve a satisfactory agreement of simulation results with experimental data.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the output spectrum for discrete microwave phase shifter in the dynamic mode
abstract: The output spectrum of the discrete microwave phase shifter in a continuous phase shift was investigated. The advantages of this device compared with phase shifters on frequency dividers are shown.

articleTitle: Temperature diagnostics of biological objects in pathological conditions
abstract: The mathematical model of temperature distribution of biological objects for the special case of the Laplace equation in homogeneous environments is shown. The temperature profile is presented as a function of one coordinate. The analytical dependence of temperature profile is largely determined by the function of the heat source. The possibility of using of temperature diagnostics for finding pathological processes in biological tissues is also shown.

articleTitle: Application of multiagent simulation for logistic scheduling
abstract: The present paper concerns the trends of evolution of multi agent intelligent scheduling, decision support systems and simulation systems for task of logistic scheduling. The comparison of two perspective approaches of intelligent scheduling (the Needs-and-Means Networks and the model of multi agent resources conversion process) and related information technologies (MAGENTA and BPsim) are presented.

articleTitle: Thermal treatment of the heat-insulating material with the use of microwave radiation
abstract: The experimental research results of the basalt cardboard thermal treatment with the microwave electromagnetic energy application are presented in the article. The weight change diagrams of the basalt cardboard samples during the drying process are given. Changes in the temperature behaviour are analyzed on the surface and inside the samples depending on coupling medium. An advice on the drying process parameters improvement is given.

articleTitle: Creation of composite light transformation material with the pre-set spectrum of the luminescence for manufacturing cultural plants illumination modules
abstract: The publication considers creation process of the composite light transformation material based on the nano- and micro-particles of organic and nonorganic phosphors with luminescence spectrum as close as possible to the absorption spectrum of plants. Longevity of luminescence a new composite and possibility of its application in manufacturing plants illumination industrial systems are studied.

articleTitle: Quasistatic method of the analysis of intradynamic characteristics of autodyne systems
abstract: A method of quasi-static calculation of autodyne response which takes into account high-order members of the expansion of the general solution is proposed. The error estimation of intradynamic characteristic calculation of autodynes using the known and the proposed methods is given. The comparative calculations of autodyne characteristics are performed.

articleTitle: The model of diffraction of the electromagnetic fields on spatially-heterogeneous film structures in a waveguide
abstract: Based on a method of finite differences in a time domain (FDTD) the numerical model of diffraction of electromagnetic fields on the spatial and non-uniform film structures in a wave guide is developed. When carrying out spatial sampling the adaptive spatial grid was used. The task of diffraction is solved for a near and far zone that allowed defining both electromagnetic fields on film structure, and ratios between capacities.

articleTitle: Synchronization of klystron oscillator with harmonic and noise signals
abstract: The present paper presents results of experimental studies of synchronization effect in a klystron autogenerator with a delayed feedback by introducing of an additive sum of noise and harmonic signals in a feedback chain. It is shown that this effect causes noticeable increasing of SNR ratio on klystron output.

articleTitle: Improvement of parametres electrically small antennas of a microwave range
abstract: The paper presents the results of VSWR and efficiency factor studies of the so-called “electrically small” antennas (ESA) with the dimensions considerably smaller than resonance sizes with the corresponding inductive loads (IL) which have been connected directly to the radiating wire of the antenna.

articleTitle: Electron optics of IOT
abstract: We carried out a computer simulation of electron-optical systems of multibeam TV IOT with a single-stage depressed collector and single-beam magnetless mini-IOT (having electrostatic focusing). To enhance beam structure and current throughput the control grids with additional radial jumpers are proposed. The amount of radial and circular jumpers was optimized. Experimental testing of these electron guns showed good agreement with results of simulation.

articleTitle: Patch slot antenna with circular polarization for the high-accuracy positioning using GNSS signals
abstract: A new method to improve technical characteristics of the patch slot leaky-wave antennas with the circular polarization has been described. It has been shown that the use of additional slots with electrical length shorter than the electrical length of the main slots of the radiator, the former being implemented as concentric arcs around the phase center of the antenna, allows improving the frequency, phase and angular characteristics of the antennas. In particular, the ellipticity decreases and the cross-polarization increases, improving the given antenna resistance to multipath interference which is one of the main sources of the high-accuracy positioning errors. Based on this method multi-band patch slot leaky-wave antennas with the right-hand circular polarization for the high-accuracy positioning using the signals of the Global navigation satellite systems, including GLONASS, GPS and GALILEO, have been designed.

articleTitle: Simulation of the signal reflected from the target distributed by angular coordinate
abstract: The simulator based on a system of two antennas can provide simulation of targets distributed at the angular range not exceeding the direction-finder resolution. Quantitative assessment of the impact of various factors of unbalanced simulator antenna system upon the accuracy of the simulation, when radar uses monopulse direct-finding and Doppler beam sharpening, is carried out.

articleTitle: Aluminum oxide based nanostructures for impedance nanoelectronics
abstract: Fluorescence and Raman light scattering in dielectric nanostructures based on aluminum oxide have been investigated. Ultrathin metal-containing conducting Langmuir - Blodgett films deposited on the anodic alumina shield the action of strong electrical fields and minimize electrical capacity of a near-electrode Helmholtz double electrically charged layer.

articleTitle: Appropriation of tolerances at designing hairpin microstrip low-pass filters
abstract: The investigation of tolerances limits for the microstrip hairpin low-pass filter's geometrical parameters is carried out. Method of calculation of the filter circuit is based on a quasi-dynamic approximations and quasi-static analysis of topology discontinuities. Interval models were used for the synthesis of tolerances. Optimization of tolerances for the filter's geometrical parameters is made by introducing of weight coefficients.

articleTitle: New analytical model of multiconductor coupled microstrip lines
abstract: For the first time to build a model of the multiconductor coupled microstrip lines the original concept of magnetic slits is introduced, which allows reducing the connectivity of the cross-section of up to one and applying an analytical technique of conformal mappings Schwarz-Christoffel implemented in the form of computer numerical procedures. The model has a high numerical efficiency and accuracy sufficient for practice.

articleTitle: Effect of microwave irradiation of low intensity and magnetic fields on the Ca2+ contents in pea root cells
abstract: The changes in the Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> contents in of pea root hair cells after microwave irradiation and magnetic field exposure were investigated. The microwaves of frequency 36.6 GHz and 100 μW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> intensity were produced by a generator designed and produced at the department of Theoretic Radio physics of the Kharkov National University. Roots also were processed by static magnetic field of 25 mT induction. The Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> content was determined by the fluo-3 staining in roots hair cells. The microwaves (5 and 10 min exposure) induced the significant increase in the Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> contents in cell nucleus. The magnetic field (1, 5 and 10 min exposure) not induced the increase of calcium content in cell nucleus. The regulatory role of the intranuclear increase of Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> in cell response to electromagnetic and magnetic fields is discussed.

articleTitle: The influence of the coordination results on the satellite networks technical parameters
abstract: The assessment of influence of interference between satellite networks in the Ku-band on quality parameters of the provided services. Design specification data of the satellite “Lybyd” onboard retransmitter were used in the calculations.

articleTitle: Observations of venus and mars by means of upgraded yevpatoria planet radar in 2012
abstract: Radar studies of planets from Evpatoriya using an upgraded radar with RT-70 antenna were resumed after 20-year interval. Among the peculiarities of radar studies in 2012 a new approach of signal distortion correction was used because of Doppler effect, when the distortions were removed after echo-signal acquisition. The obtained results of Mars and Venus observations confirm efficiency of radar hardware and signal processing software.

articleTitle: Adaptive modeling of inter-organizational business processes in telecommunication sector
abstract: Inter-organizational business processes are becoming increasingly prevalent in the telecommunication sector. Numerous partners such as Telecommunication vendors, Internet Service Provider (ISP) or Cloud provider collaborate across organizational borders in a highly dynamic environment. Seamless integration and efficient management of data and information is indispensable for such processes characterized by permanent re-planning. In short, the right information has to be available at the right time, in the right place. Although appropriate information management is necessary, the technological support is still limited. The paper presents an adaptive modeling approach based on Configurable Collaboration Artifacts as key elements for representing collaborative business processes. The solution approach extends the concept of Business Artifacts by mechanisms of runtime variation.

articleTitle: Prospects of donor-acceptor geterostructures application in pHEMT's
abstract: The development results of pHEMT's with an optimized quantum well and additional potential barrier have been submitted. High power transistors with gate length about 0.4 – 0.5 µm and 0.8 mm width have demonstrated specific output power exceeding 1.6 W/mm, associated gain exceeding 9.5 dB and efficiency about 50 % at 10 GHz. Prospects of donor-acceptor doped hetero-structure application in pHEMT's is done.

articleTitle: Design of model of load-balancing routing for software defined networks
abstract: The paper describes a proposed flow model of load-balancing routing by two criteria for software defined network such as the coefficient of maximum link utilization, and the average multipath delay. The results of comparative analysis of solutions of the routing problem with proposed model against those of the previously known models have been presented.

articleTitle: Correction of the parameters of transistor spice-models using ultra-short pulse meter of current-voltage and capacitance-voltage characteristics
abstract: It is shown that the quality of simulation of baseband pulse amplifying by bipolar transistors is considerably improved if we perform the corrections of the parameters of their models using method of ultra-short pulse current-voltage and capacitance-voltage characteristics.

articleTitle: Queue management in distributed infocommunication systems with Service Oriented Architecture
abstract: In this work a mathematical model of active queue management in a system with Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) according to a Random Early Detection algorithm is presented. Analysis of the algorithm efficiency for overload prevention in SOA systems is done. Influence on the system performance of such algorithm's parameters as mark probability denominator, minimal and maximal threshold values of queue length is studied. Recommendations on selection of the values of algorithm's parameters to increase the efficiency of overload prevention in distributed infocommunication SOA systems are formulated.

articleTitle: Popov Crimean scientific and technological center
To the 80th anniversary of professor Dmitriy Mikhaylovich Sazonov
abstract: Dmitriy Mikhaylovich Sazonov- the Professor of the Department of antenna assemblies and radio waves propagation of the Moscow Power Engineering Institute (MPEI), an expert in the field of radiophysics, antenna and microwave devices, the Doctor of Engineering. He was born on May 8, 1933 in Moscow. In 1955 after graduating from radio engineering faculty of the MPEI (nowadays - National Research University "MPEI") D.M. Sazonov remained to work in the Institute at the Department of antenna assemblies and radio waves propagation. In 1960 after finishing of postgraduate study he continued working at the department, where in 1962 he defended his master's thesis "Antennas on a metal cone of the final sizes", and in 1970 - the doctoral thesis "Theory of antenna arrays of optional geometry". Since 1975 to the present he has been working as the Professor of the Department of antenna assemblies and radio waves propagation of National Research University "MPEI". In 1977 he was given a professor's degree. The area of scientific interests of D.M. Sazonov covers a wide range of problems of applied electrodynamics: the analysis and synthesis of antenna assemblies of various types, radar devices on the basis of antenna arrays, computer-aided systems for design of antenna assemblies and SHF devices, etc. D.M. Sazonov is an author of three monographs and more than 200 articles in scientific magazines and papers of Russian and international scientific conferences. Textbooks by D. M. Sazonov are widely known. These textbooks are translated into English and Spanish. Since 1996 D.M. Sazonov became the head of the Russian subsection of IEEE on antennas and propagation of radiowaves (Russian IEEE APS Chapter), and since 1998 - the Russian subsection of IEEE on photonics, lasers and electrooptics (Russian IEEE LEOS Chapter). For his active scientific, and scientific-organizational work in IEEE Prof. D. M. Sazonov is decorated with the commemorative medal IEEE "2000 Millenium Medal for Outstanding Achievements and Contributions" (this medal in Russia is awarded only to seven persons). Since 2000 D. M. Sazonov is a member of Program Committee of CriMiCo conference. CriMiCo Organizational and Program Committees would like to express their congratulations to Prof. Sazonov on his anniversary and wish him good health for years to come and new creative results.

Organizing Committee
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members and society officers.

articleTitle: A 75th birthday tribute to Victor Danilovich Yeryomka
To the 75th anniversary of professor Oleg Vladimirovich Betskiy
abstract: Laureate of the state Prize of the Russian Federation, Professor, Doctor of physical and mathematical sciences, head of laboratory of Kotel'nikov Institute of Radio Engineering and Electronics of the Russian Academy of Sciences, editor-in-chief of journal “Millimeter Waves in Biology and Medicine”. O.V. Betskiy was born in Cuba-city of Azerbaijanian Soviet Socialist Republic. In 1957 he graduated from school with a gold medal, in 1963 - Moscow Power Engineering Institute awarded the Order of Lenin (MPEI). A capable, vigorous student of remarkable scientists and technicians - professors of MPEI I. V. Lebedev, and subsequently - Academician N. D. Devyatkov, O.V. Betskiy began his scientific activity in experimental design bureau of MPEI (1962) from the development and creation of original vacuum microwave devices - beam cross-field amplifiers for space application. This subject became a subject of his candidate (1967) and doctor's (1980) theses. At the same time since 1967 O.V. Betskiy in Institute of Radioengineering and Electronics (IRE) of Russian Academy of Sciences of the USSR (nowadays - Kotel'nikov Institute of Radio Engineering and Electronics of RAS) he was actively engaged in studying of low-intensive impact of radiation of the highest frequencies (HF) and laser range upon biological objects, including the human organism. This scientific direction is dedicated to the discovery made with direct participation of academician N. D. Devyatkov in 1965. It became an affair of the major part of O.V. Betskiy's life. Since 1977 O.V. Betskiy was the Head of the laboratory of the IRE Fryazino branch. O.V. Betskiy's wide renown was brought by his researches of mechanisms of influence of millimeter waves on the human organism. O.V. Betskiy is an author of more than 150 scientific works, 25 patents, a co-author of 6 monographs and 3 popular science brochures. In 1989 O.V. Betskiy was entitled as a professor. For development and deployment of medical EHF equipment in 2000 O.V. Betskiy together with a group of employees of IRE of the Russian Academy of Sciences and the State Research and Production Corporation "Istok" (Fryazino, Moscow region) led by academician N. D. Devyatkov, were awarded with the title of Laureates of the State Prize of Russian Federation. Program and Organizational Committees of CriMiCo conference and participants of the conference congratulate O.V. Betskiy on his anniversary from the bottom of their heart, and wish him good health and successful creative activity for the benefit of mankind.

articleTitle: In memory of professor Vladimir Mikhaylovich Shokalo (19.05.1948-18.02.2013)
abstract: Recounts the life and  professional achievements of Vladimir Mikhaylovich Shokalo (19 May 1948 - 18 Feb 2013).

articleTitle: The 75th anniversary tribute to Lev Ivanovich Tsvetkov (4.11.1938 - 18.01.2010)
abstract: This bibliograph discuss about the Lev Ivanovich Tsvetkov, 72 years, a chief of a laboratory of radio astronomy of R&D establishment “Crimean Astrophysical Observatory”, a member of International Astronomical Union, European Astronomical Community and Ukrainian Astronomical Association, Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences. Lev Ivanovich Tsvetkov was born on the 4th of November and grew up in Kineshma, Ivanovo region. In 1963 he graduated from Moscow Aviation Institute, faculty of radio engineering and in the same year he started scientific researches in Crimean Astrophysical Observatory of AS of USSR. In 1893 he defended the dissertation to gain a degree of Candidate of Physical and Mathematical Sciences with a specialization “Radio Astronomy”, and in 1999 - to take a degree of Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences with specialty “Astrophysics, Radio astronomy”. Lev Ivanovich Tsvetkov - is an author of 150 scientific publications, 50 of which are dedicated to the description of antenna measurements, and Tsvetkov-designed radio astronomical receivers and observational techniques for RT-22 of the laboratory of radio astronomy. L. I. Tsvetkov participated in various scientific programs of investigation of near-the-earth space. In 2008 his contribution to solar radio astronomy was awarded by the token “For scientific achievements” of Ministry of Education and Sciences of Ukraine. Since 1995 he was a member of Organizing and Program Committee of the conference CriMiCo in connection with Radioastronomy, Remote Sensing and Waves Propagation. On the photo: L.I. Tsvetkov (on the right) and Acad. V.M. Shulga (in the centre) present Prof. D.I. Voskresenskiy a certificate of naming a minor planet after his name. Sevastopol, the 10th of September, 2007.

articleTitle: Contents - Volume 1
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: microwave devices; radiocommunication; solid state devices and SHF integrated circuits; CAD; active devices; vacuum SHF electronics; O-type SHF devices; m-type SHF devices and gyrodevices; telecommunication system planning; direction finding and navigation systems; satellite communication and wireless access systems; information and communication technology; video information stream processing; wireless networks; telecommunication traffic control; and information networks.

articleTitle: Belarusian State University of Informatics and Radioelectronics (BSUIR)
abstract: Briefly describes the programs and mission of the Belarusian State University of Informatics and Radioelectronics (BSUIR).

articleTitle: Minimization of the SLL in the spatial antenna arrays with hexagonal structure placement of elements
abstract: Some variants of constructing antenna arrays with the hexagonal structure antenna curtains and spatial location of elements were considered. Characterizations of the orientation during the same amplitude and common-mode excitation of the antenna arrays taking into account the technological errors of manufacturing.

articleTitle: Forming of high current density electron beams for terahertz vacuum amplifiers
abstract: The results of computer analysis of high current density electron beams for THz vacuum electron devices are presented. The analysis of magnetic focusing of the low perveance electron flows in electron optical systems with the guns using the thermionic and field emission cathodes is carried out at the current density more than 100–300 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in drift space.

articleTitle: Four-beam antenna array for 24 GHz applications fed by 4 × 4 Butler matrix
abstract: A four-beam antenna array operating within 24 GHz frequency range has been developed. As a feeding network of such antenna a 4 × 4 Butler matrix has been designed utilizing a low-cost microwave laminate having permittivity 3.38 and thickness 0.203 mm. The developed Butler matrix consists of an appropriate connection of six directional couplers, two of which have been used to form a transmission-line crossover. The designed matrix has been integrated with the four-element linear antenna array confirming the usability of the utilized Butler matrix in beam-scanning applications.

articleTitle: Formation of double-walled titania nanotubes with cone like tips
abstract: Double-walled TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanotubes have been fabricated by electrochemical anodization of Ti foil in 0.3% ammonium fluoride solution in ethylene glycol with 2 vol.% of water at the low temperature of electrolyte and the subsequent annealing at 450 °C. The double-walled titania nanotubes structure with an upper honeycomb layer could be modified by sonication to the cone like tips.

articleTitle: Use of facilities of commercial purposes for external calibration of space-based SAR
abstract: The methods of external calibration of the spatial resolution in overview mode and control of accuracy of the estimate of the effective area of the specific scattering of underlying surfaces of space-based X-ray diffraction using the utility objects available in the terrain.

articleTitle: Properties of AlN-TiB2-TiSi2 coating system obtained by magnetron sputterring
abstract: The coatings investigated in this paper were deposited via the magnetron sputtering of AlN-TiB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-TiSi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> target in Ar atmosphere. The investigation of structural-phase composition, element composition, morphology and mechanical properties before and after annealing up to 1350 °C was carried out. The concentration of elements in the coating were changed after annealing under 900°C and further annealing under 1350 °C (especially after annealing under 1350°C).The hardness of as-deposited coatings was 15 GPa, but after the annealing under 1350 °C the value of hardness was increased up to (22…23.5) GPa. The value of a viscoplasticity index was 0.07. All this provides high damping properties of the coating, and the amorphous-like structure makes promising the use of these coatings as diffusion barriers in the form of independent elements, and as a contacting layer in multilayer wear resistant coatings.

articleTitle: Coupling dependences' analysis of quadrupole mode of the rectangular dielectric resonator with a coplanar waveguide
abstract: The coupling dependences between a dielectric resonator (DR) and a coplanar transmission line have been obtained for two cases: as a function of height of glass substrate, on which the DR is situated, and on the shift along the symmetry plane, that crosses through the waveguide path of CPW. The frequency diversity between the operational mode and the adjacent ones has been also calculated.

articleTitle: Assessment of radiating ability of drupaceous seeds in the millimeter range of wavelengths
abstract: Results of a pilot study of radiating ability of drupaceous seeds are given for the range of frequencies of 37.5–53.5 GHz. It is established that the level of radiation of seeds of a various origin from the studied group under identical conditions of measurement is various. Results of researches allow drawing a conclusion on expediency of use in the preventive and medical purposes of seeds of cornel, dates, chestnut and acorn as a natural source of microwave radiation.

articleTitle: Tranceiver for digital radiorelay system in terahertz frequency band
abstract: A number of the devices, which can be used for creation of new communication systems generation in terahertz band, have been developed. These devices for the first time allowed creating a digital radio relay system transceiver in 130 GHz frequency band. Output power of a transmitter was −10 dBm and sensitivity of a receiver was not lower 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup> W. Data transfer rate of 155Mbit/s was achieved using QAM-256 modulation in 25 MHz pass band.

articleTitle: Spark generators in dentistry
abstract: Technical features, action mechanism and the way of use of a spark generator in dentistry are described. The results of medical treatment with a spark generators and benefits of its using are shown.

articleTitle: Interpolation method modification for nonlinear objects identification using Volterra model in a frequency domain
abstract: The accuracy of the modified interpolation method of nonlinear dynamical systems identification based on the Volterra model in the frequency domain is studied. The polyharmonic signals with reduced amplitudes are used as the test ones. The model is built as first, second and third order amplitude-frequency and phase-frequency characteristics. The comparison of obtained characteristics with previous works is given.

articleTitle: Assessment of materials spectral characteristics in electromagnetic fields of low intensity
abstract: Results of development of the radiometer for determination of spectral characteristics of materials in electromagnetic fields of low intensity are considered. Possibility of reduction of mirror hindrances influence is shown at heterodyne transformation of frequency. The offered measuring scheme can be used in systems of nondestructive control for detection of defects in materials.

articleTitle: Amplitude-phase distribution estimation of two-dimensional antennas array for optimal spatial structure of measurement
abstract: Synthesis and analysis of pattern estimation algorithm by maximum likelihood method is carried out for 2D antennas array. Pattern estimation error versus antennas complex coefficient error is examined. It is established the fact that the minimal pattern error results in case of optimal spatial structure of measurement which is specified by angular spread of measuring points as well as rotating angle antennas array aperture.

articleTitle: Hidden data transmission system based on the principle of nonlinear parametric mixing
abstract: The possibility of increasing the degree of information signal masking in the conventional system for hidden data transmission based on the non-autonomous circuit “RL-diode with p-n-junction”, by the inertial subcircuit introduction is discussed. The principle of chaotic signal modulation by time constant variation for inertial part of the circuit “RL-diode” is proposed.

articleTitle: Resolution increase of incoherent radar systems
abstract: The method of processing of radar echo signals on the basis of an algorithm of additional autocorrelated estimation of the echo-mixture complex envelope that allows realizing the available fluctuation amplitude and angular modulation in radar signals even without their preliminary assessment is offered.

articleTitle: Detectors with low-barrier Mott diodes for millimeter-wave imaging arrays
abstract: The paper presents experimental results of a study of millimeter-wave detectors (94 GHz) based on low-barrier gallium arsenide diodes manufactured using the technology of the near surface isotype delta-doping. By varying parameters of the deltalayer it is possible to obtain a wide range of values of the effective barrier height, which is important for millimeter-wave imaging arrays that require zero-bias detectors. Optimum performance of the detectors are obtained with diodes having the barrier height of ∼0.3 eV as shown theoretically and confirmed experimentally. A study of dependence basic parameters of detectors on temperature, input power and radiation polarization was performed.

articleTitle: Multicriteria optimization of design variants when planning of mobile telecommunications networks
abstract: Selection methods for optimum project options of mobile communication networks taking into account a set of merit figures are presented. The description of the created program complex for design automatization at a stage of planning of mobile communication networks is given.

articleTitle: The features of contact resistivity of ohmic contacts to n+-GaN AND n+-GaAs at low temperatures
abstract: We studied, both theoretically and experimentally, temperature dependences of contact resistivity, ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>(T), of ohmic contacts to n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaN. The ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>(T) curves have saturation portion at low temperatures (4.2–50 K) and exponential portion as temperature grows up to 300 K. For comparison we also give the reference data on ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>(T) for ohmic contacts to n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaAs in which the n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-regions are obtained by doping the near-contact layer with Ge and Si. Some possible mechanisms are proposed to explain the experimental ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>(T) curves for ohmic contacts to n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaN and n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaAs.

articleTitle: Multicriteria optimization application within decisions making in infocommunication networks
abstract: Features of multicriteria optimization methods application for the solving of problems of a design decisions optimum choice in infocommunication networks are considered. The basic stages of multicriteria Pareto optimization are resulted.

articleTitle: On the heating efficiency of heterogeneous fluids containing iron oxide nanoparticles by microwave radiation
abstract: The paper considers thermal effects of the microwave-range electromagnetic radiation on the water based colloidal solution containing iron oxide nanoparticles (magnetite) and that on the distilled water. Irradiation was carried out at several frequencies using the open end of the waveguide. As a result of experimental studies it is found that after the irradiation with power of 33 dBm (about 2 W) and a 10-minute duration, the water-based solution of colloidal magnetite has been heated higher than the distilled water (the maximum temperature difference was about 3°C).

articleTitle: The cavity resonator for characterization of dielectric fibers
abstract: Using computer simulation, the effect of the coupling hole size and the dielectric fiber properties on the resonance properties and the forward gain of a circular cylindrical resonator with a longitudinal slot and on the electric field distribution inside the resonator has been studied. The advantages of the cylindrical cavity resonator with a longitudinal slot over closed resonators are shown.

articleTitle: Approaches for development of sub-terahertz differential noise-shift keying communication system
abstract: The idea for development of an ultra-wideband communication system utilizing a noise signal as a carrier at frequency 130–134 GHz is proposed. It is shown that using differential noise-shift keying provides rising of the system performance. Data transmission via direct noise modulation (without frequency transformation) permits bandwidth expansion and increases bitrate.

articleTitle: High-voltage discharge in nitrogen at high pressure and photoionization effect
abstract: The data of experimental study of impulse high-voltage breakdown in nitrogen at high pressure (P=10–60 atm), obtained at the electric field strength Е up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> V/cm and pulse rise-time τ=0.4–20 ns, are compared with the avalanche theory results. It is shown that traditional description of breakdown using only the impact ionization mechanism does not agree with the experiment in a wide range of the parameter Е<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BD</inf>/P(Pτ). Taking photoionization into account it is possible to obtain satisfactory phenomenological description of the breakdown process for τ=5–20 ns.

articleTitle: Character and characteristics (to the 80th anniversary of V.V. Yurko)
abstract: The personal component of technological progress is considered. The works performed under the guidance of V.V. Yurko with radio equipment for the missile defense system creation is a great illustration of the principle “new problems can not be solved in old ways!”

articleTitle: The analysis of the charge trajectories in the inhomogeneous and time-dependent magnetic field
abstract: The analysis of the charge trajectories in the inhomogeneous and time-dependent magnetic field is carried out.

articleTitle: Microstrip reflectarray on a substrate with anisotropic properties
abstract: The present paper concerns the investigation of a microstrip reflective antenna array (MSRAA) which substrate has anisotropic properties. The mathematical model of MSRAA on a crystalline semiconductor substrate has been created. Many numerical researches for various microstrip elements topologies of such reflective type antenna arrays (solid-state arrays) have been fulfilled.

articleTitle: Nanoscaled magnetic fept films with additional au layer for ultrahigh density recording and information storage
abstract: Additional intermediate Au layer influence on the phase formation in Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>Pt<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>/Au/Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf>Pt<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf> thin metallic films was investigated by methods of physical materials science. Au atoms are diffused in L1<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>(FePt) phase grain boundaries and limited their growth at heat treatment. This results in reducing exchange magnetic interaction between grains and coercivity rise up to 27.5 kOe with the increase in Au layer thickness up to 30 nm. Additional interface energy in film composition and also stresses caused by Au and FePt lattice mismatch promote the FePt film ordering process. Au layer thickness increase up to 30 nm causes decrease in ordering temperature up to 600°C.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of range ambiguity mitigation in primary radars when using signals with high pulse-repetition frequency
abstract: Effectiveness analysis of the method of range ambiguity mitigation, based on using of different pairs of pulse-repetition intervals on even and odd scans, is performed. Results of usage of the mentioned method in signal-processing equipment of a landing radar in terms of its full-time operation, are presented.

articleTitle: Sol-gel synthesis of strontium titanate thin films and perspectives of their application in production of memristors
abstract: The strontium titanate thin films were fabricated on silicon using the sol-gel method. The strontium titanate phase was registered with X-ray diffraction analysis. The films were deposited by spin-on technique and the film thickness was in the range of 90-115 nm. The perspectives for development of the sol-gel method for the formation of memristors as well as varistors and capacitors on the basis of SrTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> xerogels are discussed.

articleTitle: Electric field tuning of the composite ferrite-piezoelectric resonator Q-factor
abstract: The results of experimental investigation of tuning of magnetostatic film resonator Q-factor in composite planar ferrite/ piezoelectric structure with applied voltage are presented. On the basis of both static (transition to saturation state field) and dynamic (magnetostatic resonance frequency) properties of ferrite component, a mechanism of this effect, that qualitatively explains obtained results, was suggested.

articleTitle: Development of the wireless network system and the creation of THz-range communication channel
abstract: The appearance of the modern technical means and communication technologies on the market allowed creating, first, telecommutation system of subscriber multiservice access to information resources and services on their basis and, secondly, creating communication channel equipment for 140 GHz range.

articleTitle: The model of acoustic oscillations of biological membranes and the impact of the weak external signal upon them
abstract: The model of the black box of stable acoustic oscillations of biological cells is presented. The results of numerical simulations have shown a high degree of compliance with the experimental data of oscillations of yeast cells. On the basis of the model the mechanism of cells oscillations synchronization by an external weak signal is proposed.

articleTitle: Digital radio relay stations “Komplex MG” application for training process
abstract: Possibilities of digital radio relay stations (DRRS) “Komplex MG” application to increase theoretical and practical skills of Institute of Telecommunication Systems of NTUU “KPI” students are shown. The approaches for laboratory tests concerning the main elements of DRRS during transmission of the real radio signals are presented.

articleTitle: Reference method for determining distant object permittivity by radiohologram and its testing with fractal antennas
abstract: In this paper we propose a reference method for determining permittivity based on the calculation of correlation of experiment and reference holograms. In contrast to existing methods for determining permittivity, which require the use of fixed form samples, this method allows determining permittivity of arbitrary shape's dielectric bodies. The use of fractal antennas for this technique allowed us to obtain a frequency dependence of permittivity consistent with the theory for the range up to 1000 MHz with the same antenna. The analysis was made for the third order Minkovsky cross fractal antenna.
