articleTitle: Mode matching technique solution of eigenproblem for composite metal-dielectric resonator
abstract: A composite metal-dielectric resonator topology is described. Its performance is calculated with a dedicated Mode Matching Technique. A Finite Element Method analysis of the resonator is also carried out. The computational results of both methods are compared and found to be in a good agreement.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of electron transport in pHEMT on donor-acceptor doping heterostructures
abstract: The study results of physical mechanisms which provide abrupt increase of output power of pHEMT with donoracceptor doping heterostructures are presented. It is shown, that complementary using of potential barriers provokes abrupt decrease of the role of transversal space transfer of electrons in the heterostructure, and increases the role of energy quantization in transistor channels.

articleTitle: The objects detection efficiency improvement based on complexed radio monitoring data
abstract: The paper deals with the construction of multi-channel radiomonitoring systems with automatic objects detection that have specific parameters. The probability characteristics of detecting objects in the imaging of individual partial channels by using complexation is determined being based on the conducted simulations.

articleTitle: Required quality of service provision based on the resilient telecommunication topologies
abstract: The present paper concerns the problems of designing of the telecommunication networks resistant to external influences on the basis of the multicriterion Pareto optimization method. The developed method allows finding the best main and redundant paths in the network taking into account the set of quality indicators.

articleTitle: About Quality of Service concept's usage at delivery of messages streams circulating in convergent telecommunication network
abstract: Specificity of characteristics of end-to-end quality of service in the process of delivery of information messages stream is researched. The Quality-Of-Service concept requirements for convergent networks are formulated.

articleTitle: One-port resonant transistor amplifier
abstract: The design, simulation, and operation of one-port resonant transistor amplifiers are considered. The amplifier consists of a single FET and a resonant circuit. From the schematic point of view the considered amplifier is absolutely equivalent to the Hartley oscillator. The operation of the amplifier is based on the use of positive feedback. This is the class of regenerative amplifiers. The amplifier possesses excellent electrical characteristics and has the simplest design. The discussed amplifier will be especially useful at design of active transponders of RFID systems.

articleTitle: Capacity of the MIMO communication channel with UAV with different configurations of antenna systems
abstract: Capacity of the MIMO communication channel between the UAV and the ground control station with different configurations of antenna systems using the model of the MIMO channel was evaluated. Small dependence of capacity from orientation of antenna systems is shown with the specific spatial structure of the antenna systems.

articleTitle: Autonomous high power pulsed EMR source
abstract: Design and characteristics of compact powerful nanosecond UWB pulse source intended for study of particular electromagnetic compatibility problems are given. For excitation of dipole antenna we use high voltage drive-pulse generator with voltage output of U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>≈550 kV. Power supply is a set of rechargeable batteries. Designed source of radiation is characterized by the following parameters: field range product (FRP = E×R) equals to 700 kV (with parabolic reflector about 1.2×1.2×0.6 m overall). Peak of radiation spectrum is at the frequency of 0.3 GHz. Pulse-repetition frequency is up to 1 kHz. The source as a whole is combined into monoblock of 1 m high and 0.24 m in diameter. Total weight of the source is 65 kg approximately.

articleTitle: Calculation of spectrum of spatial lyapunov exponents for beam-plasma systems described in the framework of large particle method
abstract: The method for Lyapunov exponents spectrum calculation for distributed infinite-dimensional beam-plasma systems in the framework of PIC-method was developed. Suggested approach was successfully approved by diagnosing oscillation dynamic modes of Pierce diode, an etalon model of microwave electronics. We discussed electron flow behavior in an autonomous Pierce diode in presence of ionic background in the interaction space. The possibility of system dynamics analysis in a wide range of controlling parameters was shown.

articleTitle: Study of the spread of electron velocities in the multi-velocities electron beams
abstract: Some methods of creating multi-velocities electron beams are considered; the experimental curves of the integrated output power and generation band versus the magnitude of velocities spread of electrons in the low-voltage vircator laboratory mock-up are presented.

articleTitle: Multiple reflections of electromagnetic waves in simple layers
abstract: Reflection of electromagnetic waves without losses from uniform simple layers of different thickness and different materials is considered. The design formulas obtained in [1] taking into account multiple reflections in a layer, which are expressed as convergent series. The fulfilled calculations allowed defining the dependence of the reflection coefficient vs. a field's wave length, which differ from the ones obtained for the impedance theory and boundary problems of wave reflection.

articleTitle: A design approach to building a pseudo-coherent high duty-cycle X- and Ka-band radar
abstract: A nonconventional way of construction of two-frequency (X - and Ka-ranges) pseudo-coherent pulsed radar of high porosity is described. It is shown that the offered way can be applied both for creation of radar guidance systems of new generation in the millimeter range of wavelengths, and for modernization of operating pulsed radars of the centimeter range.

articleTitle: Usage of maximum likelihood estimation of correlatoin dimension in detecting edges of objects on radio images
abstract: An algorithm of edge detection of fractal dimension variance is created by maximum likelihood method. Given prior uncertainty of fractal dimension values, an adaptive algorithm of edge separation using correlation dimension estimates obtained by observed data is proposed. An analysis of synthesized algorithms is carried out for the conditions of complete and incomplete a priori information.

articleTitle: Software system calculation of pul parameters and frequency characteristics for different types of microstrip lines
abstract: A proposition is made for implementation of the algorithm of calculating parameters and frequency characteristics of microstrip lines, followed by visualizing the results, which is designed to simplify modeling of distributed components of the microwave integrated circuits.

articleTitle: The deployment of the satellite telecommunication system on Ukrainian Antarctic station “Akademik Vernadsky”
abstract: The problem of satellite link establishment on the Ukrainian Antarctic station “Akademik Vernadsky” is discussed. The peculiarities of the task connected with geographical location of the station are stated. It was shown that implementation of the link is reasonable either in C- or in K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</inf>-band. The results of measurements of satellite signal levels in the station location point are stated.

articleTitle: Monitoring of radiation therapy for pulmonary oncological diseases using the nonstationary THz spectroscopy
abstract: The possibility of development of noninvasive medicine diagnostics method of pulmonary diseases on the base of exhaled breath analysis with using the nonstationary THz spectroscopy is considered. The results of application of nonstationary gas spectroscopy method for monitoring of the radiation therapy of oncological patients are carried out.

articleTitle: Henry Round - “An unknown genius” of radio engineering, an inventor of autodyne method of reception
abstract: Historical information regarding the invention of the autodyne and development of autodyne receiving method is presented. Brief biographical information about Henry Joseph Round, who was “an unknown genius” of radio engineering and an English inventor of the autodyne, is provided. The process of formation and development of scientific-technical field connected with the use of autodynes in receiving and transmitting radio communications, as well as the origin of the term “autodyne” are considered.

articleTitle: Tunable band-stop and band-pass filters based on microstrip stub resonators
abstract: A novel concept for controlling of tunable microstrip resonators is proposed. The microstrip stub control is realized by detaching a part of the stub from the substrate. The air gap between the substrate and the signal electrode is the heterogeneity which controls the stub effective permittivity, in this way providing a resonance frequency shift. By moving the stub 50 microns the resonance frequency is shifted about 0.7 GHz (30%). An equivalent circuit model of the resonator is developed. Measurements results are in good agreement with circuit model, finite-difference time domain method (FDTD) and finite elements method (FEM) results.

articleTitle: Ambiguity removal and noise supression when detecting the range in the upper-air radars
abstract: In SHF locators in case of traditional object detection there can be an ambiguity due to influence of similar signal disturbance from local items. It is shown that developed at the Communications Equipment and Technologies Department of the Institute of Radioelectronics and Informational Technologies of UrFU object detection algorithms against a background of noise allow firstly, clearly detecting objects, secondly, providing advantage of signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Mathematical digital line model with servicing the multimedia real time traffic simplest flow
abstract: Based on the analyses of the functional model of multiservice information resources access network and using the teletraffic theory and self-similar processes theory, the deduction is made of design equations, which are intended for the determination and further estimation of performance parameters of the model in question, namely those of lost loads fraction and incoming load rate, while servicing simplest Poisson flow calls for channel resource allotment.

articleTitle: Thermoelectric properties of Hg1−x−yCdxEuySe crystals
abstract: The paper presents research results of the kinetic properties on the basis of the temperature dependence of electrical conductivity and thermoelectric power determined by the coefficient of thermoelectric goodness of Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x−y</inf>Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Eu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</inf>Se crystals.

articleTitle: Multi agent genetic decision support for projects scheduling
abstract: This paper focuses on the optimization of the projects scheduling problem decision using evolutionary computation and simulation. The multi agent genetic optimization method to solve the project scheduling problem base on the basis of the annealing simulation algorithm, novelty search algorithm, genetic algorithm and multi agent simulation.

articleTitle: Smart negasensor on C-negatrons
abstract: Developed and studied the intellectual negasensor scheme which is based on the matrix of capacitive autogenerating RC-negasensors and neural network on negatrons. It is shown that with corresponding learning of the neural network, the smart sensor is able to detect the texture and shape of the object's surface. The negative capacitance of C-negatron increases the sensitivity of the sensor 2 – 5 times and the neural network on negatrons includes a little number of transistors.

articleTitle: Method for the detection of small defects of electrical contacts by thermononlinear reflectometry with compensation of non-invariance of test signal's generator
abstract: This paper discusses a method of increasing the detectability of small defects in electrical contacts through nonlinear reflectometry by reducing the influence of non-invariance of test signal amplitudes. The method involves registering both the object responses, and the corresponding test signals. It has been shown experimentally that detectability is increased by more than twice, and it becomes possible to detect changes in the transitional contact resistance of 10 mΩ and higher.

articleTitle: Hydroacoustic emmiter/receiver based on A0 lamb wave in piezoelectric structure
abstract: The theoretical and experimental investigations of the influence of the nanocomposite polymeric layers on the efficiency and radiation angle of acoustic wave into liquid have been carried out. It has been theoretically shown and experimentally confirmed that in the case of using the nanocomposite polymeric material based on the polyethylene of low density with nanoparticles of cadmium sulfide of concentration 25% as an intermediate layer between the plate of 128YX LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and water medium, the power of radiation can be increased by ∼1.6 dB/λ for the ratio of the thicknesses of the layer and plate d/h=0.154 at f=1.3 MHz. It has been also shown that the presence of nanocomposite film leads to the increase of the angle of bulk acoustic wave radiation into liquid and allows the effective operation of the radiator not only in the sweet water but also in salt one. The obtained results may be used for the development of effective waveguide hydroacoustic antennas.

articleTitle: Evaluation of faultless and continuing work of one element of NGN network
abstract: The paper describes the application of the apparatus of semi-Markov process and the method of consolidation phase of semi-Markov system for the evaluation of faultless and continuing operation of one element of NGN (Next Generation Network) network.

articleTitle: Study of formation and nonlinear dynamics of squeezed beam state in a vircator with helical electron beam and additional breaking field
abstract: The results of a numerical simulation and analysis of formation and nonlinear dynamics of the squeezed state in a helical electron beam in a low-voltage vircator with additional slowing-down of electrons are presented. Fields of control parameters where the squeezed state is realized in such system are revealed. Peculiarities of dynamics of the system under study are analyzed. The formation of the squeezed state in a low-voltage system with slowing-down is shown to be accompanied by the appearance of low-frequency longitudinal dynamics of a space charge that is not typical for the squeezed state in the case of relativistic electron beams.

articleTitle: High-power pulsed millimeter-wave gyroklystron based on the TE711—TE731 mode sequence
abstract: We present the results of experimental research of the pulsed gyroklystron at 35.5 GHz with an output power 10 MW, efficiency of 30%, and pulse duration of 0.5 mks. The concept of a delayed feedback is realized in the gyroklystron at a megawatt power level to ensure generation switching of the output cavity from one mode to another.

articleTitle: Simulation of the orboklystrons oscillators and amplifiers at frequencies 300, 600, 1000 GHz
abstract: The self-consistent mathematical model, in which the space-charge of beams of rectangular section, sagging of fields in gaps are considered, is formulated. It is shown, that calculations electronic power orboklystrons oscillators at frequencies (300…1000) GHz can reach 24-2 W respectively. Amplifiers have the gain of 20–30 dB.

articleTitle: Design of microstrip antennas for dual-frequency on-board transmitter “Mayak 150/400”
abstract: The advantages of using microstrip patch antennas as on-board antennas are experimentally demonstrated by modeling analogues of a dipole antenna and a pin antenna for dual-frequency on-board transmitter “Mayak 150/400”. The application of microstrip patch antennas also solves one of the topical problems of antenna technology; it makes possible the creation of small-size design, low-profile on-board spacecraft antennas.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of spaceborne SAR's through characteristic for chirp and m-sequence modulated sounding signals
abstract: A comparison of spaceborne SAR's spatial resolution and radiometric characteristics is given for two sounding signal modulation types: LFM and M-sequence. Images obtained in sample SAR hardware-in-the-loop tests using reflected signal simulation technique are analyzed. Spatial resolution was estimated using impulse response method, while radiometric characteristics were estimated using differential radiocontrast method.

articleTitle: Self-organization of nanoscale structures at various types of substrates
abstract: The regularities of formation of nanoclusters of germanium (Ge) and SiGe solid solution on the silicon substrates oriented in the plane (100), (111), and also on the surface of nanofilms of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and Dy<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> are investigated. It is established that the spatial characteristics of self-organizing nanoclusters are defined by the temperature of deposition, crystallographic orientation of a semiconductor substrate, type of a dielectric film on the substrate, the effective thickness of the film of polycrystalline silicon and by the content of germanium in it.

articleTitle: Formation of copper 3D structures under stationary conditions of quasi-equilibrium condensation
abstract: The results of experiments involving obtaining of copper micro- and nanosystems by condensation of ion-sputtered material near thermodynamic equilibrium are presented in the work. We established three basic options for structuring condensates by studying of the structural and morphological characteristics at different stages of the build-up of condensates. The first of these columnar structures are formed through field selectivity. The second mechanism involves the formation of mesoporous crystalline systems in the absence of faceting on the growing surface. In the absence of an electric field, you can implement a third mechanism of structure, which is based on the formation of elongated structural fragments consisting of loosely coupled faceted nanocrystals.

articleTitle: Geometrical optics method for analysis of radial structures
abstract: A method and a computer program for calculation of complex electrically large radial-axial systems by using the theory of geometrical optics (GO) and wave optics (WO) are described. The comparisons of results with known electrodynamic systems Ansoft HFSS and CST MWS, based on the finite element (FEM) and finite integrals method (FIM), are performed. It is shown that the adoption of this method provides sufficient accuracy in calculating the distribution of bulk density of electromagnetic power in the treated material.

articleTitle: Research of the wheat's spectrum exposed to low intensity microwave radiation by chemometrical methods
abstract: The results of experimental research of the dependence of wheat grain's spectrum in near-infrared range (NIR) vs. the duration of low intensity microwave radiation influence are presented. Nonlinearity of an interaction process between wheat grains and radiation, the effect of storage of energy, long enough conservation of the effect of influence after irradiation, were founded.

articleTitle: Protection of satellite communication links against intentional interference
abstract: The special features of construction and functioning of some promising systems for protection of satellite communication links against intentional interferences are represented. The work of systems is respectively based beyond the methods: the compensation of interferences, separation of “transmitting” and “receiving” satellites-retransmitters, a monitoring complex of radio-frequency resource and location of the source of the interferences - GeoMon.

articleTitle: Influence of terahertz electromagnetic radiation on the frequency of absorption of molecular oxygen on briggs-rauscher oscillating reaction
abstract: In the article the description of the influence of electromagnetic radiation on the frequencies characteristic for the maximal absorption intensity and atmospheric oxygen radiation on the process of Briggs-Rauscher reaction has been provided. It has been shown that the radiation increases the time of the oscillation mode for more than 20 % in comparison to an unirradiated flask because of the intensification of the process of oxygen precipitation.

articleTitle: Operation time assessment for spacecraft SHF-antenna drive
abstract: The accuracy increasing of assigned operation time assessment for SHF-antennas drive gear mechanisms of spacecraft is considered. The accuracy increasing means of assigned operation time assessment for gear mechanisms on the example of an electric drive of the Earth remote satellite are substantiated. The analytical expressions concerning of determination of assigned operation time for the antenna drive gearbox in view of increased accuracy are obtained.

articleTitle: Commercial production of Soviet radio tubes with the assistance of the French Company Generale de la TSF
abstract: In the early 20's of XX century, Soviet radio factories had outdated equipment, which did not allow establishing the production of radio tubes in large quantities. To solve this problem, a contract with a French company TSF was signed. However, a number of Soviet scientists expressed their doubts concerning appropriateness of the measures taken. To resolve the conflict, several government commissions were created, which confirmed the necessity for such an agreement. Owing to this cooperation the progress in the manufacture of vacuum tubes in the Soviet Union lasted for ten years.

articleTitle: Polarization conversion by bilayer chiral structure with giant optical activity
abstract: Theoretical analysis and experimental study of the properties of two-layer multi-element plane-chiral structure (PChS) at 8-mm band of electromagnetic waves in a free space have been carried out. It is shown that the plane-chiral structure exhibits optical activity, and in accordance with the calculation results in the rotation of the polarization plane by 90 °. Measured and calculated transmittance maximum cross-polarized component of the same frequency with high accuracy and loss do not exceed 0.1 dB. The possibility of tuning bandwidth by changing the distance between the layers is shown. The spatial distribution of the wave beam passed through the PChS has been investigated. It is found that the studied structure also has focusing properties.

articleTitle: The novel analytical solution approach for the eigen modes problem solution in the waveguide ferrite resonator
abstract: The novel method of an analytical solution of a problem on ferrite resonator eigen modes in a waveguide on the basis of an Cauchy integral and interpolation Lagrange formula for arbitrary sizes of the resonator and permeability tensor parameters of gyromagnetic medium is offered. The analysis of the dispersion equation is performed and relations between problem parameters are established for three types of solutions: the localized modes, surface modes, modes with complex frequencies.

articleTitle: Public key cryptosystems based on Reed-Solomon codes over Clifford algebras
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to introduce new cryptosystems based on Reed-Solomon codes over Clifford algebras with fast code and encode procedures based on fast Fourier — Clifford — Galois transforms.

articleTitle: The methods of struggle against congestion in the critical parts of the infocommunication network
abstract: The methods of network resources management were suggested in this paper. We developed a simulation model of the trunk IP/MPLS network and made a laboratory experiment to test the effectiveness of methods for MPLS Traffic Engineering and to compare evaluations of network performance under different scenarios of throughput management.

articleTitle: Features of the recognition algorithm of intelligent agents as a result of the code in Javascript
abstract: The use of Javascript on HTTP client side for determination of an intelligent agent is presented. The basic shortcomings are revealed, and some recommendations are given to eliminate them.

articleTitle: Spectra of permittivity of different woods in the frequency range of 3–12 GHz
abstract: The paper presents measurement data of the dielectric constant of softwood (such as spruce, pine, cedar, fir), which have been conducted by the resonator method in the range of 3 – 12 GHz. A contrast to the dielectric properties of deciduous and coniferous trees has been noted, as well as the dependence of the area of upgrowth. The impact of the weight moisture on the dielectric properties of wood has been researched. The results can be used for remote sensing of forest cover.

articleTitle: Model of high-intensity local influence of microwave radiation on semiconductor layered structures
abstract: The numerical model of local high-local influence of microwave radiation on semiconductor structures is presented. The electrodynamic part of the model is constructed with use of a method of FDTD with an adaptive spatial grid. At creation of thermal part the method of independent thermal streams was used. Distributions of electromagnetic and temperature fields in semiconductor structure which allow determining the characteristic sizes of local sites with increased temperature in semiconductor structures under the influence of electromagnetic fields of microwave range are obtained.

articleTitle: Calculation of scattering matrix of finite plane waveguide array with an impedance flange using variation principle
abstract: This paper presents a theoretical investigation of the computation method of scattering matrix elements for the finite phased array of plane waveguides with an impedance flange. Waveguide array consists of the finite number of identical semi-infinite plane waveguides. Mutual coupling between waveguide apertures has been taken into account using variation principle in the single-mode approximation. As the result, the set of algebraic equations for scattering matrix elements has been obtained.

articleTitle: Experimental study the electrodynamic characteristics of slow-wave structure such as folded-waveguide of various modifications
abstract: The results of experimental study of the electrodynamic characteristics of a slow-wave structure such as a foldedwaveguide and its modifications depending on the size and configurations are presented. The possibility of the coupling impedance minus the first space harmonic increase for 1.5÷2 times is demonstrated by introducing rectangular patches in the folded-waveguide interaction space area at an insignificant decrease of the working frequency bandwidth.

articleTitle: Studying of a waveguide insert with a rectangular window in the millimeter wavelength range
abstract: A number of examinations of the influence of the rectangular window geometrical sizes on the resonant properties of the insert was made. The expressions for the transmission and reflection coefficients were calculated. The graphs of the resonant frequency dependences versus the insert length and width of the rectangular window were shown. The frequency dependence of the reflection coefficient with various heights of the window was presented; also fractional-rational approximation was carried out for this function, as a result of which the values of the poles (natural frequencies) and zeros were obtained.

articleTitle: Wide-band ultra-compact coaxial-to-rectangular waveguide and coaxial-to-double ridged waveguide transitions
abstract: The new wide-band transitions between 50-Ohm coaxial line and standard rectangular waveguide (18–26 GHz) or double ridged waveguide (8–18 GHz) have been successfully designed and experimentally tested. The fabricated transition for frequency band 18–26 GHz has VSWR less than 1.3. The measured VSWR of the couple of coaxial-to-double ridge waveguide transitions in the back-to-back fixture does not exceed 1.4, while VSWR of single coaxial-to-double ridge waveguide transition is about 1.15. The proposed design of coaxial-to-waveguide transitions is ultra-compact, easy-to-manufacture and it shows excellent electrical performances by mass production.

articleTitle: Solid-state oscillators of chaos with a nonlinear contour
abstract: The approach to design of the power-efficient chaotic solid-state oscillators is proposed. Results of schematic simulation and experiments of microwave oscillator layouts made with the use both microstrip and lumped elements are given. It is shown that generators made on the basis of the approach allow generating chaotic oscillations in the given frequency band with efficiency of (15–25) %.

articleTitle: Deep space telecom and radar in a Ka-band ground station antenna
abstract: Deep Space Telecommunication with satellites to Jupiter and beyond require high power transmission capabilities for the ground-segment and highly sensitive reception capability. Radar functionality calls for high transmission power, for instance for imaging a Near-Earth Object. This paper discusses a perspective scenario to equip a 35 m ground-station antenna with a high power Ka transmitter and having available sensitive reception capability mono- or bi-static. A 35 m ground-station antenna as used in ESA's ground-segment is considered only for descriptive reasons. Consideration is given to a number of aspects (not-exhaustive), which need to be taken into account. Different frequency bands are used for Deep Space telecommunication for up and downlink, for radar functionality, the same frequency band is used in up- and down-link with consequences for a transmission-reception scenario. One needs duplexers, or more a use of a bi-static scenario. The authors discuss this scenario, which is not in any approved planning or program.

articleTitle: Novel approaches for nordugrid arc resource brokering
abstract: In order to provide users with performance and task execution effectivity, GRID has to implement an effective brokering algorithm. The main goal of such load balancing in GRID is to decrease the overall execution time and make utilization of the computing resources effective. In this work the modern approach to building metaschedulers in Grid segments is considered.

articleTitle: The high-stable reference oscillator for the frequency synthesizer of the homodyne system
abstract: The internal structure and characteristics of the scheme, based on a single reference crystal oscillator, for an indirect frequency synthesizer of the microwave measurement system are considered. A method of frequency stabilization of a crystal oscillator with low level of phase noise used in this system is described. The feasibility of applying this system for formation of discrete series of signals with frequencies which are slightly different from each other in carrying out homodyne measurements is analyzed.

articleTitle: Application of high power microwaves for heat treatment of metallurgical containers lining
abstract: Possibility of application of high power microwaves for heat treatment of the metallurgical containers lining at power reducing and decrease of the toxic emission in comparison with traditional heat treatment by natural gas is shown.

articleTitle: Designing and manufacturing of 1–8 GHz band low-noise GaAs Schottky-gate FET's taking into account the dimensional effect
abstract: It is shown that taking the dimensional effect (fractal properties of epitaxial n-GaAs) into account in designing and manufacturing of the low-noise 1–8 GHz band Schottky-gate FET's with a larger gate length allows obtaining a higher power gain K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">U</inf>. The obtained results show the effectiveness of the proposed fractal approach in the designing of Schottky-gate FET's.

articleTitle: Is the animal brain a Clifford algebra computer?
abstract: We present a new theoretical framework for multidimensional image processing using hypercomplex and Clifford algebras. The main goal of the work is to show that commutative hypercomplex algebras and Clifford algebras can be used to solve problems of hyperspectral, multi-color and color image processing and pattern recognition in a natural and effective manner. Thus, the animal brain might have the ability to operate as a Clifford algebra computing device

articleTitle: Features of extra-dynamic characteristics of autodyne systems
abstract: The solution of differential equations system of the autodyne is found using quasi-static method for the general case of an arbitrary value of reflected radiation time delay and the rapid motion of a reflecting point object. Formation features of autodyne response are considered, taking into account such internal parameters of the oscillator as nonisochronism and nonisodromism. The waveform, DC component and distortion parameter functions of the distance and the direction of the location object movement are found.

articleTitle: Model of thermal processes in spatial-heterogeneous film structures at influence of electromagnetic microwave radiation
abstract: The numeral 3-d model of thermal processes is offered in heterogeneous film structures at influence of the microwave fields. A model is built with the use of method of independent thermal streams. For numerical realization an adaptive spatial net was used, that allows optimizing the design process depending on an object under study. Distribution of temperature is resulted for a double-layer spatial-heterogeneous film structure.

articleTitle: On electron hysteresis in O-type long-time interaction devices
abstract: The results of the theoretical study into the hysteresis phenomena for long-time interaction devices such as orotrons and diffraction radiation generators in the boundaries of approximated half-analytic nonlinear theory are presented. An attempt to describe the electron-hysteresis loop is made. The theoretical analysis confirms that the main cause for hysteresis phenomena is the average electron velocity change during the interaction between the electrons and synchronic traveling spatial harmonic of the HF-field.

articleTitle: Coaxial excitation of wideband V-shaped antenna
abstract: The results of coaxially fed 3-dimentional V-shaped printed antenna study are presented. The coaxial feed position providing 30% bandwidth with VSWR less than 1.5 is found. The antenna directional pattern frequency dependence is studied. The operating frequency range limitations are determined. Using the fact of far-field pattern shape distortion it is found that the final bandwidth is 21%.

articleTitle: Effect of thermal treatment on the structure and mechanical properties of coatings based on (Ti, Hf, Nb, Si)N
abstract: The paper presents the results of original research of nanostructured coatings based on (Ti, Hf, Nb, Si)N deposited by CAVD method. Coatings were investigated by several complementary methods of the structural element-analysis, such as: proton microbeam (μ-PIXE), micro- and nano-electron beam (EDX and SEM analysis), XRD. Elemental composition, microstructure, residual stresses in nanograins, profiles of atomic distribution on the surface of coatings in 3D view, phase composition, texture of surface were determined before and after annealing at temperatures 300, 500, 800, 1000°C (annealing time τ = 30 min).

articleTitle: The expansion of nonlinear radar functionality
abstract: The features of studying of medium with «metal-oxide-metal» structures were considered. The suitability of usage an additive mixture of phase modulated signal components and «white» Gaussian noise as a sounding signal (SS) was grounded. It is shown, that nonlinear scatterers re-emit signal, which spectral components have «grounds» («superstructures» with persistent spectrum). The estimation of nonlinear scatterers saturation can be made by the SS floor power level, at which the appearance of «grounds» in spectrum of response signal is observed.

articleTitle: THz surface electromagnetic waves in multilayer periodic semiconductor-dielectric structure
abstract: The properties of terahertz surface waves (SW's) in the finite semiconductor-dielectric periodic structure in an external magnetic field were investigated. The band structure of the considered periodic material was analyzed (Fig. 1). Analytical and numerical calculations of the dispersion relation for SW's were carried out. The distribution of electromagnetic field and the energy flow of SW's were studied. We also analyzed the properties of SW's in the considered structure in the subwavelength approximation (effective medium approximation).

articleTitle: SLA-aware approach for dynamic Web Service Composition
abstract: This paper provides SLA-aware dynamic Web Services Composition approach and its software implementation that allows performing composition supporting all classes of non-functional parameters and providing run-time support and dynamic reconfiguration at the same time.

articleTitle: Results of observations of comets C/2009 R1 and 17P/Holmes in oh line at 18 cm
abstract: The results of observations of comets C/2009 R1 (McNaught) during June 14–28, 2010 and 17P/Holmes during November 6–10 and November 25 – December 3, 2007 in line of OH molecule at 18 cm are presented. The OH gas production rate of comet C/2009 R1 (McNaught) versus the heliocentric distance between 0.42 and 0.62 AU is estimated.

articleTitle: Detecting of different pulse wave biosignals on large arteries
abstract: Detecting of pulse wave signals on the basis of direct sensing using relaxation processes in optoelectronic p-n junction is offered. Demonstrated the possibility of simultaneous and synchronous detecting of photoplethysmogram and sphygmogram that have different nature, so that their modulation coefficients of optical signals have opposite signs. The possibility of detecting the difference signal as a superposition of photoplethysmogram and sphygmogram on the optical layer. The resulting signal characterizes tonic state of the vessels, which is promising for the implementation of blood pressure measurement without arm cuffs.

articleTitle: Signal detection in RSA against the background of perturbing reflections
abstract: The algorithm of multiple-unit target detection against the multiple-unit disturbance and analysis' method of its efficiency have been presented.

articleTitle: Cartographic images processing methods
abstract: The work concerns the developing methods for processing of color map images to improve their quality. Improving of their quality is provided owing to adjusting the intensity component of the image in color space HSI by means of the gamma correction method. Input and output data are expressed in RGB color space. The proposed method can be used for the processing of low-quality aerial photographs.

articleTitle: Methods of decision making theory at the choise of the topological structure of access networks
abstract: The paper describes the approach and methods of decision making theory during the design of access networks within the task of network topological structure choice. A software product for reducing designer's time to be consumed for the choice of the best structure is presented.

articleTitle: Patch irradiators antenna array of Ku-band with control of the radiation field polarization
abstract: The results of investigation of the characteristics of a multi-element patched radiators antenna array of Ku-band with controlled polarization of the radiation field are presented. The designed antenna is characterized in the frequency band with little variable directional properties and qualitative matching on the radiators inputs. The results of the feeding system of antenna array development are presented.

articleTitle: Scattering of electromagnetic waves on the lattices of Dielectric Resonator's prism
abstract: Electromagnetic waves scattering on rectangular DR lattices of various prism forms are considered. It is shown that in some cases the scattering process is not explained by Snell's law.

articleTitle: Statistical measures of moment estimator for integral phase difference for application of reference phase method
abstract: The expression for estimator method for the moments of integral phase difference on the example of a minimum-phase method is obtained. The behavior of bias of estimator and its deviation for a case of different true values of integral phase difference and signal/noise relations are analyzed.

articleTitle: Microwave properties of semiconductors
abstract: The paper presents study of frequency dependencies of dielectric permittivity and loss in the most important semiconductor materials, such as silicon and gallium arsenide, at microwave range, as well as their temperature dependencies. It is shown that dielectric permittivity exhibit practically no dispersion at microwaves, while increases with rising temperature.

articleTitle: Optimization of emission domain first-emission thermionic cathode in millimeter-wave magnetron
abstract: This paper describes the results of research of the electrostatic potential distribution in the gap between the first-emission cathode and the interaction space in the millimeter-wave magnetron. It is shown that electrons emitted from the ring of 1,05r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">к</inf> – 0,95r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">А</inf> radius only take part in the growth of secondary-emission electrons in the magnetron interaction space.

articleTitle: AESA for a spacecraft operating in deep space
abstract: This paper considers the results of development of broadband space-based AESA. In particular, it concerns the results of calculation of one element of AESA in computer-aided design system using numerical methods of electrodynamics by parametric synthesis and provides radiation characteristics, frequency characteristics and the distribution of the normal component of the electric field.

articleTitle: Evaluation of magnetic field therapy for the treatment of patients with cardiovascular diseases
abstract: The calculation of amplitude and phase index of form is offered for the signals of pulse wave, which allows comparing quantitatively the degrees of difference of pulse waves, and has sensitiveness to influence the magnetic field.

articleTitle: Channel capacity analysis of wireless communications systems in 60 GHz band
abstract: The channel capacity of 60 GHz wireless communications systems over Rayleigh fading channels and Ricean fading channels for line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) with Phase shift keying (PSK) are investigated. The channel capacity in additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel is compared with the capacity over Rayleigh fading channels and the capacity over Ricean fading channels. The q-ary PSK modulation channel capacity analyses were conducted for Ricean fading channel, AWGN channel, and Rayleigh channel, where the SNR per symbol is known.

articleTitle: Determination of amorphous silicon absorption spectrum
abstract: An empirical model of the spectral dependence of amorphous silicon absorption coefficient is presented. The effect of the amorphous structure degree of disorder on the absorption coefficient value is demonstrated. The results can be applied for modeling of devices based on a-Si:H.

articleTitle: Probability distribution of simultaneous signal spectrum fluctuations in the noise data transmission system
abstract: Wireless data transmission system on the basis of the spectral interference of noise signals is investigated. The probability density of frequency transfer ratio on power in the non selective on frequency random scatter channel is estimated.

articleTitle: Nonlinear theory of the multiharmonic interactions in the longitudinal wave amplifier of superheterodyne fel
abstract: The cubic nonlinear theory of multiharmonic interactions of space charge waves (SCW) in the superheterodyne free electron laser (FEL) amplifier-section with a longitudinal electrostatic undulator is constructed. The lengths and levels of wave saturation were determined. The conditions under which there is a multiharmonic SCW amplification with a wide frequency range without distortion is found out.

articleTitle: Algorithm of the reflector's coordinates determination
abstract: An algorithm for determining coordinates of the reflectors that can be used in MIMO radar flat rectangular antenna array topology has been developed. Curves of accuracy of the coordinates calculated by the proposed algorithm versus error of the original data have been experimentally determined.

articleTitle: Development and study of the radioelectronic optical meter of methane concentration
abstract: The radioelectronic optical concentration meter of methane has been developed and studied. It has been determined: the conversion characteristic; the sensitivity to the output voltage is 0.51 V/<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vol.</sup>%; the absolute error of measurement is not over ±0.02 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vol.</sup>%, that is lesser by an order than the required value; the additional error caused by temperature changes does not exceed ±0.25 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vol.</sup>%, that is 1.6 times lesser than allowable.

articleTitle: The contribution of national technical university of ukraine «Kyiv Polytechnic Institute» in the preparation of scientific, production and technical personnel of the radioelectronics profile (1950–1980's)
abstract: The present paper concerns the activity of Kyiv Polytechnic Institute in the area of preparation of scientific, production and technical personnel for the radioelectronic sphere. The Institute's role in the development of radioelectronics in Ukraine in 1950–1980's is determined on the basis of carried out study.

articleTitle: Selective receiving of chaotic radiopulses
abstract: The new type of receiving of ultrawideband chaotic radio pulses is proposed. The method is based on projection of chaotic radio pulses to orthonormal set of reference signals. It was shown that this possibility exceptionally deals with properties of chaotic oscillations, generating by means of deterministic dynamical system. Performance of this method in the AWGN channel is identical to energy receiving and its essential feature is selectivity to the chaotic signal.

articleTitle: Using parabolic equation technique for radiation problem
abstract: In this paper the scalar radiation problem using parabolic equation is considered. The scattered field calculation technique based on two parabolic equations for waves propagating in two opposite directions is presented. The near- and far-field calculation results for parabolic cylinder reflector and various excitation conditions are shown. The near-field amplitude for cylindrical Luneburg lens and line current excitation are produced.

articleTitle: Morphological processing in contrast correction of distorted digital television images
abstract: The way of scene depth estimation when correcting digital television images recorded in bad weather, is considered. The way of its accuracy improving by application of morphological processing is presented. The possibility of proposed method application as depth map estimation technique is analyzed.

articleTitle: Transmission rate improvement estimation for satellite system in case of on-board signal regeneration
abstract: The realization of received signal regeneration on-board of a satellite allows implementing different transmission technologies on sections of a satellite link which has several advantages. One of these advantages is lowering of requirements to the energy properties of satellite channels at the expense of transformation of channels multiplexing method on the satellite. Comparative calculation demonstrates significant data transmission rate gaining in comparison with “transparent” satellite retransmission.

articleTitle: Procedure of electromagnetic compatibility implementation in design, construction and operation of industrial objects
abstract: A proposition is made for a new conceptual approach of EMC implementation to integrally link together all stages of developing objects outfitted with a large amount of electrical and radio-electronic equipment and stages of supplying technical facilities for those objects; features of developing a complex of the measuring and test apparatus' for implementation of the proposed approach are also considered.

articleTitle: “Laspi-Stereo” tuner: Its place in the domestic history of radio equipment
abstract: The importance of “Laspi-001 Stereo” tuner's appearance for radio electronics development which was manufactured by Sevastopol Instrument-Making Plant named after Kalmykov is considered. The study is carried out within the framework of analysis of a sample of such tuner from of the National Museum of Heroic Defense and Liberation of Sevastopol funds.

articleTitle: Experimental measurements of SMR-BAW resonators at 10 GHz
abstract: On the example of SMR-BAW resonators with operating frequency of 10 GHz the problems arising at production of such devices, rating adjustment and measurement at high frequencies are considered, and solutions are also given.

articleTitle: Excitable Schrödinger's metamedia
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to introduce new metamedia in the form of cellular automata. The cells are placed in a 2D array and they are capable of performing basic hypercomplex operating and exchanging messages about their state. Cellular automata like architectures have been successfully used for computer vision problems solving and hyperspectral image processing.

articleTitle: Posibility of growing pyramidal nets' usage for classification of fuzzy formalized objects
abstract: The article presents a possibility of using the growing pyramidal nets for fuzzy formalized objects' classification as a fragment of information networks' user model building process.

articleTitle: Energy resource distribution among digital communication system channels
abstract: The author proposes a method for distribution of energy resources of a digital communication system among data channels by changing signal constellation and channel coding parameters. A transmitter and a receiver with possibility of adaptive distribution energy resources are described. The results of modeling are shown.

articleTitle: Monitoring and measurement of synchronization signal parameters in IP/MPLS-network
abstract: The principles of the measurement of timing signals parameters on IP/MPLS transport network are considered. The results of measurements of instability of atiming signal of the Base Station are submitted. The basic principles of the creation of timing signals monitoring system are considered as well.

articleTitle: Dmitriy Borisovich Zimin: Scientist and maecenas (to the 80th anniversary from the date of his birth)
abstract: Life and activities of the famous Russian scientist and Maecenas, the founder and president of “Dinastiya” charity foundation,— a specialist of Radio Engineering Institute of Academy of Sciences of the USSR in the past, Doctor of Engineering Dmitry Borisovich Zimin, are analyzed. The new facts concerning “Dinastiya” charity foundation's support of the Crimean microwave conference in 2005, and Zimin's visits to the Crimea and Sevastopol are put into scientific circulation.

articleTitle: Modelling of multiservice streams at the decision of tasks of parametric synthesis
abstract: The present paper concerns mathematical models of informational streams and methods of determination of their characteristics on various sites of multiservice network NGN for the purpose of their usage at designing of telecommunication networks. To solve the problems of parametric synthesis of a multiservice telecommunication network as a mathematical model of data flows it is offered to use models of self-similar processes.

articleTitle: Structural and parametric synthesis of telecommunication systems with the usage of the multi-layer graph model
abstract: The present paper concerns the overlaid nature of modern telecommunication networks and expediency of the multi- layer graph model usage for its design. The general statement of a design problem is given. The design method in general using a multi-layer graph model and its application for a typical information-telecommunication system is proposed.

articleTitle: Methods and tecniques of spectrum refarming for LTE network deployment
abstract: Methods and techniques of spectrum refarming for deployment and further developing of LTE networks in Ukraine, are presented in this paper. We suggest an optimal solution for radio access network sharing based on soft migration from GWCN to MOCN architecture. We propose the model of effective frequency bands dispensing based on interfere bands exception. Furthermore, the algo-rithm of cooperative service of users, which allocated on the edge of cell, had been studied. In order to achieve better spectrum utilization of GSM network and satisfy the QoS requirements, we propose the method of compression the spectrum allocated by GSM users. Simulation results confirm the gain of proposed methods, in terms of calls lost probability.

articleTitle: Theory and practice of three-dimensional radio frequency visualization of objects
abstract: An effective radio holographic 3D-images synthesis scheme on the basis of the probe signal with linear frequency modulation is developed. The potential (maximum achievable) and the actual characteristics of the imaging system are compared.

articleTitle: Improving effectiveness for processing signals in data transmission channels with phase manipulation
abstract: The digital data transmission system scheme with external and internal turbo-encoder has been developed. The recommendation for cascade encoder components type and structure has been issued. The analytical relationships and research results for describing bit error rate of the cascade turbo-encoder components have been represented.

articleTitle: Investigation of approximation methods for increase the accuracy of phase measurement systems
abstract: The investigation of accuracy for methods of defining of the phase for delayed harmonic signals with white noises in digital systems. The method intended for digital processing of signals with use of electronic computing devices is offered, its comparison with a correlation method is carried out. The method is able to uses for digital commutation systems. Comparison with correlation methods is performed. The paper includes recommendations on the choices of Nyquist frequency and signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Noncontact infrared thermometer based on a self-oscillating lambda type system for measuring human body's temperature
abstract: There has been developed a device for temperature measuring based on a self-oscillating system, whose equivalent circuit has been implemented on the lambda diode's schematic analog, that provides high sensitivity and allows solving the problem of increasing accuracy of measuring human body's temperature in the noncontact way. The measurement error is ±0.1% within the operating range of (32–43) °C, the measuring time being 1 s, and at a the frequency instability of 3·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup>.

articleTitle: Review of capabilities of mathematical models for surface roughness of the low-temperature ceramic circuit boards
abstract: The experimental investigation of the surface of the low-temperature ceramic Green Tape 951 from DuPont and a conductive layer based on silver paste 6148 Ag. SEM photographs of the surface have been taken. The analysis of existing mathematical models and possibility of their use to describe the surface of the ceramic circuit board and a silver wire is performed.

articleTitle: Analysis of noise characteristics of autodyne microwave sensors of small displacements
abstract: The analysis of the noise level function of the distance to the monitoring surface was fulfilled. The major requirements for the choice of the working point and for the level of the reflected radiation were formulated. Experimental research results confirming the conclusions of theoretical studies were obtained on the example of autodyne hybrid-integrated oscillator module “Tigel-08” based on 8-mm wavelength range two-mesa planar Gunn diodes.

articleTitle: Optimization of radiosonde antenna radiation pattern
abstract: The vertical dipole antenna for atmospheric radiosonde with vertically tilted and horizontally isotropic radiation pattern is developed. The problem is solved by insertion of metal disc into antenna design. The model of the developed antenna for frequency band around 403 MHz is researched by means of computer analysis. The influence of the perforation of antenna disc on its characteristics is considered. The possibility of tilting the radiation pattern by 30 degrees without affecting the antenna input parameters is shown.

articleTitle: Algorithms of increase of accuracy and spatial resolution of the location-based remote sensing systems
abstract: The Improvement of the informative value of the results of remote sensing of various objects is connected with the improvement of the spatial resolution of the systems of environmental monitoring and suppression as correlated, and not correlated noise. Three useful algorithms of signal processing with the aim of improving the resolution and accuracy of measurement of coordinates of the controlled object are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Signal distortion analysis of autodyne microwave vibration sensors
abstract: The features of signal formation on amplitude and frequency changes of oscillations in an autodyne oscillator being under the influence of reflected electromagnetic radiation from the reflecting vibrating object are considered. Calculations of the harmonic coefficients and relative amplitude of the first harmonic of the signals depending on the amplitude of vibration for different operating points were performed. The recommendations for the proper selection of the operating point were developed, the possibility of dynamic range extension of autodyne vibration parameter meter is shown, microwave oscillator frequency stabilization with the external high-Q resonator is proposed.

articleTitle: Wireless charging mechanism for outdoor appliance
abstract: A portable wireless device for recharging batteries of vehicles is described in this paper. Application of novel, based on coupled radial spirals antennas with dimensions significantly less than the operating wavelength in free space, makes it possible effective pumping of RF energy without radiation into surrounding medium.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of processes at the cavities of high-power 300 GHz gyrotrons
abstract: For some advanced fusion experiments and promising technological applications RF sources with CW power near 200–1000 kW and frequency 300 GHz and more are requested. In the framework of this project, investigation of processes of interaction of helical electron beam with RF field at the cavities of several design versions of a 300 GHz gyrotron with output power of 200–1000 kW for operation in the continuous mode was implemented at IAP RAS.

articleTitle: Signal processing in location-based remote sensing systems
abstract: Location systems are widely used in environmental monitoring complexes. A method of processing signals in the radar channels, allowing providing high accuracy and getting a super-resolution.

articleTitle: Development of industrial microwave installation for grain processing
abstract: A microwave industrial installation for high-intensity thermal grain processing has been developed. An approach to create the optimal design of waveguide working chamber of the microwave installation operating in the traveling wave mode is offered. The installation is started-up and further experimentally investigated in operation at microwave power of 25 kW. The parameters of high-intensity heat treatment of grain and grain products, which have indicated a promising application of the developed microwave installation in the agriculture and food industry, are defined.

articleTitle: Morphology and structure of ZnO nanorods for saw sensors applications
abstract: The new results of the single-crystalline zinc oxide nanorods synthesis on the lithium niobate substrate by the hydrothermal growth using zinc acetate as a precursor for both seed-layer and nanostructures array, are presented. The formed nanostructures could be applied as a sensing element for acoustic wave based sensors.

articleTitle: Simulation of characteristics of optical burst switched networks
abstract: We provide the simulation of optical burst switching network for different signaling schemes. Our experiment shows that the INI scheme is more flexible, and is able for reconfiguration in dependence of traffic requirements. INI is able to combine advantages of both JET and TAW schemes.

articleTitle: High-informative medical diagnostic sphygmosystem on the basis on piezoresonant mechanotron pressure sensor
abstract: The research examines the peculiarities of application of piezoresonance mechanotrons with controlled interelectrode gap as the sensors of pulse wave of automated sphygmographic system of investigation of human cardiovascular system. The worked-out system “BIOTON” is intended for registration of local and volumetric sphygmograms in the tasks of polycardiographic and polysphygmographic researches and allows increasing considerably the accuracy and reliability of computer diagnostics of parameters of human hemodynamics.

articleTitle: The asymptotes of the dispersion curves of the TM wave in a planar anisotropic waveguide
abstract: The asymptotes of the dispersion curves for TM waves in an anisotropic planar waveguide with positive values of the permittivity tensor are obtained from Fresnel's equation for various values of the optical axis inclination angle in the plane of incidence. The dispersion curves have been calculated for the mode m = 1 of the TM wave for an anisotropic artificial medium with negative permittivity for extraordinary wave and positive permittivity for ordinary wave at various angles of inclination in the incidence plane.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of metal-dielectric nanocomposites with ferromagnetic inclusions
abstract: Metal-dielectric composites of epoxy matrix and nickel nanoparticles (up to 40 vol.%) were prepared. Their dielectric and magnetic properties were investigated in the frequency range from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> Hz to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> Hz. Electrodynamic parameters (reflection coefficient and absorption) of composites were calculated in dependence on the frequency (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> Hz to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> Hz) and nickel content. Possible applications of composites with ferromagnetic inclusions are discussed.

articleTitle: Retracing distribution of the sea surface elevations from altimeter return form
abstract: The factors that limit the ability to retracing the distribution of sea surface elevation from altimeter return form are considered. It is shown that the current method of calculating the parameters of the distribution can not fully account for the effect of waves on the high ridges of the reflected radio pulses, which in particular leads to an underestimation of the values of skewness obtained by altimetry.

articleTitle: Quality improvement of bulk soldering of microwave devices
abstract: The analysis of theoretical and experimental data is carried out, the optimization of technological processes of convection, wave and laser soldering is achieved. It is shown that the convection and wave soldering have relatively high precision to ensure optimum soldering temperatures by means of lower temperature difference in the depth of solder connections of manual, or laser soldering. The temperature of the solder joints in laser soldering can be estimated from the heat conduction equation for a semi-infinite plate with a given heat flux at the surface. The temperature of solder joints in a convection soldering can be adequately described by the assumption of regularity of the process of heating.

articleTitle: Diagnosing of underfloodings and spontaneous ignitions harbingers on drained-out wetlands by active and passive methods
abstract: The report analyzes the results of the combined consecutive day-time and night-time (in the dry autumn season, when vegetation processes mostly canceled) and multi-seasonal (in summer and winter conditions) radar - thermal IR sensing of grass stand covered dried-out wetlands. Investigations were carried out by using ACRS-30 aviation remote sensing complex. Investigation area was subjected to previously drained swamps in the area of Nizhyn, Chernihiv region of Ukraine. As a result it was shown that the radar-thermal IR survey can detect manifestations of hazardous processes on grass stand covered drained-out wetlands: over-wetting (due to non-working state of drainage channels) sites, as well as areas of low-temperature oxidation and self-heating of organic matter (including peat) prior to their spontaneous combustion in excessively drained-out sites.

articleTitle: Multiresonator microstrip antenna
abstract: The multiresonator microstrip antenna which includes disk metal-dielectric structure with six slot radiators was studied. With the help of finite elements method the spectral characteristics and current distribution on disk and energy characteristic were investigated. The possibility of two modes both multifrequency (sweep mode) and single frequency (fixed frequency) was shown.

articleTitle: Some test results of the “Polus” navigational upper-air sounding system
abstract: Test results of the «Polus» upper-air sounding system (UASS) based of the satellite GLONASS/GPS platforms are discussed in the report. Data of the experimental launch of navigation radiosondes (single and coupled), allowing carrying out a system operational parameter assessment, the comparative analysis of characteristics of the «Polus» UASS with radar sounding systems and evaluating reliability and measurement result reproducibility, are provided.

articleTitle: Controlled selective amplifier of microwave range
abstract: The architecture and the results of investigations of the properties of controlled selective amplifiers (SA) with low current consumption for microwave range based on SiGe technology are presented. Application of MOS transistors provides high weakening of the output signal in the low (near resonance) frequency range at the expense of minimizing the direct transmission of the input signal at the output SA.

articleTitle: “Visual” technique for design of microwave power amplifiers using large signal S-parameters
abstract: The «visual» technique for microwave power amplifier (PA) design is proposed. The design is based on load-pull simulations (or load-pull measurements) and large signal S-parameters. The technique takes into account a set of PA performances including output power, efficiency, large signal gain, input and output matching, stability, etc. As an example, the 30–33 GHz two-stage MMIC PA is designed based on the 0.15 µm GaN HEMT process on SiC substrate.

articleTitle: Bases of the codon recursive error-corrected coding of number-impulse data sources in telecommunication systems
abstract: On the results analysis of properties, advantages and disadvantages of recursive coding methods of number-impulse data sources is developed the method of codon recursive code sequences forming and data digital manipulation that will improve the identification performance of the data source integral characteristics and implement error-corrected exchange of information.

articleTitle: Investigation of thermal annealing of schungite in ammonium chloride medium
abstract: Effect of thermal annealing of schungite in ammonium chloride medium at 900 °C for 2 hours, was investigated. The chemical composition of the investigated substance and screening characteristics in the range (8…12) GHz is determined. The results of X-ray diffraction analysis of the initial and annealed material and a comparative table of the concentration of substances are presented.

articleTitle: Diffraction problem solution for bistatic zone of Radio Acoustic Sounding Systems
abstract: Meteorological parameters measurement on the lower route segment of sounding with modern radio acoustic systems is hampered due to a significant procedure error. The problem solution conditions are presented, the possibility to use Fresnel approximation is substantiated, the sequence of derivation of the analytical expression derivation of the signal being received is shown, the algorithm of numerical definition of the procedure additions to the amplitude and Doppler frequency shift stipulated by the sounding system bistatic nature, is described.

articleTitle: Modification of the stress-strain state for multicomponent (Ti-Zr-Hf-V-Nb)N nanostructured coatings by annealing at 600 °C
abstract: The nitride coatings (Ti-Zr-Hf-V-Nb)N based on the multicomponent high-entropy alloys with using of various methods of element-structural analysis, such as the method of phase-structural analysis of XRD, “α-sin<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>ϕ” methodology of the stress-strain state measurement (X-ray tensometry) have been investigated. It is shown, that the increasing of the stability of the considered coatings to oxidation during annealing is possible through the formation of the elastic stress-strain state of compression in the coating.

articleTitle: Vertical side looking algorithm based on radioaltimeter with pulse modulation
abstract: The vertical side looking algorithm is described in this paper. The algorithm's essence is in using a coherent distance and Doppler processing with further synthesizing radiolocation image. The linear objects with their parameters are extracts from a radiolocation image. The study results show the ability of creation of a correlation extreme navigation system based on the developed algorithm.

articleTitle: The improved method of cyclic code shift keying of perspective radiointerfaces
abstract: The present paper concerns the improved method of cyclic code shift keying, which allows adapting flexibly the parameters of perspective radiointerfaces to the condition of spreading the radio waves saving the maximum speed of data transfer and digital correlation processing on input; as well as an order of digital correlation processing of signals synthesized by the offered method.

articleTitle: On static fields representation in the theory of regular waveguide excitation
abstract: We obtained representations for static electric and magnetic fields induced by charged-particle current in a regular simply connected ideally conducting waveguide in the form of solutions to excitation equations of Kisunko-Vainshtein waveguide excitation theory. On the example of a regular rectangular waveguide an equivalence of the obtained expressions with Green's function representations of these fields is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Influence of electrostatic field periodic heterogeneity on M-type devices characteristics
abstract: The influence of the electric field periodic inhomogeneity in the interactions space, caused by the presence of a slow structure, to the processes of an electron beam interaction with high-frequency waves in M-type devices is investigated. It is shown that the presence of such heterogeneity modifies the electric modes which are the best for the interaction of device operation as the amplification both of a monochromatic wave, and signals, containing many harmonics.

articleTitle: Pulse microwave transmitter of aerological radar
abstract: The paper presents results of the development of the pulse transmitting device of the aerological radar of atmosphere radio sounding system ensuring measurement of the inclined range up to an aerological radiosonde (AR) fitted with the superregenerative transceiver (SRT).

articleTitle: Planning and implementation aspects of study of experimental psycho-physiological conditions of extreme activity operators
abstract: The developed methods of the electroencephalographic research with the aim to obtain quantitative parameters of transient brain biorhythm signals which provide the evaluation process of psycho-physiological brain parts condition of extreme activities operators.

articleTitle: Range properties of a composite material on the basis of conducting fibers of arbitrary geometry
abstract: The task of interaction between electromagnetic waves and a plane layer of biisotropic composite material, which represents a dielectric matrix, containing resistive fibers in the form of coupled few-coil helices of different sizes was solved. The influence of helix size on frequency properties of a plane layer of the composite material was investigated. The possibility to broaden the resonance band of the composite by employing similar resistive inclusions was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Packet method of telemetry data transmission in the upper-air sounding system
abstract: The paper considers the development of a hardware and software system implementing the batch method of transmission of telemetry data to ground-based radar from spaceborne upper-air radiosonde equipped with a super-regenerative transceiver.

articleTitle: 2-mm wavelength range orotron with double-row periodic structure and two electron beams
abstract: The experimental study of output power increase in 2 mm orotron with double-row periodic structure and semispherical open resonator by means of introducing an additional electron beam was performed. This additional plane electron beam was situated over second row of periodic structure used in experiment. Theoretically It is shown that when the caustic radius to radiation wavelength has ratio r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> /λ ≅ 2, the effect of power increase is possible in all frequency tuning range of orotron. But in experiment it was observed for r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> /λ ≅ 1.7.

articleTitle: The investigation of the nanoporous materials formation under temperature fluctuations
abstract: Based on the three-parametric Lorenz system, the model, that allows describing in a self-consistent way a mode of the nanoporous structure formation was developed. Considering the influence of the fluctuations of the growing surface temperature the phase diagram of the system and the dependence of the stationary concentration were obtained.

articleTitle: Calculation of characteristics of two types of nanoradio based on carbon nanotubes
abstract: Modification of an express engineering method for simulation of nanoradio based on carbon nanotubes was proposed. Influence of nanoelectromechanical system parameters on nanoradio IV-characteristics was shown. Calculation of demodulation current of amplitude modulated (AM) signals was also made.

articleTitle: Flow-based model of fault-tolerant routing in MPLS-network
abstract: A Design of flow-based model for MPLS Fast ReRoute is proposed in the paper. The model allows calculating two types of paths, i.e. primary and backup ones, for the same flow. Depending on the parameters of the model, different schemes of reservation such as link protection, node protection, or path protection, can be implemented. In the course of solving the problem of MPLS Fast Reroute the classical metric of primary and backup paths is minimized. The nonlinear restrictions, which are responsible for prevention of node, link or path intersection of primary and backup routes, are introduced in the structure of the model.

articleTitle: A new technique for extraction of bias-dependent drain resistance in HEMTs
abstract: A new technique for extracting bias-dependent drain resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf> in microwave FETs is proposed. Solving a set of equations for the new FET internal equivalent circuit, the analytical formula for bias-dependent R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf> value is derived. The dependence of R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf> on bias voltages is obtained for 0.15 um GaN HEMT on SiC substrate. The use of bias-dependent R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf> in linear and nonlinear FET models leads to improving the modeling accuracy of the FET S-parameter, IV-characteristics, and output power.

articleTitle: Forecasting of bipolar integrated circuits hardness for various kinds of penetrating radiations
abstract: Experimental equipment for registration of parameters variation of integrated circuits (IC's) which are in operation mode and influenced by a flux of electrons with 4 MeV energy is considered. It's shown possibility of high energy electrons application for forecasting IC hardness to neutron and proton radiation.

articleTitle: Tri-band active patch slot antennas for angular observations using GLONASS/GPS signals
abstract: Tri-band (L1/L2/L3) active patch slot leaky-wave antennas with the right-hand circular polarization for angular observations using the signals of the Global navigation satellite systems GLONASS/GPS have been designed.
