The antenna positioning accuracy in the horizontal and vertical planes as well as in the angular observations has been estimated. Measurements have been made in the L1 frequency band using the combined GLONASS/GPS constellation. It has been shown that the positioning root-mean-square-error (RMSE) of an active antenna relative to another one in the horizontal plane is less than 2.2 mm, and in the vertical plane it is less than 1.8 mm. RMSE of the positioning by the yaw, roll and pitch angles at a distance of 0.7m between the centers of three antennas does not exceed 9 angular minutes, while at a distance of 2 m it does not exceed 4 angular minutes.

articleTitle: Development of the scientific bases for technology of contact soldering of microwave devices
abstract: One of the most important parameters affecting the quality of soldering of electronics is soldering temperature. The article provides analytical relations which allow calculating the required contact soldering temperature taking into account the parameters of the soldering station and solder bar.

articleTitle: The method for accurate measurements of absolute phase and group delay of frequency converters
abstract: A new method for absolute phase and group delay of mixers and frequency converters is introduced. The method can also measure conversion loss. Method has the highest accuracy that is achieved by excluding connections and re-connections in microwave networks during measurements.

articleTitle: Hybrid-monolithic frequency converter device created with LTCC technology, using flip-chip
abstract: In the article the results of development of hybrid monolithic frequency converter multilayer microwave LTCC device of FSUE “RPC “Istok” are presented. For improvement of frequency selection, decrease of overall dimensions and increase of reliability the flip-chip technology of die mounting has been used.

articleTitle: Comparison analysis of vector network analyzer verification techniques
abstract: This paper illustrates validity of calibration comparison method to evaluate effective error factors of vector network analyzers verification procedure. The method is quite simple to be implemented in the software of modern instruments. Verification procedure will be much simpler if electronic calibrators are used.

articleTitle: Resonant slot spherical antenna
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic waves radiation into a space outside a perfectly conducting sphere through a narrow slot, cut in an end-wall of a semi-infinite rectangular waveguide, excited by a wave of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> type is solved using a rigorous self-consistent formulation. The asymptotic solution of the integral equation for magnetic current on the aperture of slot was found by the generalized method of induced magnetomotive forces (MMF). Influence of the sphere radius upon energy characteristics of the spherical antenna was investigated numerically.

articleTitle: Upper-air sounding system with radio navigational measurement of coordinates by GLONASS/GPS signals
abstract: Specialists of UrFU and PC «Radiy» have developed upper-air sounding system (UASS), using GLONASS/GPS signals for position of an upper-air radiosonde. In comparison with UASS of radar type it has advantages of higher accuracy, reliability of measurements, and mobility. Batch manufacturing of the system is established at the PC «Radiy».

articleTitle: Development of the vertical handover algorithm for heterogeneous wireless networks
abstract: The present paper concerns an intelligent multicriteria vertical handover algorithm for the heterogeneous wireless networks. It uses fuzzy logic for parameters processing and for the triggering handover decision making. A proposed solution allows increasing quality of the service provided by the network, and providing transparent mobility of users.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillation phase stabilization effect of nanosecond gunn oscilators (numerical simulation)
abstract: Numerical simulation based on the local field model was performed to study the starting mode of operation of a nanosecond pulsed Gunn oscillator. Deviations of the microwave oscillation phase in the oscillator with resistive load and with a resonator equivalent circuit were determined depending on the pulse rise time and amplitude of modulation voltage on the Gunn diode.

articleTitle: The methods of compensating parasitic elements of the transistor in class-F amplifier at the microwave range
abstract: The methods of construction and calculation of the Output Load Circuit (OLC) which allows compensating the negative effect of parasitic elements of the transistor (output drain-source capacitance - C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf> and drain inductance - L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</inf>) in class-F power amplifier (PA) with addition of the third harmonic voltage at the frequency of 400 MHz is proposed. The results of modeling and experimental research of energy characteristics of the class-F PA, in which the OLC allowing compensation of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf> and L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</inf> has been used, are presented.

articleTitle: Microstrip-stub reflectarrays as microvave component of the controllable radar cover built from integral modules with digital reconfiguration
abstract: The paper shows that for a number of functional purposes reconfigurable microstrip reflective type antenna arrays can make up a set of base elements for the creation of components of digital controllable covers intended for microwave operation.

articleTitle: The multichannel homodyne measuring system of the microwave signal amplitude and phase progression fluctuations
abstract: In this article the principle of the multichannel homodyne measuring system of the microwave signal amplitude and phase propagations fluctuations with homodyne frequency transform is considered.

articleTitle: Digital transceiver module of the intelligent antenna array
abstract: The ways of design of the intelligent antenna arrays using digital beamforming technology are considered. QPSK modulators and power amplifiers models - the base transmitter paths elements of digital transceiver module (TRM) are designed and studied.

articleTitle: Microwave method of the even temperature distribution in the volumetric materials
abstract: Problems of the even temperature distribution creation in the volumetric materials with different dielectric losses placed in the beam-type microwave device are examined. The volumetric material was irradiated by two types of antennas which provided perpendicular and parallel flux direction of the electric-field vector relatively to the material's surface. Experimental data on the temperature field distribution in the volume of material is presented. It is shown that the total temperature dispersion is less than 5°C inside the material heated up to 80°C.

articleTitle: Influence of an ion cloud on dinamics of relativistic electron beam dynamics
abstract: The behavior of an electron beam in plasma in the presence of external fields is investigated. The analysis of electron beam divergence dependence vs. concentration of ions in the interaction space is carried out. It is demonstrated that a longitudinal magnetic field and positively charged plasma in combination can be used for confinement of the electron beam.

articleTitle: An experimental estimation of an accuracy of the digital elevation maps obtained by space-based InSAR systems
abstract: This paper presents the results of an experimental research of the digital elevation maps accuracy by processing with different phase noise filtration algorithms and phase unwrapping methods. A conclusion about the necessity of utilization of ground control points for model geocoding is made.

articleTitle: Template method of forming InSb large aspect ratio quantum nanowires
abstract: Method of nanoporous templates creating based on the anodic alumina (AA) for forming of quantum nanowires with a high aspect ratio is developed. The processes of InSb electrochemical deposition in the pores of templates are studied. The results of electron microscopic study of these nanostructures and electron probe electron probe X-ray spectrum microanalysis are shown. Percentage ratio of indium and antimony in formed nanowires is determined.

articleTitle: Determination of the coordinates of the pathological zones in the mass of the biological object
abstract: Results of research of the biologic objects field structures interaction at the determination of pathologic zones in their mass are offered. Thus, approach to a problem of the interaction of medicine equipment modules with biologic objects during patient diagnostics is based on modeling of field structures distribution, which these oscillation systems are generated, taking into account time history there parameters at diagnostics process, sizes of a real sensor and distance up to a pathologic zone in their mass. Especially, the gradient vector field distribution analysis of structures of a biological object with an anomalistic object in mass is analyzed. These simulators for creation of the principles of functioning of the new techniques of the express determination of pathologic zones in biologic mass may be used in future.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic properties of composites based on multiwall carbon nanotubes studied by THz-TDS and cw BWO-based spectrometer at different levels of peak THz power
abstract: The spectra of the permittivity of composites based on MWCNTs in the frequency range from 50 GHz to 3.5 THz have been measured. The methods of pulse spectroscopy based on femtosecond laser and a continuous wave radiation on the spectroscope using a backward wave oscillator have been applied for measuring. Peak radiation power varied from microwatts to hundreds of kilowatts.

articleTitle: Microwave and terahertz dielectric properties of single-crystalline scandate substrates for ferroic thin film deposition
abstract: Single-crystalline (110) DyScO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and (110) TbScO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrates were studied in microwave and THz ranges. Their inplane components of anisotropic dielectric parameters were measured from 10 K to 400 K. TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01d</sub> and HE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11d</sub> resonances of the thin substrates were used for their microwave characterization. The microwave and THz parameters are consistent, show a strong dielectric anisotropy and pronounced temperature dependences. Use of the substrates in microwave applications is discussed.

articleTitle: Coherent pulse radar with airborne superregenerative transceiver
abstract: The paper presents results of the development of mobile coherent radar of the radio sounding system (RSS) of the atmosphere receiving telemetric information from an aerological radiosonde (AR), fitted with a superregenerative transceiver (SRT), measuring its angular coordinates and inclined range at a distance up to 250 km.

articleTitle: On the locality principle keeping in Aharonov — Bohm effect
abstract: The locality principle fulfillment in the Aharonov-Bohm (AB) effect is analyzed from the point of view of a self-sufficient potential formalism based on so-called gradient hypothesis in electrodynamics. The “magnetic” kind of AB effect is examined (as the quantum charged particle moves to an infinitely long solenoid with a constant current), and no locality principle violation recognized if the gradient hypothesis is used. A conclusion is made that AB effect is no longer a physical or electrodynamic “paradox”.

articleTitle: Synthesis of rational topology of wireless sensor networks
abstract: The problem of constructing of rational topology of wireless sensor networks using repeaters on the basis of miniature unmanned aerial vehicles is considered; a method of solving the problem through the use of a specially designed base of rules of such repeaters placement, which avoids exhaustive search of network graphs to get close to the optimal solution in real time, is proposed.

articleTitle: A neural network algorithm for linear structures detection on SAR images
abstract: It is pointed out that traditional algorithms for linear structures are not effective in a presence of speckle on images. The neural network algorithm based on Hough transform is offered and researched. The examples of real space images processing are given.
